item.skycraft.relic.ad_green_treaty.desc: A pledge between Summerset and Valenwood, written on cured hide because no Bosmer will sign on paper.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_queens_gift.desc: A carved box of Summerset glass holding a silver moon-sugar spoon. A gift for the Mane, and a promise.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_veil_cipher.desc: A wax tablet of names and dates, written in a code that confuses Bosmer and Khajiit with livestock.
item.skycraft.relic.ad_viper_banner.desc: Blue-green silk worked with a coiled serpent. The Maormer fly it when they mean to burn a town.
item.skycraft.relic.aetherial_bow.desc: Auriel's own bow, waiting for its sunlit arrows.
item.skycraft.relic.akaviri_katana.desc: An Akaviri blade from the fall of Pale Pass. The steel is still bright under centuries of frost.
item.skycraft.relic.alms_purse.desc: A purse stitched with the symbols of the Nine, heavy with donations for the poor.
item.skycraft.relic.amaund_writ.desc: A writ of execution. The name on it is the Emperor's.
item.skycraft.relic.amulet_of_saarthal.d: An old Nord amulet that hums whenever it's near powerful magic.
item.skycraft.relic.ancestor_mask.desc: A bone mask from the Urshilaku burial caverns, stolen by grave robbers and recovered. It feels watched.
item.skycraft.relic.ancestor_moth.desc: Glowing moths drawn from the Ancestor Glade, which let a Moth Priest read a Scroll safely.
item.skycraft.relic.arkay_censer.desc: A small brass censer that the Temple uses to bless the resting dead. The smoke smells of cedar.
item.skycraft.relic.arvel_deed.desc: The Arvels' debts to an Imperial bank, which Orvas Dren will be delighted to buy.
item.skycraft.relic.ash_salts.desc: Bitter ingredients from the ashlands. Boiled together, they ease the blight's grip.
item.skycraft.relic.attunement_sphere.de: A humming Dwemer device that Septimus says will open the way to the Tower of Mzark.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_epistolar: A Black Book recovered from a Dwemer ruin. It wants to be read.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_waking.de: Bound in something that is not leather. The pages move when you aren't looking.
item.skycraft.relic.black_soul_gem.desc: A soul gem gone dark as a starless night. It can hold a mortal soul, and it wants to.
item.skycraft.relic.black_soul_star.desc: Malyn Varen's soul is trapped inside, souring the Star.
item.skycraft.relic.black_worm_orders.de: Names of Guild mages, their routes and their habits, in a careful cramped hand. Signed with a worm devouring its own tail.
item.skycraft.relic.blackwood_ledger.des: Shipments of 'tonic' paid for in Company gold and logged by an Argonian hand.
item.skycraft.relic.bravil_signet.desc: A Bravil magistrate's seal ring, heavy gold. Its owner will be very embarrassed to explain its loss.
item.skycraft.relic.brotherhood_letter.d: Orders in a Cyrodiilic cipher, sent to a Dark Brotherhood agent in Vvardenfell. The last line gives a place.
Raw ebony from the Caldera mine, weighed, sealed and stamped with the Hlaalu mark. All of it this time.
item.skycraft.relic.colony_report.desc: Falco Galenus's report on the colony: the mine, the rieklings, the smugglers, the factor, and the recovered cargo.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_ahzid_letter.desc: Promises of Forebear gold and Imperial favour to whoever holds Lord Hamaad's seat after him. Signed in Ahzid's own hand.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_anahbi_mask.desc: Beaten gold over a face that died four hundred years ago. Dented where the robbers pried at it.
item.skycraft.relic.cr_tribute_casket: Tribute Casket of the High King
item.skycraft.relic.cr_tribute_casket.de: A sealed casket of salt-silver bound for the High King's court. The raiders had not yet broken the wax.
item.skycraft.relic.crusaders_vision.des: A coal from the Shrine of the Crusader that does not burn the hand. It glows brighter near Pelinal's relics.
item.skycraft.relic.crystal_shard.desc: A shard of the Crystal Tower's living stone, stolen by Maormer raiders.
item.skycraft.relic.dagon_idol.desc: A crude red idol of the Prince of Destruction, carved by people who should have known better.
item.skycraft.relic.delphine_note.desc: 'If you want the horn, rent the attic room at the Sleeping Giant Inn. Your friend.'
item.skycraft.relic.dissident_tract.desc: A pamphlet questioning the divinity of the Three. Written with care, and with considerable courage.
item.skycraft.relic.dragonstone.desc: A slab of carved stone mapping the burial mounds of dragons across Skyrim.
item.skycraft.relic.dream_ash.desc: A pinch of fine grey ash from the slopes of Red Mountain, gathered at the place of Nibani's vision.
item.skycraft.relic.dremora_sigil.desc: A blackened iron token from the Daedra at Fort Sutch. It is warm and does not cool.
item.skycraft.relic.duel_glove.desc: A formal glove of challenge, thrown at your feet by a Hlaalu who thinks Redoran honor is a joke.
item.skycraft.relic.dulcias_ledger.desc: Notches for every goat the goblins took. She wants proof the debt is settled.
item.skycraft.relic.ebony_blade_relic.de: It grows sharper every time it betrays a friend.
item.skycraft.relic.ebony_sample.desc: A dense, gleaming chunk from the first seam of the Raven Rock mine.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_blood.d: Serana's scroll. It speaks of a bow, a prophecy, and the sun's death.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_cyrodii: Taken from the Imperial Library in the White-Gold Tower. It is impossible to read for long without the world going soft at the edges.
To look upon it is to see time itself, bent and folded. Handle with reverence.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_sun.des: Valerica's scroll, guarded in the Soul Cairn for an age.
item.skycraft.relic.eruvan_token.desc: A worn bronze disc with an Akaviri dragon's eye. Proof that the Blades sent you.
item.skycraft.relic.ervyn_confession.des: A purse of fresh coin and a note: 'For the Sarethi matter. Make sure the boy is seen near the body.' Signed only with a V.
item.skycraft.relic.eyes_of_the_falmer.d: Two great gems pried from a Dwemer statue. Worth more than most towns.
item.skycraft.relic.fb_dwarven_astrolabe: A nest of brass rings that still turn on their own, slowly, as if tracking stars no one else can see. Looted from the ruins of Stros M'Kai.
Instructions to burn the bonded warehouses of Taneth on the night of the new moon. Sealed with a crown above a sword, and no name.
Water-stained pages listing silk, glass and Imperial-bonded wine, every crate insured under the Emperor's seal.
item.skycraft.relic.fellglow_books.desc: Three volumes on the Eye of Magnus, taken from Urag's shelves by a former student.
item.skycraft.relic.finns_lute.desc: A lute carved by the bard Finn. The strings still hold their tune.
item.skycraft.relic.first_writ.desc: A writ of honorable execution, sealed by the Morag Tong and recognised by the Grand Council. It names one person.
item.skycraft.relic.focusing_crystal.des: A lens of Dwemer glass that once focused starlight in Mzulft's Oculory.
item.skycraft.relic.forged_black_hand_or: Orders in Lucien's style, sealed with a Speaker's mark. The ink is only weeks old, and the mark is wrong.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_heart_of_hollow_e: The heart of the great bear of Purewater Run, wrapped in moss. The Reachfolk say a bear's heart remembers how to be brave.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_silver_blood_ledg: Twenty years of payments from the Silver-Blood family to 'the mine'. No ore is listed. No names, either.
item.skycraft.relic.fs_warrens_note.desc: 'The woman asks too many questions. In the market, in daylight, so the others learn. N.' Found in a killer's cot in the Warrens.
item.skycraft.relic.fyr_endorsement.desc: A single line in Divayth Fyr's hand: 'Not a fool.' From him, this is a lavish recommendation.
item.skycraft.relic.gallus_journal.desc: Written in old Falmer script. Someone in Winterhold might read it.
item.skycraft.relic.gauntlets_of_the_cru: Heavy steel gauntlets worn by Pelinal in the war against the Ayleid sorcerer-kings.
item.skycraft.relic.gb_klimmeks_bundle.d: Dried fish, salt, a wheel of hard cheese and a note in careful letters: 'For the Masters, with respect.'
item.skycraft.relic.glenmoril_heads.desc: Grim trophies. Kodlak believes burning them will free a soul from Hircine's hunt.
item.skycraft.relic.goldenglow_bill.desc: Proof that someone has quietly bought Goldenglow Estate out from under its owner.
item.skycraft.relic.gp_felling_saw.desc: A long Colovian saw with sap still drying in its teeth. The Bosmer would very much like to see it melted.
item.skycraft.relic.gp_story_knot.desc: A cord of braided sinew tied in a hundred knots. Each knot is a sentence of a story only a Spinner can read.
item.skycraft.relic.graht_seed.desc: The seed of a walking tree, pulled from the Wilderking's thorns.
item.skycraft.relic.gull_captains_log: Captain's Log of the Gilded Gull
item.skycraft.relic.gull_captains_log.de: The last page is a tally of ransoms. The handwriting gets shakier toward the end.
item.skycraft.relic.heart_shard.desc: A splinter of red crystal from the depths of Red Mountain, still humming with old power.
item.skycraft.relic.helm_of_the_crusader: Pelinal Whitestrake's helm, dented and blackened, and still warm under the dust.
item.skycraft.relic.hist_sap.desc: Amber sap from the Root Hist, free of the blight.
item.skycraft.relic.hist_sap_vial.desc: Thick, faintly warm, and sweet-smelling. Taken from a Blackwood mercenary who would not stop fighting.
item.skycraft.relic.hlaalu_rent_ledger.d: Rents owed to the Council Manor by Balmora's shopkeepers. Several pages are marked in red.
item.skycraft.relic.honningbrew_poison.d: Labeled pest poison. It is not pest poison.
item.skycraft.relic.horn_of_jurgen.desc: The plain war horn of the founder of the Greybeards' order.
item.skycraft.relic.indarys_charter.desc: Councilor Sarethi's grant of land at Bal Isra, to raise a Redoran stronghold in the House's name.
item.skycraft.relic.jagged_crown.desc: The ancient crown of Skyrim's High Kings, made of dragon teeth and bone.
Names of retired Blades across Cyrodiil, with notes on their families and habits, in Aldmeri script.
item.skycraft.relic.kd_red_wyrm_banner.d: The order's first standard: a red dragon on black. The cloth is sound after two hundred years in a tomb, which no one can quite explain.
item.skycraft.relic.kd_wyrm_tooth.desc: As long as a forearm and still warm to the touch. Proof enough for any court in the Covenant.
item.skycraft.relic.king_olaf_verse.desc: The lost Edda of King Olaf One-Eye, in his own scratchy hand.
item.skycraft.relic.kr_chancellors_purse: Freshly minted Wayrest coin, still in the wrapping of the banker who serves the Chancellor's household.
item.skycraft.relic.kr_ransom_letter.des: A demand for five thousand crowns for the safe return of Elsabet Mornay. Written in a careful hand, on very good paper. Pirates rarely own very good paper.
item.skycraft.relic.legion_orders.desc: A demand that Whiterun admit a Legion garrison.
item.skycraft.relic.lex_roster.desc: Every Guild fence and safehouse the Watch suspects, with the night each will be raided.
item.skycraft.relic.lost_strongbox.desc: A waterlogged strongbox from the lost ship, holding the colony's quarterly accounts and its pay chest.
item.skycraft.relic.lovidicus_journal.de: A nobleman's journal, its last pages written in a hand that grew stranger with each entry. One passage speaks of an orc woman and a son.
item.skycraft.relic.mace_of_the_crusader: A flanged mace blessed in Stendarr's name. Undead things flinch from its shadow.
item.skycraft.relic.magius_letters.desc: Letters arranging the sale of Company ebony to smugglers, signed in the factor's own hand.
item.skycraft.relic.marsh_heal_herbs.des: Marsh herbs that Sister Ilara can brew into a draught against the coughing sickness.
item.skycraft.relic.meridia_beacon.desc: A glowing orb that pulls you, gently, toward the Statue to Meridia.
item.skycraft.relic.miraak_note.desc: 'The usurper is in Skyrim. Go to Solstheim, find the stones, serve Miraak.' Unsigned.
item.skycraft.relic.moon_relic.desc: A silver lattice that catches both moons' light.
item.skycraft.relic.moon_sugar_crate.des: Fine moon sugar from the Dren plantation, marked as saltrice for the excise men.
item.skycraft.relic.mp_consecrated_sugar: Sugar from the temple fields, blessed under both moons. Stolen once, to be cooked into skooma. Not anymore.
A silver censer with two openings, one for each moon. It went dark when the Fane fell to the Dro-m'Athra.
item.skycraft.relic.nahkriin_staff.desc: Nahkriin's staff, the key that opens the portal to Sovngarde.
item.skycraft.relic.netch_jelly_jar.desc: Quivering, faintly glowing jelly from a bull netch. A Telvanni master wanted it for reasons he did not explain.
item.skycraft.relic.netch_leather_gift.d: A large, flawless netch hide, the kind a wise woman might use for a drum or a cloak.
item.skycraft.relic.oghma_infinium.desc: Hermaeus Mora's book of all knowledge. Reading it changes the reader.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_bloodline_axe.de: A broad iron axe notched by twelve generations of chiefs. Each notch has a name, and Burguk can recite them all.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_giant_knucklebon: As big as a fist, and yellow with age. Wise-women grind such bones for their charms.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_offering.desc: A tusk taken from the ogre that terrorized Wrothgar.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_old_keystone.des: A carved block from the gate of an older Orsinium, cut when the city was young and still believed it would last.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_orichalc_ore.des: A lump of green-veined ore, heavy as guilt. Forged right, it makes the hardest steel the Orcs know.
item.skycraft.relic.panteas_flute.desc: A silver flute that belonged to the College's finest musician.
item.skycraft.relic.peryite_incense.desc: Vampire dust, silver, deathbell and ruby, burned together. It smells exactly like you'd expect.
item.skycraft.relic.pilgrims_token: Pilgrim's Token of the Seven Graces
item.skycraft.relic.pilgrims_token.desc: A small clay token, stamped at each shrine of the pilgrimage. It is nearly full.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_breach_shard.desc: A splinter of a breach between worlds. Raindrops hang motionless inside it.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_dream_shell.desc: A pale pearl that was in your hand when you woke. It is cool, faintly damp, and smells of sea fog.
item.skycraft.relic.ps_horologe.desc: A Psijic instrument of nested silver rings that measures not hours but the distance between what is and what might have been.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_altmer.desc: A crystal shard from a Summerset ruin.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_argonian.des: Sap from a sacred Hist tree.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_breton.desc: A spellbook taken from a coven's altar.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_dunmer.desc: Ash of a Dunmer ancestor, stolen from its family tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_foreign.desc: Nobody knows who made it, or what it's for.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_imperial.des: A glowing blue Ayleid stone, full of starlight.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_khajiit.desc: Sweet, sticky and sacred. Do not lick.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_orc.desc: A crude idol, stolen from a stronghold shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_redguard.des: A curved sword from an age before Hammerfell had its name.
item.skycraft.relic.raw_glass_lode.desc: Green, glittering raw glass from the Zebabi mine. Worth more than its weight in gold, and heavy enough to prove it.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_blade.desc: Broken shards of an impossibly sharp blade.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_hilt.desc: One piece of the dagger of the Prince of Destruction.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_pommel.desc: A pommel stone that glows like a coal.
item.skycraft.relic.rethan_deed.desc: A Hlaalu land grant for a manor on the Odai plateau, signed with a flourish by Councilor Curio.
item.skycraft.relic.rjorns_drum.desc: A war drum. Rjorn played it while the hagravens screamed.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_smuggled_steel.de: Blades from a Senchal forge, wrapped in oilcloth and stamped as 'pickled fish'.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_sugar_tithe.desc: The year's moon sugar, owed to a lord who has never cut a cane in his life.
item.skycraft.relic.rk_tax_chest.desc: A locked box of coin squeezed out of the farmers of Anequina. The lock is very good. The hinges are not.
item.skycraft.relic.rueful_axe.desc: Clavicus Vile wants Barbas dead with it. Barbas would rather not.
A sticky note, mostly wine stains: 'Misty Grove. Bring the staff. Bring yourself.'
item.skycraft.relic.sh_flaying_list.desc: Names of hunters, smiths and farmers who trade with Jorrvaskr. Three are crossed out in something brown.
item.skycraft.relic.sh_varek_journal.des: Plans for the Silver Hand after Krev, written in a cramped, proud hand, and a map of the old refuge where the hunters gather.
item.skycraft.relic.shehai_blade.desc: The spirit-sword of a Yokudan Ra Gada warrior, sealed in its tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.sigil_stone.desc: Torn from the top of an Oblivion gate's tower. It's warm, and it pulses like a heart.
item.skycraft.relic.silver_hand_orders.d: Orders to burn Jorrvaskr's hounds out of their den, signed by Krev the Skinner.
item.skycraft.relic.skeleton_key.desc: Nocturnal's own key. It opens anything: locks, doors, minds.
Vaermina's staff. It feeds on dreams.
item.skycraft.relic.smuggler_ledger_tong: A smuggler's accounts, with a column of payments to a Balmora fence named Corvo.
item.skycraft.relic.smuggler_manifest.de: Cargoes ferried across Lake Rumare by night, and the Waterfront warehouse each was bound for.
item.skycraft.relic.ss_magistrate_seal.d: An Imperial seal from a province that no longer belongs to the Empire. Its owner pretended otherwise.
item.skycraft.relic.ss_morag_tong_writ.d: A sealed writ naming every Shadowscale in the Stormhold enclave. Signed by Weighs-the-Coin, in a careful, greedy hand.
item.skycraft.relic.ss_slaver_brand.desc: A Dunmer house-mark on an iron rod. It has been used recently.
item.skycraft.relic.ss_stolen_clutch.des: Six warm, leathery eggs wrapped in moss, packed for a long journey to a collector in Cyrodiil.
item.skycraft.relic.staff_relic_magnus.d: Old Morokei's prize. It drinks magicka from whatever it is pointed at.
item.skycraft.relic.stamped_ebony.desc: Ebony bearing the East Empire Company's stamp, found in a smugglers' cave. It should never have left the warehouse.
item.skycraft.relic.stormcloak_axe.desc: A war axe, sent as a message: choose a side.
item.skycraft.relic.substructure_map.des: A crumbling chart of the Ayleid passages under the Imperial City, older than the Empire above them.
item.skycraft.relic.teekeeus_concordance: A fat, much-annotated index of the Chorrol library. Faintly singed, and missing a corner the scamp chewed off.
item.skycraft.relic.th_blade_insignia.de: A dragon on a dulled steel badge. Its owner kept it hidden for thirty years and polished it every night.
Found under a loose cobble on the Alinor quay. The cipher is clumsy; the treason is not.
item.skycraft.relic.th_orvanwe_letters.d: Letters in a careful hand, sold to a Windhelm buyer: patrol routes, prisoner lists, and the Emissary's own notes.
item.skycraft.relic.th_talos_amulet.desc: Taken from a hidden shrine near Rorikstead. Its worshippers would call it faith. The Thalmor call it evidence.
item.skycraft.relic.thalmor_dossier.desc: Thalmor notes on an old Blades archivist believed to hide beneath Riften.
item.skycraft.relic.thread_renegade.desc: A black thread carried by a renegade who thought it would protect him. It did not.
item.skycraft.relic.thread_ruin.desc: A black thread from the Daedric ruin of Yansirramus, warm as skin.
item.skycraft.relic.thread_shrine.desc: A black thread that never tangles, taken from Mephala's shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.tong_death_list.desc: Names of Hlaalu loyalists in Balmora, several crossed out. The last name is Nileno Dorvayn's.
item.skycraft.relic.troll_fat_offering.d: A slab of fat cut from a living troll, for Malacath's shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.umbranox_signet.desc: The ring of the Counts of Anvil, missing for decades. The Gray Fox gave it to me to return.
item.skycraft.relic.und_barrow_torc.desc: A twisted band of black iron, cold enough to sting the fingers. The dead king wore it for a few thousand years.
item.skycraft.relic.und_broodmother_fang: A hooked fang as long as a dagger, still beaded with venom. Glirion wants it for the trophy wall.
item.skycraft.relic.und_dreloth_mask.des: A carved bonemold mask from the Dreloth family niche. The grave-robber had already scraped the name off half of it.
item.skycraft.relic.und_malatar_varla.de: An Ayleid star-stone humming with stored light. It pulses brighter whenever it is carried away from the ruin.
item.skycraft.relic.und_mazzatun_idol.de: A squat stone figure with jade eyes, worn smooth by the hands of a people who no longer come to pray.
item.skycraft.relic.und_volenfell_core.d: A Dwemer heart of brass and spinning rings. It is still turning, and it is still warm.
item.skycraft.relic.und_warden_horn.desc: A war-horn of yellowed bone bound in bronze, taken from the deepest hall of Labyrinthian.
item.skycraft.relic.uvirith_spores.desc: A sealed pouch of Telvanni tower spores, ready to be coaxed into a mushroom tower.
item.skycraft.relic.vg_collectors_casket: A lacquered box of Daedric curios. Something inside scratches, very faintly, when no one is looking at it.
item.skycraft.relic.vg_dagon_sigil.desc: A shard of black stone that glows like a coal and never cools. Dug out of the ground beneath Mehrunes Dagon's shrine.
Orders sealed in dark red wax: watch the Hall of the Vigilant, count its keepers, and report when the Keeper travels.
item.skycraft.relic.vilkas_blade.desc: Notched from the training yard. Eorlund will know what to do with it.
item.skycraft.relic.welkynd_stone.desc: A blue crystal cut by Ayleid hands. It hums against the palm with stored light.
item.skycraft.relic.wuuthrad_fragment.de: A shard of Ysgramor's legendary axe, carried home across the sea.
story.skycraft.npc.adamus_phillida.greet: Commander of the Legion in the Heartland, and I have more roads than soldiers. If you can hold a sword and follow an order, we can talk.
story.skycraft.npc.aela.greet: If you've come to stare, the training yard is around back. If you've come to hunt, talk to me.
story.skycraft.npc.agronak_gro_malog.gre: They call me the Gray Prince. The crowd loves the name. I've never been sure what it means, and nobody has ever told me.
story.skycraft.npc.ahzid_at_hel_ra.greet: Cousin Hamaad thinks the past is a fortress. I think it is a tomb. Lovely weather, isn't it?
story.skycraft.npc.alvor.greet: Iron, steel, a bit of leather. If you need it mended, my forge is warm.
story.skycraft.npc.amaund.greet: You are late. Never mind. What I am about to ask has not been asked in four hundred years.
story.skycraft.npc.amiel_lannus.greet: The Priory has been empty for a long time. I kept the lamps lit anyway. Someone had to believe the order would come back.
story.skycraft.npc.ancano.greet: The Thalmor take an interest in the College's work. Purely as advisors, of course.
story.skycraft.npc.ansei_zahreh.greet: The Shehai is not a blade you carry. It is a blade you become. Most who ask me about it are disappointed by that answer.
story.skycraft.npc.aranea.greet: The Lady of Twilight told me you would come. She tells me many things, at dusk and at dawn.
story.skycraft.npc.arelle_vantis.greet: Welcome to the Leyawiin hall. Don't mind the empty benches. The Blackwood Company took the contracts, and the members followed the coin.
story.skycraft.npc.armand_christophe.gre: Easy, friend. On the Waterfront, a man who asks too many questions gets answers from the lake. Ask me the right one.
story.skycraft.npc.arngeir.greet: The Voice is a gift of the gods. We spend our lives learning to use it rightly. Few have the patience.
story.skycraft.npc.astrid.greet: Every family has its rules. Ours are simple: obey, don't betray, and never kill a Brother or Sister.
story.skycraft.npc.athyn_sarethi.greet: Councilor Sarethi. Forgive the bare walls; Redoran spends its coin on swords and grain, not tapestries.
story.skycraft.npc.atub.greet: Largashbur is cursed. Our chief is too proud to ask the Furious One why. I am not.
story.skycraft.npc.aubrec_valmont.greet: A knight of the Rose is courteous to the poor, honest with the powerful and terrible to the wicked. Most days I manage two of the three.
story.skycraft.npc.aventus.greet: Go away. Unless... unless you're the one. Are you the one the Night Mother sent?
story.skycraft.npc.azadhi.greet: Jone and Jode are the two moons, walker. Masser and Secunda, you call them. Their dance tells Khajiit who we are.
story.skycraft.npc.balgruuf.greet: Whiterun stands at the heart of Skyrim, and I intend to keep it standing. What brings you before me?
story.skycraft.npc.bersi.greet: Pottery, fine pottery. And if you break it, you've bought it.
story.skycraft.npc.boethiah_cultist.gree: Boethiah respects only strength, and betrayal is a kind of strength. Have you come to prove yours?
story.skycraft.npc.bolvyn_venim.greet: I am Archmaster of this House. Whatever you want, say it plainly, and do not waste the Archmaster's time.
story.skycraft.npc.borri.greet: (Master Borri says nothing. His eyes go to the courtyard gate, and back to you.)
story.skycraft.npc.brenna_ashfall.greet: Stendarr bids us hunt monsters. He never said they'd all have fangs. Some carry silver and call themselves heroes.
story.skycraft.npc.brother_dranos.greet: I tend the sick, and I read old books, and I ask old questions. Some in the Temple think the last of these is the most dangerous.
story.skycraft.npc.brynjolf.greet: Never done an honest day's work in your life for all that coin you're carrying, eh lass? Or lad. The light's poor.
story.skycraft.npc.burguk_gro_dushnikh.g: Dushnikh Yal does not feed strangers. Strangers feed Dushnikh Yal, or they leave. Which are you?
story.skycraft.npc.burz_gro_khash.greet: Edge on that blade's gone soft. Leave it on the bench, I'll fix it, and you'll listen to me complain while I do.
story.skycraft.npc.canctunian_ponius.gre: The East Empire Company moves the wealth of an Empire, and I move the Company. Keep your hands clean and your ledgers cleaner.
story.skycraft.npc.captain_noraya.greet: I've run cargo past pirates, storms and Imperial tax-men. The tax-men were the worst.
story.skycraft.npc.carcette.greet: Stendarr's mercy is for the lost. His hammer is for the things that lose them. Which have you come about?
story.skycraft.npc.carnius_magius.greet: Factor of Raven Rock. This colony runs on ebony, and the ebony runs through me. Remember that, and we'll get along famously.
story.skycraft.npc.celarus.greet: Every question you ask me has been asked before, usually by someone more patient. Ask anyway. The asking is the lesson.
story.skycraft.npc.celinar.greet: You found Artaeum. Or Artaeum let itself be found by you. That distinction will matter, later.
story.skycraft.npc.cicero.greet: Hello, hello! Cicero tends the Mother. Cicero does not like to be interrupted. Unless it's for a joke!
story.skycraft.npc.corvinus_aelius.greet: Fine silks from the Market District, priced for people who never ask the price. Are you that kind of person?
story.skycraft.npc.corvo_malaxius.greet: Looking to sell something? I'm looking to buy. No questions, no names, and especially no Tong.
story.skycraft.npc.crassius_curio.greet: Oh, a new face! Do come in. I am Councilor Crassius Curio, patron of the arts, friend of the House, and an enthusiastic judge of character. Mostly of the character's calves.
story.skycraft.npc.dalvilu_arethan.greet: Balmora's temple keeps its doors open and its lamps lit. If you are troubled, sit. If you are here to help, there is always more to do.
story.skycraft.npc.dame_maelis_corbel.gr: I train the squires. If you've come to be one, roll up your sleeves. If you've come to watch, there's a bench by the wall.
story.skycraft.npc.dame_orielle_fontaine: Manners first, then the sword. You'd be amazed how many fights end at the manners.
story.skycraft.npc.dar_jazad.greet: Senchal has a hundred smugglers and only one Dar'jazad. The others will cheat you. This one will cheat you honestly.
story.skycraft.npc.deeja.greet: The Hist speaks in sap and dreams. This one listens. Lately, the Hist sounds afraid.
story.skycraft.npc.delphine.greet: Rooms are ten septims. Mead is cheaper. Questions cost more.
story.skycraft.npc.delvin.greet: Business has been terrible since the curse. Not that I believe in curses. Mostly.
story.skycraft.npc.dervenin.greet: My master is on vacation! He's in the head of a dead king, and he won't come out! Help a poor madman?
story.skycraft.npc.dexion.greet: A Moth Priest reads the Elder Scrolls, and pays for it with his eyes. I will pay, if the cause is worth it.
story.skycraft.npc.divayth_fyr.greet: Four thousand years, and visitors still knock as though I might be asleep. I am never asleep. Come in, and touch nothing.
story.skycraft.npc.dulcia_marcanus.greet: Three goats gone this month and a cart burned. If the Guild doesn't help, I'll have nothing left to pay it with.
story.skycraft.npc.dulnea_ralaal.greet: The kwama are restless and something bigger is down there with them. I've been hiding in this side tunnel for a day.
story.skycraft.npc.einarth.greet: (Master Einarth inclines his head, slowly, as if even a nod were a word he must not waste.)
story.skycraft.npc.elenwen.greet: Skyrim is cold, its people are loud, and its gods are wrong. Otherwise it is a perfectly pleasant posting. What do you need?
story.skycraft.npc.elsabet_mornay.greet: Father sits on the King's council. Everyone is very polite to me, and nobody tells me anything.
story.skycraft.npc.eltrys.greet: Not here. Not in the open. Markarth has ears in the stones, and most of them are paid for.
story.skycraft.npc.eno_hlaalu.greet: The Morag Tong is the oldest guild in Morrowind, and the only one the law permits to kill. We do it by writ, in daylight, and we sign our work.
story.skycraft.npc.eola.greet: You look hungry. Not for bread, I think. For something rarer.
story.skycraft.npc.eorlund.greet: The Skyforge was old when the first Companions came. I only keep it fed.
story.skycraft.npc.erandur.greet: Dawnstar dreams badly, and every dream has the same mother. I know her name. I served her once.
story.skycraft.npc.erunor_vaelanwe.greet: You stand straighter than most recruits. Good. The Thalmor notice posture. We notice everything, eventually.
story.skycraft.npc.esbern.greet: Forty years I've been waiting for the world to end. You'll forgive me if I'm not good company.
story.skycraft.npc.ethasi_rilvayn.greet: This hall keeps the writs for the West Gash. If you're here to hire us, state the name. If you're here to join, state your reasons.
story.skycraft.npc.ezhar_at_taneth.greet: Yokuda is under the sea, friend, and the sea is where the money is. Sit down. Have you ever read a bill of lading?
story.skycraft.npc.faendir.greet: Mind your feet. That moss was here before your grandmother's grandmother, and it will be here after you, if you mind your feet.
story.skycraft.npc.falco_galenus.greet: Somebody has to keep the colony's books honest. Apparently that somebody is me, whether I like it or not.
story.skycraft.npc.faleen.greet: The Jarl has no time for you. I'll decide whether he makes some.
story.skycraft.npc.falion.greet: Morthal has little use for a conjurer, and less for questions. Still, you have the look of someone who needs one.
story.skycraft.npc.faralda.greet: The bridge is narrow and the drop is long. State your business with the College.
story.skycraft.npc.farengar.greet: Unless you've brought me a dragon, or something about dragons, I'm rather busy.
story.skycraft.npc.farkas.greet: Vilkas says I talk too much. I don't think so. Do you think so?
story.skycraft.npc.farouz_the_drover.gre: Salt, dyes and Yokudan steel. Everything in these crates is older than the Empire's roads and worth more than its coin.
story.skycraft.npc.feldras_morvayn.greet: A tower is not built, it is persuaded to grow. Bring me patience and spores, and I'll give you a home.
story.skycraft.npc.frea.greet: The All-Maker's stones are sick, and my people walk in their sleep. If you can help, help. If not, stand aside.
story.skycraft.npc.gaius_eruvan.greet: Officially, the Blades were disbanded and there's nobody up here but an old man and some goats. Unofficially, mind your step on the ice.
story.skycraft.npc.galmar.greet: You want to fight for Skyrim? Good. Let's see if you can.
story.skycraft.npc.garrick_vane.greet: I serve the Chancellor. That is all you need to know about me, and more than most people learn.
story.skycraft.npc.geldis.greet: The Retching Netch serves the best sujamma on Solstheim. It's also the only sujamma on Solstheim.
story.skycraft.npc.gerdur.greet: The mill doesn't run itself. But for a friend of my brother's, I can spare a minute.
story.skycraft.npc.ghamrash_gra_shura.gr: Every wall in Orsinium starts as ore in somebody's hands. Usually mine. What have you brought me?
Sit, sit. Nobody joins the Undaunted sober, and nobody leaves this table until the cask is dry or the floor is comfortable.
story.skycraft.npc.gray_fox.greet: You'll forget my face the moment you look away. Don't take it personally. It's an old trick, and not one I chose.
story.skycraft.npc.green_lady.greet: The Silvenar speaks for the people. I hunt for them. If you are here to waste his time, you will find I am quicker than he is.
story.skycraft.npc.gurak.greet: Orsinium has been burned down more times than any city in Tamriel. It is still here. So am I.
story.skycraft.npc.hadoba.greet: The moons are dancing well tonight, walker. This one can always tell. Sit, and let Hadoba see what kind of shadow you cast.
story.skycraft.npc.hadvar.greet: I keep hearing that roar in my sleep. Whatever that thing was, the Legion will need every sword.
story.skycraft.npc.haelga.greet: Dibella blesses all who come to her with an open heart. Or an open purse.
story.skycraft.npc.hamaad_at_hel_ra.gree: My grandfather's grandfather crossed the sea with a sword and the songs of Yokuda. I still have the songs. Have you come to learn them, or to sell me something?
story.skycraft.npc.hannibal_traven.greet: The University is open to anyone with patience and a mind. The first is rarer than you would think.
story.skycraft.npc.harkon.greet: You stand in Castle Volkihar, mortal, and you still have your blood. Consider that a courtesy.
story.skycraft.npc.hestor_aldrinus.greet: Antiquities, curiosities, rarities from every corner of Tamriel. Nothing dangerous, of course. Almost nothing.
story.skycraft.npc.hieronymus_lex.greet: Captain Lex, Imperial Watch. Every theft in this city is a crime against the Emperor, and every unsolved one is a crime against me.
story.skycraft.npc.hlaalu_factor.greet: House Hlaalu deals in everything. Even information. Especially information.
story.skycraft.npc.iachesis.greet: Hm. You arrived exactly when I expected you, which is to say three days late. Sit. Time is a river, and we are about to go fishing.
story.skycraft.npc.ilmaril_senwe.greet: The Crystal Tower has kept the memory of the Aldmer since before the first Bosmer sang the first tree into shape. Do not touch the shelves.
story.skycraft.npc.ilvia_tarn.greet: The Akaviri left us their swords, their walls and their oaths. I keep all three dusted. Mostly the oaths.
story.skycraft.npc.irileth.greet: Keep your hands where I can see them. The Jarl has had enough surprises this year.
story.skycraft.npc.isran.greet: The Vigil of Stendarr failed. The Dawnguard won't. Vampires are getting bolder, and somebody has to be bolder still.
story.skycraft.npc.ivo_brennault.greet: The King is very busy. I am very busy on his behalf. Speak quickly, and beautifully if you can manage it.
story.skycraft.npc.jo_vassa.greet: This one has walked from Rimmen with bad knees and a good heart. Only a little further now. Only a little.
story.skycraft.npc.kaie_briar_mother.gre: The Reach remembers who it belongs to. The stone remembers. The roots remember. Do you?
story.skycraft.npc.karliah.greet: Twenty-five years I've waited for someone to hear the truth. Sit, and listen.
story.skycraft.npc.keerava.greet: The Bee and Barb serves drink and food. Trouble, it does not serve.
story.skycraft.npc.kesh.greet: Kesh tends the Taskmaster's shrine. Kesh is clean. The others? Not so clean.
story.skycraft.npc.klimmek.greet: My knees used to climb that mountain. These days they mostly complain about it.
story.skycraft.npc.kodlak.greet: Jorrvaskr has stood longer than Whiterun's walls. We take work for coin and honor both, and we don't ask which a job pays in.
story.skycraft.npc.lady_yasreen.greet: My father believes the old ways will keep us. I believe they will, if someone is willing to bleed for them.
My family has held Aldcroft for six generations. I mean to hold it for a seventh, if I can get there alive.
story.skycraft.npc.larak_gro_khazgur.gre: Burguk sends a messenger instead of coming himself. That tells me most of what I need to know.
story.skycraft.npc.lucien_lachance.greet: Don't be alarmed. I've been watching you for some time, and I like what I've seen. The Family has an offer for you.
story.skycraft.npc.lucretia_valga.greet: Imperial Commissioner of Charters. Every company in the Empire trades by the Emperor's leave, and I decide how long that leave lasts.
story.skycraft.npc.madanach.greet: So the Silver-Bloods have sent me another one. Sit. The mine has nothing but time, and I have spent a great deal of it waiting for someone useful.
story.skycraft.npc.magister.greet: Alinor welcomes scholars. Barbarians, it merely tolerates. Which are you?
story.skycraft.npc.maj_al_ragath.greet: Glirion sends me his drunks and calls them recruits. Prove me wrong about you, and do it before I finish this cup.
story.skycraft.npc.malborn.greet: I don't know you. Unless Delphine sent you, in which case, keep your voice down.
story.skycraft.npc.mallam_ryon.greet: I speak for the masters of this House, who cannot be bothered to speak for themselves. You may consider that an honour. They would.
story.skycraft.npc.mane.greet: The Mane speaks for the moons and for every Khajiit under them. Speak plainly, and the Mane will listen.
story.skycraft.npc.marcella_tullus.greet: I build walls. Good ones. The trouble is that people keep wanting to knock them down.
story.skycraft.npc.marius_faelian.greet: Imperial goods, Imperial prices, Imperial receipts. I don't deal in anything that isn't on the books.
story.skycraft.npc.master_aryon.greet: Most of my colleagues think the world ends at the edge of their towers. I am trying to persuade them otherwise. It is slow work.
story.skycraft.npc.master_gothren.greet: The Council needs no new voices. The Council needs fewer. Leave my tower while you still have legs.
story.skycraft.npc.maven.greet: If you're here to beg, the Temple of Mara is down the street. If you're here to work, sit down and close your mouth.
story.skycraft.npc.mercer.greet: Brynjolf vouches for you. That buys you a seat at the table. Keeping it is up to you.
story.skycraft.npc.meril_vandas.greet: Give me stone, coin and a season without raiders, and I'll give you a manor the whole West Gash will envy.
story.skycraft.npc.millona_umbranox.gree: Anvil has had a countess and no count for a very long time. I have grown used to answering for both.
story.skycraft.npc.mirabelle.greet: If you've lost your way, I can point you. If you've broken something, I'd rather know now.
story.skycraft.npc.mistress_dratha.greet: Stand further back. Further. There. Men are tolerable at a distance, and you are not yet tolerable.
story.skycraft.npc.modryn_oreyn.greet: I've buried more contracts than most men have signed. Ask your question and I'll tell you whether it'll get you killed.
story.skycraft.npc.murbul.greet: Malacath watches the stronghold through my eyes. Today they are tired eyes, so speak plainly.
story.skycraft.npc.nazir.greet: Contracts, coin and corpses. In that order, if we're lucky.
story.skycraft.npc.nelkir.greet: There's a door in the cellar that whispers. It tells me things about my father. Want to know what it says?
story.skycraft.npc.neloth.greet: If you're here to waste my time, do it efficiently. If not, you may be useful.
story.skycraft.npc.neminda.greet: House Redoran asks three things of its people: duty, honor and endurance. The ash will test the third. I will test the other two.
story.skycraft.npc.nibani_maesa.greet: The ancestors whisper about strangers before they arrive. They were whispering about you this morning. Sit by the fire.
story.skycraft.npc.nileno_dorvayn.greet: House Hlaalu does not ask where you were born, only what you can do and what it costs. Sit. Let us discuss the second part first.
story.skycraft.npc.njada_stonearm.greet: The whelps in Jorrvaskr fight with their mouths. I fight with a shield. Guess which of us gets more work.
story.skycraft.npc.ocheeva.greet: The Sanctuary is your home now. Eat, sleep, train. When there is work, Vicente will tell you. When there is trouble, I will.
story.skycraft.npc.odric_hollenmoor.gree: Daggerfall has been burned, besieged and betrayed, and the Dragon has stood at its gate through all of it. Kneel or stand as you like. Just don't waste my time.
story.skycraft.npc.old_huzail.greet: The harbour talks, if you know how to listen. It talks louder for a coin or two.
story.skycraft.npc.old_tamsin.greet: A septim for an old woman? Or a crust. Or a kind word. I'm not choosy, dear, I'm only hungry.
story.skycraft.npc.orvas_dren.greet: My brother sits in the Duke's chair in Ebonheart and smiles at Imperials. I grow saltrice and keep the Tong fed. One of us is honest about what Morrowind needs.
story.skycraft.npc.owyn.greet: Blademaster of the Arena. I don't care where you're from or what you did before. On the sand, all I care about is whether you're still standing.
story.skycraft.npc.primate_artorius.gree: The Temple of the One welcomes every soul, the faithful and the merely tired alike. Sit, if you need to. The Nine are patient.
story.skycraft.npc.prophet_of_anvil.gree: They laugh at me in the street. Let them. Something old is waking under the Heartland, and the Nine have no knights left to meet it.
story.skycraft.npc.quaranir.greet: You've noticed me. Good. The Psijic Order watches; it seldom speaks. Today it speaks to you.
story.skycraft.npc.ra_khaj.greet: If you are here to question this one again, he still knows nothing. If you are here for something else, please be quick.
story.skycraft.npc.ralof.greet: Gerdur's cooking, a roof, and a dragon somewhere to the north. Talos keep us, what a day.
story.skycraft.npc.raminus_polus.greet: Master of Initiates. Which means I read your recommendation letters, and I find out which of them were exaggerated.
story.skycraft.npc.ranabi_erabenimsun.gr: Gulakhan of the Erabenimsun. Urshilaku friend, are you? Then you're a long way from friends.
story.skycraft.npc.rawan_dar.greet: Rawan-dar sells spice, silk, and absolutely no opinions about politics. None. Would you like some silk?
story.skycraft.npc.razum_dar.greet: Raz is only a humble envoy of the Queen. Humble, handsome, and listening to everything you say. Sit, sit.
story.skycraft.npc.redoran_warden.greet: House Redoran keeps the ash at bay. Duty first. Speak quickly.
story.skycraft.npc.rikke.greet: Skyrim is my home too, whatever Ulfric says. The Legion is how we keep it whole.
story.skycraft.npc.rolan_dufresne.greet: Camlorn sends its best to the lists every year, and every year Daggerfall pretends to be surprised when we win.
story.skycraft.npc.sabine_larrenne.greet: I study the Dwarves. Mostly that means I study the inside of locked crates and the outside of my purse.
story.skycraft.npc.sabjorn.greet: Honningbrew mead, best in the hold. Or it will be, once I get rid of these skeevers.
story.skycraft.npc.sam.greet: A drinking contest! Win, and I'll give you a staff that'll make you famous. Lose, and you buy.
story.skycraft.npc.savlian.greet: Kvatch was burned once, in the Oblivion Crisis. We rebuilt it. Now there's a gate in the hills again, and nobody wants to say it out loud.
story.skycraft.npc.savos_aren.greet: The College is a place of learning. I'd like it to remain one, whatever the Jarl and the townsfolk think of us.
story.skycraft.npc.sedrisa_vandu.greet: Half the village is coughing ash and the other half is too frightened to come near them. I'm running out of everything.
story.skycraft.npc.sees_behind_eyes.gree: You hatched under the Shadow, little one. I smelled it on you before you reached the door. Come in out of the light.
story.skycraft.npc.septimus.greet: The box, the lock, the heart within... Hm? A visitor. How dreadfully interruptive.
story.skycraft.npc.serana.greet: I've been asleep a long time. Tell me the world hasn't changed too much. Actually, don't.
story.skycraft.npc.shazrah.greet: Welcome to the camp of the Laughing Blades, walker. We laugh because the nobles have taken everything else. Why are you here?
story.skycraft.npc.shishara_assemanu.gre: Guar hides, kwama eggs, trama root. Honest goods, honest prices. Don't haggle like a Hlaalu and we'll get along.
story.skycraft.npc.sigrun_frost_hand.gre: Rorikstead grows good grain and minds its own business. I'd thank you to do the same, elf.
story.skycraft.npc.sigrun_pelt_trader.gr: If you're here to buy, I've nothing left. They took the furs. They took everything.
story.skycraft.npc.silus.greet: Welcome to the Museum of the Mythic Dawn! Mind the robes; some of them are original.
story.skycraft.npc.silvenar.greet: I am the voice of the Bosmer. All of them, at once, which is louder than you might think. Speak, and I will hear how the forest answers.
story.skycraft.npc.sinding.greet: Don't look at me like that. I'm locked up for a reason, and I'm not proud of it.
story.skycraft.npc.sister_ilara.greet: Mara's chapel is full and the sick keep coming. If you are well, roll up your sleeves. If you are sick, lie down. Either way, welcome.
story.skycraft.npc.skjor.greet: Keep your blade sharp and your questions short.
story.skycraft.npc.skrivva.greet: This one keeps the Guild's business in Bravil. Speak softly. The walls here are thin and the guards are thick.
story.skycraft.npc.sovor_trandel.greet: This is the Council Club. Morrowind for the Dunmer, and the Dunmer for the Tong. If you're an outlander, the door is behind you.
story.skycraft.npc.spinner.greet: The Green Pact binds us: we do not cut the living wood, and we eat only flesh. Most outsiders find the second part harder.
story.skycraft.npc.storn.greet: I am the shaman of the Skaal. The wind has gone strange, and the stones cry out in a voice I don't know.
story.skycraft.npc.sul_matuul.greet: I am Ashkhan of the Urshilaku. Outlanders come here to buy, or to steal, or to preach. Which are you?
story.skycraft.npc.tah_weesh.greet: Speak softly near the hatchery. The eggs listen, and the ones that are left are frightened.
story.skycraft.npc.tavia_orrin.greet: I'm a farmer. I grow apples. Whatever you think I used to be, I'm not that any more.
story.skycraft.npc.teeba_enoo.greet: The King of Argonia sends his regards, and occasionally his lists. Today I carry a list.
story.skycraft.npc.teekeeus.greet: Chorrol's chapter keeps a fine library, if one ignores the scorch marks. Mind the shelves. They bite. Well. One of them does.
story.skycraft.npc.telanil_orvanwe.greet: Another fresh face from home. Have a drink. The Emissary's wine is the only thing in this province that isn't trying to kill us.
story.skycraft.npc.tharen.greet: The Tribunal walked among us once. Now we keep their temples, and the mountain keeps its secrets.
story.skycraft.npc.tholer_saryoni.greet: The High Fane is open to every pilgrim. The Three are watching over Vvardenfell, even when Vvardenfell forgets to look up.
story.skycraft.npc.thonar_silver_blood.g: My family owns the mine, the inn, the smelter and a good number of the guards. Keep that in mind while you speak.
story.skycraft.npc.tirvel_sadrano.greet: Ebony, raw and honest, straight out of the hill. Well. Straight out of the hill, anyway.
story.skycraft.npc.tolfdir.greet: Ah, a student! Or are you a visitor? Either way, there is always time for a lesson on wards.
story.skycraft.npc.tullius.greet: I have a war to win and a province full of people who'd rather I lost it. Make it quick.
story.skycraft.npc.tyranus.greet: There is something foul in that house. I can smell it. Help me cleanse it.
story.skycraft.npc.ulfric.greet: Skyrim belongs to the Nords. Speak, if you have something worth my time.
story.skycraft.npc.urag.greet: This is the Arcanaeum. Touch the books with clean hands and don't eat near them.
story.skycraft.npc.urgarlag_chief_bane.g: I killed a chief who deserved it and left a stronghold that didn't. Now I kill things in the dark for fun. You look like you might keep up.
story.skycraft.npc.varvur_sarethi.greet: They say I killed a man. I didn't. But nobody listens to the accused, only to the accuser.
story.skycraft.npc.vex.greet: Don't touch anything. And don't talk to me unless it's about money.
story.skycraft.npc.viarmo.greet: Welcome to the Bards College, the oldest school of song in Skyrim. Mind the lute strings; they bite.
story.skycraft.npc.vicente_valtieri.gree: Forgive me if I don't offer my hand. It's cold, and I've learned that guests find it unsettling. Contracts, my friend, are my department.
story.skycraft.npc.vilena_donton.greet: The Guild takes honest coin for honest steel. If you want the other kind, the Blackwood Company is hiring, and I'll thank you not to come back.
story.skycraft.npc.vilkas.greet: Another hopeful. Everyone wants to be a Companion until they learn what it costs.
story.skycraft.npc.viranus_donton.greet: Mother thinks I'm still twelve. I'm not. I can hold a shield as well as anyone in this hall.
story.skycraft.npc.wades_in_reeds.greet: The marsh remembers everything, dry-skin. Even the things the city would rather forget.
story.skycraft.npc.weighs_the_coin.greet: Another Shadow-born. Welcome. Keep your contracts close and your purse closer. I say it to everyone. Hardly anyone listens.
story.skycraft.npc.wulfgar.greet: (Master Wulfgar breathes out through his nose, and the candle beside him gutters.)
story.skycraft.npc.yasmin.greet: In Hammerfell, a sword is a prayer. Most people pray badly.
story.skycraft.q.ad_beneath_the_veil.des: The cipher led Razum-dar to a Veiled Heritance meeting place in the hills west of Firsthold. He wants their masked leader stopped.
Under the silk mask was Lord Varandil, a councillor of Firsthold. He spat that the Queen had sold her birthright to beasts. Then he stopped saying anything.
Unmask the leader of the cell
Raz suspected. Raz hoped to be wrong.
The Silk Mask was Lord Varandil.
Some of his followers surrendered. They deserve a trial.
A trial. Yes, the Queen would like that. Raz will see they get one, and Raz will see it is public. Let Auridon hear what they believed.
Hang the rest quietly. Fear will finish the job.
Hm. Effective. Also exactly what the Veiled Heritance would do. Raz will think about it. Raz will think very hard.
story.skycraft.q.ad_beneath_the_veil.out: I unmasked the leader of a Veiled Heritance cell: Lord Varandil of Firsthold. The conspiracy is wounded, though Razum-dar doubts it is dead.
story.skycraft.q.ad_beneath_the_veil.pit: Raz broke it over breakfast. The Veiled Heritance meets in an old cellar in the hills west of here, and the man who leads them wears a silk mask and a very expensive ring. Go in. Bring Raz the ring, with or without the finger.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.desc: Maormer raiders from Pyandonea have landed on the Auridon shore near Vulkhel Guard. Razum-dar thinks the Veiled Heritance told them where the patrols would not be.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o0.reply: Sea Vipers on the west shore, burning boats at Vulkhel Guard. Somebody told them the patrol was moved. Raz would like to know who, but first Raz would like the Maormer dead.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o2.text: Drive the Maormer raiders back into the sea
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o3.journa: Captain Orilith called a wave onto the beach that took two of the town's boats with it. The third wave she called never came.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o5.reply: Raz will hang it in the hall, upside down. The Maormer find that very rude. Now, you are going on a long trip. Raz hopes you like trees.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o5.text: Bring the banner to Razum-dar in Firsthold
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.o5.topic: The raid is broken. Here's their flag.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.outro: I broke a Maormer raid on Vulkhel Guard and took the Sea Vipers' war-banner. Razum-dar says my next task lies far from Summerset.
story.skycraft.q.ad_sea_vipers.title: Sails off Vulkhel Guard
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.de: Altmer, Bosmer and Khajiit will gather at the Crystal Tower to seal the Aldmeri Dominion before Queen Ayrenn. Sapiarch Ilmaril Senwe will keep the rite, and Razum-dar is certain the Veiled Heritance will not let the day pass quietly.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.o0: You are here to stand in the right place and say nothing until spoken to. The rite is old and the Sapiarchs are older. Go to the Tower and wait by the eastern stair.
Speak with Sapiarch Ilmaril Senwe in Alinor
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.o2: Stop the Veiled Heritance assassins at the stair
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.o3: The Veiled Hand had been a Sapiarch's acolyte. He had studied the Tower's stairs for years. He never thought someone might wait on them.
Kill the Veiled Heritance's last master
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.o4: Then stand where I told you, and this time, kneel when the Queen looks at you.
Return to the Sapiarch for the ceremony
The stair is clear. The ceremony can begin.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_crystal_tower.ou: I stopped the Veiled Heritance's last strike at the Crystal Tower. Before the gathered peoples of the Dominion, Queen Ayrenn named me her Hand.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_manes_blessing.d: With Valenwood bound to the Dominion, Queen Ayrenn wants Elsweyr's blessing as well. I am to carry her gift to the Mane in Riverhold.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_manes_blessing.o: A spoon for moon sugar, made by people who do not eat it. The Mane understands the meaning. But gifts are words. The Mane would see a deed.
Present the Queen's gift to the Mane
Queen Ayrenn sends this, with her respect.
Raiders from the Ebonheart Pact are burning sugar caravans on the road west of the city. Nords and Dunmer, far from home and very hungry. Make them less hungry, forever.
Ask what deed the Mane requires
Destroy the Pact raiders on the caravan road
Then the caravans will sing your name in their own way, which is mostly about the price of sugar. Tell your Queen: Elsweyr stands with the Dominion. The Mane will come to the Crystal Tower.
I carried Queen Ayrenn's gift to the Mane and cleared Pact raiders from the caravan road. Elsweyr has pledged to the Dominion, and the Mane will attend the ceremony at the Crystal Tower.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.desc: Razum-dar, a Khajiit who calls himself Queen Ayrenn's humble envoy, asked me to watch the Firsthold docks for a conspirator passing messages against the Queen.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.o1.j: The messenger tried to throw his tablet into the harbor. He threw it poorly.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.o1.t: Stop the messenger before he slips away
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.o3.r: Ah. The Veiled Heritance. Raz hoped it was only smugglers. Smugglers you can bargain with. Welcome to the Queen's service, friend. Raz will try not to get you killed.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.offe: I want to serve the Dominion.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.outr: I caught a Veiled Heritance messenger on the Firsthold docks and gave his cipher to Razum-dar, who welcomed me into Queen Ayrenn's service.
story.skycraft.q.ad_the_queens_eyes.pitc: Good, good. Raz has a small problem with large teeth. Someone on the Firsthold docks is passing messages to people who hate the Queen. Raz cannot be seen watching the docks; everyone knows Raz. You, nobody knows. Yet.
Razum-dar has given me a treaty to carry to Elden Root in Valenwood. The Green Pact must agree to it, and spies of the Daggerfall Covenant would very much prefer that it never arrive.
Carry the treaty to Elden Root
On hide, not paper. Someone in Summerset was listening, for once. But the Green does not sign for the Queen. It signs for the one who carries the treaty. Tell me why you carry it.
I bring a treaty from Queen Ayrenn.
Because Summerset needs the forest more than the forest needs Summerset.
True, and rarely said aloud by an outsider. The Green will remember that you said it.
Because divided, all of us fall to the Covenant and the Pact.
A soldier's reason. Not wrong. The Green has buried a great many soldiers and kept their songs.
It is sung, which is better. Go carefully. There are Bretons in the trees who were very interested in this treaty.
Hand the treaty to the Spinner
The Covenant spies carried a copy of my route, written in a Firsthold hand. Somebody in the Queen's own city is still talking.
Ambush the Covenant spies on the road
Spinner Aerfin sang Valenwood's assent to Queen Ayrenn's treaty, and I killed the Covenant spies who had been waiting to stop it.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.desc: Owyn has put me in a beast match against a pair of wolves and a senche tiger from Elsweyr.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.o2.reply: Ha! The traders will want to sell us another. Bloodletter, that's your rank now. Go and get your arm looked at.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.o2.topic: That cat was worth every septim.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.outro: I won the beast match against two wolves and a senche, and rose to the rank of Bloodletter.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.pitch: The crowd's bored of people. Today it's beasts: a pair of wolves from the Great Forest, and a senche the Elsweyr traders sold us at a scandalous price. Kill the wolves fast; save your strength for the cat.
story.skycraft.q.ar_beast_match.title: The Beast Match
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.de: Owyn, the Blademaster of the Imperial Arena, will put me on the Arena's roster if I win my first bout as a Pit Dog against a dockside brawler named Fennick Sallow.
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.o0: Step out onto the Arena sand
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.o2: So he is. The crowd liked you. Don't let it go to your head; they like everybody who wins. Welcome to the Arena, Pit Dog.
Report to Owyn in the Bloodworks
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.of: I want to fight in the Arena.
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.ou: I won my first bout in the Imperial Arena and joined the roster as a Pit Dog.
story.skycraft.q.ar_blood_on_the_sand.pi: Everybody wants to fight in the Arena until the gate opens. Sign this, take a Pit Dog's raiment, and walk out onto the sand. Your first match is against Fennick Sallow, a brawler from the docks. Win, and you're on the roster.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.desc: Owyn matched me against the Hallon twins, a pair of gladiators who have never lost fighting together.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.o1.rep: First time for everything. You're a Brawler now. The purse goes up, and so does the quality of the people trying to kill you.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.o1.top: The twins have lost a doubles match now.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.outro: I beat the Hallon twins and rose to the rank of Brawler.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.pitch: Two on one this time. The Hallon twins fight as a pair and they've never lost a doubles match. Keep your back to the wall and don't let them circle you.
story.skycraft.q.ar_brawlers_bout.title: The Brawler's Bout
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.desc: The whole Imperial City has turned out for the final bout: the Gray Prince against the challenger. Agronak asked me to fight him honestly, to the end.
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.o0.te: Walk out onto the sand for the final bout
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.o1.te: Defeat Agronak gro-Malog, the Gray Prince
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.o2.re: It is. He went down the way he wanted, with the crowd on its feet. The title is yours, Grand Champion. Wear it better than the last man who wore it alone.
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.outro: I defeated Agronak gro-Malog in the final bout and became Grand Champion of the Imperial Arena.
story.skycraft.q.ar_grand_champion.title: The Grand Champion
story.skycraft.q.ar_gray_princes_blood.d: Agronak gro-Malog, the Gray Prince, asked me to visit the ruined estate of Lord Lovidicus, the noble his mother named as his father, and find out the truth about his blood.
story.skycraft.q.ar_gray_princes_blood.o: Travel to the ruins of the Lovidicus estate
Deal with what has made its nest in the ruins
The journal made it plain. Lord Lovidicus was a vampire, and the orc woman he kept in his household bore him a son. The Gray Prince.
Give it here. ...No. No, that can't... Stay. Hear this from me, not from the gossips.
I found your father's journal. You should read it yourself.
Ysabel Andronicus had held the Champion's place for three seasons. She fought cleanly and lost cleanly, and the crowd chanted her name as she was carried out.
Win the Champion's bout against Ysabel Andronicus
He told me. He looks like a man who's already decided how it ends. You're Champion now. Only the Gray Prince stands above you.
Ysabel's down. Agronak says he wants the final match.
Owyn says you wanted to see me.
I learned that the Gray Prince is the son of a vampire lord, and won the Champion's bout. Agronak has asked for the final match, and asked me not to hold back.
story.skycraft.q.ar_gray_princes_blood.p: I did. You travel. I don't; the Arena owns my days. My mother said my father was a lord of Cyrodiil, and before she died she gave me a name: Lovidicus. His estate is a ruin near the Gold Road. Go there. Find out who he was. Then come back and fight for Champion.
Owyn put me in against two ogres from the Jerall Mountains.
Gladiator. You've earned the title the hard way. Agronak wants to talk to you, privately. I'd go. He doesn't ask twice.
I killed two ogres in the Arena and was named Gladiator. Agronak gro-Malog, the Grand Champion, wants to speak with me.
Two ogres, bought from a caravan out of the Jerall. They're slow, they're stupid, and either one could flatten a horse. Don't stand where they can grab you.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.desc: Owyn matched me against a minotaur from the Nibenay hills that killed four of its handlers on the way to the Arena.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.o0.jour: The minotaur charged three times. The third time it didn't get up again. The stands were so loud I couldn't hear my own heart.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.o1.repl: They usually are about you, it seems. Warrior. And the Grand Champion asked who you were today. That's never happened before.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.outro: I killed the minotaur on the sand and rose to the rank of Warrior. The Grand Champion has started asking about me.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.pitch: A minotaur, caught in the hills above the Nibenay. It killed four handlers on the way here. The odds-makers have you losing, which means the purse is very good if you don't.
story.skycraft.q.ar_the_minotaur.title: The Minotaur
story.skycraft.q.ar_three_against_one.de: The rival Blue Team has challenged our side with three gladiators against one. Owyn put me forward.
story.skycraft.q.ar_three_against_one.o0: Defeat the three Blue Team gladiators
story.skycraft.q.ar_three_against_one.o1: And the Yellow Team gets bragging rights for a season. Myrmidon. You're climbing fast. People are starting to say your name in the stands.
The Blue Team needs three new gladiators.
story.skycraft.q.ar_three_against_one.ou: I defeated three Blue Team gladiators alone and rose to the rank of Myrmidon.
story.skycraft.q.ar_three_against_one.pi: Careful what you ask for. The Blue Team has put up three of their best against one of ours. That's you. They fight like a phalanx: shields up, spears out. Break the line and they break with it.
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.desc: Ash creatures driven by the mountain's dreams have come down on the Urshilaku camp. Sul-Matuul will need every spear, and after the fight, the clan will gather by the fire.
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.o1.text: Defend the camp from the ash creatures
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.o2.text: Kill the Ash Ghoul leading them
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.o3.reply: Safe because of you. Stay. The clan has something to say.
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.o3.text: Sit by the fire with Sul-Matuul
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.outro: I defended the Urshilaku camp from the mountain's creatures. Sul-Matuul and the clan named me Ashkhan-to-be, the first outlander so honored.
story.skycraft.q.ash_ashkhan.title: Ashkhan
story.skycraft.q.ash_blood_between_clans: The Erabenimsun clan has been raiding Urshilaku herds. Sul-Matuul wants the feud ended and has sent me to deal with Ranabi, the Erabenimsun Gulakhan.
Travel to the Erabenimsun camp
Does he? The Urshilaku have fat herds and we have ash. If he wants peace, he can pay for it. Or you can prove the Urshilaku have teeth.
Speak with Ranabi
Sul-Matuul wants an end to the raids.
Then let your best hunter face me, and the winner sets the terms.
Ha! Bold. Very well. But my young hotbloods won't wait for a fair fight. Watch your back.
The Urshilaku will share their grazing in the dry season, in exchange for peace.
Shared grazing? That's more than we'd win by raiding. Agreed. But some of my young bloods won't like it.
Choose how to end the feud
Three young hunters came at me rather than accept Ranabi's word. Ranabi watched, and when it was over he nodded, as if that settled everything. It did.
Erabenimsun Hotblood
Fight off the young Erabenimsun raiders who reject the terms
No more? I have waited ten years to hear that. You have done the Urshilaku a great service, clanfriend.
Report to Sul-Matuul
The Erabenimsun will raid no more.
You look troubled, Ashkhan.
I ended the feud between the Urshilaku and the Erabenimsun.

The Erabenimsun have taken guar from our herds again. They are a hard clan with a cruel Ashkhan, but blood between clans helps no one but the mountain. Go to their camp. Speak with Ranabi, their Gulakhan. End this, one way or another.
Blood Between Clans
story.skycraft.q.ash_dream_of_the_mounta: Nibani Maesa says the ancestors want to speak to me directly, on the slopes of Red Mountain under the night sky.
Climb to the slopes of Red Mountain
Drive off the ash creatures drawn by the dreaming
Gather ash from the dreaming place
Then that is your path. I will burn this ash on the fire tonight and the whole camp will dream your vision. Go to Sul-Matuul in the morning.
Tell Nibani Maesa what the ancestors said
They told me to keep the clans together.
The ancestors spoke to you about me?
On the slopes of Red Mountain, the ancestors spoke to me: the clans must stand together, or the ash will bury them.
They want to speak to you themselves. Go to the slopes of Red Mountain at night, to the place where the ash lies smooth as water. Wait there. Something will come. Some of it will want to kill you.
story.skycraft.q.ash_gift_for_the_wise_w: Nibani Maesa, wise woman of the Urshilaku, asked for a bull netch hide for a new spirit drum. In return she will read my future.
Flawless. The drum will speak well. Now sit, and let me read you.
Bring the hide to Nibani Maesa
A bull netch hide, as you asked.
I want to learn your ways, not change them.
A good answer. The ancestors approve. Most outlanders say they want to learn and mean they want to buy.
I came for adventure. I stayed for the people.
Honest. The ancestors like honest. They also like it when you bring meat.
What would honor the wise woman of the Urshilaku?
I brought Nibani Maesa a bull netch hide. She read my shadow by the fire and seemed amused by what she saw.

Honor. Such a big word for a small thing. I would like a bull netch hide, a good one, for a new spirit drum. The netch drift in the bitter coast winds to the south. Bring me one, and I will read your shadow for you.
A Gift for the Wise Woman
story.skycraft.q.ash_outlanders_hunt.des: Shishara Assemanu, an Ashlander trader outside Ald'ruhn, told me the Urshilaku clan might accept an outlander who hunts for them: kagouti for meat, cliff racers for peace.
So the hunters told me. An outlander who brings meat and asks for nothing. Rare as rain. Sit at our fire, then, clanfriend.
Speak with Sul-Matuul, Ashkhan of the Urshilaku
I've hunted kagouti and cliff racers for your camp.
story.skycraft.q.ash_outlanders_hunt.off: How does an outlander earn the clans' trust?
story.skycraft.q.ash_outlanders_hunt.out: I hunted for the Urshilaku and Sul-Matuul welcomed me to the clan's fire as an outlander friend.
story.skycraft.q.ash_outlanders_hunt.pit: By being useful, the same as anyone. The Urshilaku camp in the north is short of meat and long on cliff racers. Go and hunt for them. Kill kagouti, kill racers, then show your face to Sul-Matuul. He'll decide if you're a friend.
story.skycraft.q.ash_robbed_ancestors.de: Grave robbers have broken into the Urshilaku burial caverns and taken the death-masks of the ancestors. The angry dead are walking, and Nibani Maesa has begged me to set things right.
story.skycraft.q.ash_robbed_ancestors.o0: Travel to the Urshilaku burial caverns
story.skycraft.q.ash_robbed_ancestors.o2: Put the restless ancestors back to rest
story.skycraft.q.ash_robbed_ancestors.o4: The mask of Hassour the Elder, who led the clan through the great ash fall. You've brought him home. The ancestors won't forget this. Neither will I.
Return the death-mask to Nibani Maesa
The robbers are dead and the ancestors are quiet. This was taken.
story.skycraft.q.ash_robbed_ancestors.ou: I recovered the stolen death-masks from the Urshilaku burial caverns and laid the restless ancestors back to rest.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.desc: Finn's lute lies in Dead Crone Rock, in the Forsworn-held hills of the Reach.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.o2.rep: Still in tune! Finn built well.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.o2.tex: Bring the lute to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.pitch: Finn's lute. A student took it into the Reach, to Dead Crone Rock. The Forsworn live there. Be careful.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.title: Finn's Lute
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.des: Pantea Ateia's flute was lost in Ilinalta's Deep, a drowned fort on Lake Ilinalta.
She'll weep, and then she'll play. Thank you.
Bring the flute to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.off: Do you have any work for a bard?
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.pit: Pantea lent her flute to an apprentice who took it to Ilinalta's Deep, on the lake. He never came back. The flute should.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.desc: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt, a ruin in the Reach overrun by hagravens.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.o2.re: All three instruments, home at last. The College owes you more than I can pay, but here's what I can.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.o2.te: Bring the drum to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.pitch: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt. Hagravens. I'd go myself if I weren't a coward.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.title: Rjorn's Drum
story.skycraft.q.bards_tending_the_flame: Viarmo, headmaster of the Bards College, wants King Olaf's lost verse from Dead Men's Respite, to win back the city's festival and give me my place at the College.
Take King Olaf's verse from his tomb
Half rotten and half in riddles. Perfect. I'll write the rest myself, and the Jarl will have her festival. Welcome to the College, bard.
King Olaf's verse. I have it.
How do I join the Bards College?
We'd need a reason to let you in. Here's one: the King Olaf's Fire festival is banned, unless I can show the Jarl the lost Edda of King Olaf. It's said to lie in Dead Men's Respite. Bring it back.
story.skycraft.q.bl_blade_of_pale_pass.d: Ilvia Tarn sent me to Pale Pass, the Akaviri fortress high in the Jerall Mountains, to recover a Dragonguard katana from the dead who still guard it.
story.skycraft.q.bl_blade_of_pale_pass.o: Fight through the frozen dead of Pale Pass
Defeat the ghost of the Dragonguard commander
Look at the steel. Nearly two thousand years in the ice and not a fleck of rust. It's yours now. Carry it the way they did.
Bring the katana to Ilvia Tarn
The ghost let me take it, once I'd earned it.
Is there anything left of the Dragonguard at Pale Pass?
I recovered a Dragonguard katana from Pale Pass. Ilvia had it polished and bound, and returned it to me as a Blade's sword.
story.skycraft.q.bl_blade_of_pale_pass.p: More than anyone admits. The old fort is full of frost and restless dead, and in its heart lies a Dragonguard blade no Blade has carried since the order was young. Bring it home. A Blade should carry a true Akaviri sword.
story.skycraft.q.bl_dragonguard_legacy.d: Ilvia Tarn, Cloud Ruler's archivist, insists every new Blade learns where the order came from before learning anything else.
story.skycraft.q.bl_dragonguard_legacy.o: Then a question to start. When the Akaviri came over the Jerall and Reman Cyrodiil met them at Pale Pass, what turned a war into an oath?
Speak with Ilvia Tarn in the archive
Eruvan says you're to teach me.
Exactly. They had come hunting dragons and found a man with the blood of one. They knelt, and their swords became his guard. That is where we begin.
Reman paid them better than their own lords.
A soldier's guess, and wrong. They saw the dragon in his blood and swore to him. Gold never bought the Dragonguard. Remember that.
Study the Akaviri records with Ilvia
Good. Now you know why the Thalmor fear us and why dragons should. Go and see the Captain. He has real work for you.
Ilvia Tarn taught me the history of the Blades, from the Akaviri Dragonguard at Pale Pass to the order's long years of service.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.desc: Captain Gaius Eruvan, who keeps Cloud Ruler Temple above Bruma, hinted that the Blades still exist. To earn an invitation, I must clear the trolls that killed his couriers on the mountain road.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.o0.text: Kill the trolls on the road to Cloud Ruler Temple
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.o2.reply: He was a good lad. Thank you for bringing it home. Come inside. It's time you heard the oath.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.o2.text: Bring the token to Gaius Eruvan at Cloud Ruler Temple
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.o2.topic: The trolls are dead. Your courier carried this.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.offer: People in Bruma say you're more than a retired soldier.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.outro: I swore the old oath of the Blades at Cloud Ruler Temple. The order is small and hidden, but it is not gone.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.pitch: People in Bruma talk too much. But you're no Thalmor, I can see that much. There's a troll pack on the road to the temple that's killed two of our couriers. Clear it, bring back this token from the courier's satchel, and I'll show you what Cloud Ruler still is.
story.skycraft.q.bl_invitation.title: An Invitation to Cloud Ruler
story.skycraft.q.bl_justiciars_in_the_sn: Thalmor Justiciars are hunting a former Blade, Tavia Orrin, who lives quietly at Applewatch west of Bruma. Captain Eruvan sent me to save her.
Kill the Thalmor agents surrounding the farm
The Justiciar carried a dossier with Tavia's name on it, and a dozen more. Some of those names were struck through already.
Bring Tavia Orrin to Cloud Ruler Temple
Then we've got their list, and they've lost their hunter. I'll send warnings to the ones still living. Tavia stays here. Gods, it's good to see her.
Tavia is safe. The Justiciar carried a list of every Blade they know about.
Ilvia says you have something for me.
I killed a Thalmor Justiciar at Applewatch and brought Tavia Orrin to Cloud Ruler, along with the Dominion's list of hunted Blades.

Tavia Orrin served with me for twenty years. Now she grows apples at Applewatch, and the Thalmor have found her. Justiciars are on the road. Get there first, and bring her here where the walls are thick.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.desc: A letter has come from Skyrim, from Delphine and Esbern: dragons are returning. Captain Eruvan wants the old sky-watch at Dragonclaw Rock manned, and a dragon was seen circling it already.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o0.reply: From Delphine and old Esbern, both. Listen.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o1.text: Climb to the sky-watch at Dragonclaw Rock
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o2.journal: The dragon came down out of the cloud like a falling house. Esbern's advice was sound. I took the wing first.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o2.text: Slay the dragon circling Dragonclaw Rock
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o3.reply: A Blade killing a dragon in the Jerall. It hasn't happened since the Dragonguard came over the mountains. Then let's do it properly, and light the watch again.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.o3.topic: The dragon at Dragonclaw Rock is dead.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.outro: I killed a dragon at Dragonclaw Rock, the old sky-watch above Bruma. Captain Eruvan means to restore the full watch.
story.skycraft.q.bl_sky_watch.title: Watchers of the Sky
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.desc: Captain Eruvan wants the beacon on Dragonclaw Rock lit again for the first time in two hundred years. The Thalmor will see it too, and they have sent a strike team to stop it.
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.o0.te: Relight the sky-watch beacon on Dragonclaw Rock
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.o1.te: Hold the beacon against the Thalmor strike team
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.o2.te: Kill the Thalmor commander, Justiciar Taarion
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.o3.re: Look at it burn. Every Blade still alive in Cyrodiil will see that, and know where to come. You did this. From tonight, you're Knight-Commander of Cloud Ruler.
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.o3.to: The beacon is lit, and the Thalmor are dead.
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.outro: The sky-watch beacon burns again on Dragonclaw Rock. Captain Eruvan named me Knight-Commander, and scattered Blades have begun to find their way back.
story.skycraft.q.bl_watch_restored.title: The Watch Restored
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.desc: Ancano has taken control of the Eye of Magnus. Wild magic is tearing through the College and the town of Winterhold.
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.o0.text: Return to the College of Winterhold
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.o2.repl: Savos... Savos is dead. Ancano did this. If you have found where the Staff of Magnus lies, go now. Nothing else can stop that Eye.
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.title: Containment
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.desc: With the Staff of Magnus I can drain the Eye's power and break Ancano's hold on it.
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.o2.re: The Order will take it, to a place where it will harm no one. Go and speak to Tolfdir. The College needs a new Arch-Mage, and I believe it has one.
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.o2.to: Ancano is dead. What about the Eye?
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.title: The Eye of Magnus
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.desc: Faralda let me across the bridge to the College of Winterhold. The Master Wizard, Mirabelle Ervine, will see me enrolled, and Tolfdir teaches the first lessons.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o0.te: Cross the bridge into the College of Winterhold
