story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o1.re: Another apprentice. Welcome. Your quarters are in the Hall of Attainment. Lessons start in the Hall of the Elements; Tolfdir is waiting there now.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o2.re: Excellent! Wards. Remember: a ward is not a wall. It's a door you're holding shut. Hold it shut with your whole will. Now, I need help with a small excavation at Saarthal. You'll come, won't you?
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.offer: I want to join the College.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.pitch: Then show me you can do more than wave your hands. Cast any spell you know here, at the gate; the ward will tell me the rest. Then go inside and find Mirabelle.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.title: First Lessons
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.des: Savos Aren sent me to Mzulft to study the Dwemer Oculory, which might reveal where the Staff of Magnus lies.
Fight the Falmer and the machines of Mzulft
Light through the Oculory's lenses drew a map on the walls. The Staff of Magnus lies in Labyrinthian, and the light showed something else: a Thalmor agent had been here before me.
Take the focusing crystal from the Oculory
Labyrinthian. Of course. I went there once, as a young man, with friends. I was the only one to come out. Go carefully, and tell no one, least of all Ancano.
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.off: The books speak of the Staff of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.pit: The Psijic monk visited you again, didn't he? Go to Mzulft, the Dwemer ruin in Eastmarch. Their Oculory focused light the way the Eye focuses magic. Bring back what it shows.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.d: Urag gro-Shub says the books I need were stolen by a former student who fled to Fellglow Keep to join a circle of necromancers.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.o: Mostly without blood. This one speaks of a staff, the Staff of Magnus. If anything could tame that Eye, it's that. Read it here; don't take it away.
Here are your books, without blood.
I need books about the Eye of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.p: The ones you want aren't here. Orthorn, a student, ran off to Fellglow Keep with three of my best volumes as a gift for some necromancers. Get them back. And don't get blood on them.
story.skycraft.q.col_staff_of_magnus.des: The Staff of Magnus lies with the dragon priest Morokei in Labyrinthian, the ruined city where Savos Aren lost his friends long ago.
Fight through the halls of Labyrinthian
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.desc: Tolfdir is leading the College's excavation of Saarthal, the ancient Nord city near Winterhold. He asked me to help find anything of magical interest.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o1.t: Fight through the draugr of Saarthal
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o2.t: Search the ruins for magical artifacts
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o3.j: Beyond Jyrik Gauldurson's tomb we found an enormous orb of magic. Tolfdir thinks it may be the Eye of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o4.r: And the Psijic Order appeared to you. They are not given to visits. Bring nothing more out of Saarthal without telling me, and say nothing to the Thalmor.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o4.t: We found something enormous under Saarthal.
Kodlak Whitemane died before he could be cured. The Circle carries his ashes and the restored Wuuthrad to Ysgramor's Tomb, to free his spirit from Hircine.
Fight through the tomb's restless guardians
Burn a witch head in the Flame of the Harbinger
Kodlak was right. I want to be free of the beast too.
Then it's done. Burn a head for yourself, and walk out of here as you came into the world.
The beast is part of me now. I'll keep it.
Your choice, Harbinger. The blood will serve you, if you master it and not the other way round.
Decide whether to keep the beast blood
Kodlak is dead. The Silver Hand's last raid. He wanted to be laid to rest in Ysgramor's Tomb, and free of the blood. We go north, all of us, with Wuuthrad.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.desc: Skjor sent me with Farkas to recover a fragment of Wuuthrad, Ysgramor's axe, from Dustman's Cairn.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o0.t: Travel to Dustman's Cairn with Farkas
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o1.j: Inside the cairn the Silver Hand were waiting for us. They knew about Farkas. They called him a beast.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o1.t: Fight off the Silver Hand ambush
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o2.t: Fight through the draugr of the inner crypt
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o4.r: So Farkas told you, and you came back anyway. Good. Tonight, the Underforge. There is more to the Companions than steel.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.offe: Kodlak says you have a job for me.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.pitc: A scholar came to us with rumor of a fragment of Wuuthrad in Dustman's Cairn. Take Farkas. If you come back with it, we'll talk about your future.
Kodlak wants to be free of the beast blood before he dies. The witches of Glenmoril Coven, who first gave the Companions their curse, hold the key to curing it.
Thank you, Shield-Sibling. I can feel Sovngarde already. When my time comes, burn one in Ysgramor's tomb and take me home.
Return to Kodlak with the witches' heads
The witches are dead. Here are their heads.
You wanted to see me, Harbinger?
I'm old, and I want to see Sovngarde, not Hircine's hunting grounds. The witches of Glenmoril Coven gave us this blood long ago. Bring me their heads, and we can burn the beast out of me.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.desc: Kodlak Whitemane, Harbinger of the Companions, is willing to consider me for a place at Jorrvaskr. First, the others want to see me fight.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.re: Fine. Not with me; I'd rather not spoil my afternoon. Go out there and put down something that deserves it, then come back.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.te: Talk to Vilkas in the training yard
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.to: Kodlak says I'm to prove myself.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o1.te: Prove yourself: kill three bandits or beasts
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o2.re: Hm. Not bad. Now take my sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge and ask him to sharpen it. Every whelp runs errands; you're a whelp.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.re: Of course he did. Here, take this shield to Aela while you're at it. Welcome to Jorrvaskr, whelp.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.te: Take Vilkas's sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.to: Vilkas asked me to bring you his sword.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o4.re: Good. You're one of us now, as far as the hall is concerned. Don't get comfortable.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.offer: I'd like to join the Companions.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.pitch: Join? Let me look at you. Vilkas, take our guest out to the yard and see what kind of arm they have.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.title: Take Up Arms
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.de: Skjor offered me the Circle's gift: the blood of the beast. And then the Silver Hand, the hunters who track werewolves for sport, killed Skjor. Aela wants Gallows Rock burned to the ground.
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o0: Wait for nightfall, then go to the Underforge beneath the Skyforge
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o2: Now we hunt the ones who hunt us. Skjor went after them alone and they killed him. Gallows Rock. Tonight.
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o6: Then they died a day too early to do it. Skjor is avenged. Kodlak will want to see you; he has other things on his mind.
Show Aela the Silver Hand's orders
story.skycraft.q.cr_dust_of_the_ancestor: Lord Hamaad at-Hel Ra, a lord of the Crowns in Sentinel, asked me to drive grave-robbers from the tomb of his ancestor Anahbi and recover what they stole.
Travel to the tomb of Anahbi
The robbers had broken three burial niches and woken what slept inside. The dead fought them as hard as they fought me.
Drive the robbers from the tomb
Recover the funeral mask of Anahbi
Almost is honest. I will carry it back myself at dawn, with the proper songs. You have done a Crown's work. From today you stand among us as a Supplicant. It is the first step, and the longest.
Return the mask to Lord Hamaad in Sentinel
The robbers are dead, and Anahbi's mask is back in the family. Almost.
I'm told the Crowns still keep to the old ways. I'd like to serve.
I recovered the funeral mask of Anahbi from grave-robbers. Lord Hamaad accepted me among the Crowns, the old Redguard nobility who keep faith with Yokuda and the High King.

Serve? Outlanders say that word easily. East of the city lies the tomb of Anahbi, a Ra Gada warlord of my blood, and grave-robbers have broken its seals. Drive them out and bring back what they took, and I will believe you mean it.
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.de: Lady Yasreen will be confirmed as her father's heir before the tomb of Anahbi, as Crown heirs have been for centuries. Ahzid will not let it happen quietly.
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.o0: Attend the investiture at the tomb of Anahbi
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.o1: Defend the rite from Ahzid's sellswords
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.o2: Ahzid fought well for a man who swore the old ways were dead. At the end he called on Anahbi's name. The tomb did not answer him.
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.o3: Then my nephew chose the sword over the song, and the sword answered him. Stand before the tomb, friend. There is one more rite today, and it is yours.
story.skycraft.q.cr_lord_of_the_crown.ou: Lady Yasreen was confirmed as heir before the tomb of Anahbi, and Ahzid paid for his bargain with his life. Lord Hamaad named me a Lord of the Crown and gave me the blade his ancestor carried ashore.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.desc: Lord Hamaad is failing. He has named his daughter Yasreen his heir, but his nephew Ahzid has been dining with Forebear merchants and Imperial factors. Lady Yasreen asked me to learn what her cousin is planning.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o0.r: My father is dying, slowly and with great dignity, and my cousin cannot wait. Ahzid keeps rooms by the harbour where the Forebear traders lodge. Find out who he writes to.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o0.t: Speak with Lady Yasreen in Sentinel
I heard your father is ill.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o1.t: Search Ahzid's rooms by the harbour
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o2.j: Two sellswords were waiting in the alley behind Ahzid's rooms. They had Forebear coin in their purses and very little sense.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o2.t: Deal with the hired blades who followed you out
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o3.r: Then he has sold something that was never his to sell. What do we do with it? I would hear your counsel before I hear my own temper.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o3.t: Ahzid has promised your father's seat to the Forebears in exchange for their gold.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.o4.c: Read it before the whole court. Let Sentinel see what he is.
Openly, then, as the old lords did. He will have no friends left by nightfall, and very little left to lose. Watch your back.
Keep it quiet. Let him think he's safe, and watch who comes to his door.
Patience. My father would approve. We will see which Forebear houses are fool enough to show their faces.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_empty_chair.outr: Ahzid at-Hel Ra has been trading promises of his uncle's seat for Forebear gold. Lady Yasreen holds his letter now, and the succession will be settled at the tomb of Anahbi.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.desc: Farouz the Drover is carrying the Crowns' tribute to the High King along the caravan road east of Sentinel. Alik'r raiders have struck every caravan this season, and Lord Hamaad wants this one protected.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o0.tex: Escort Farouz to the Well of the Long Road
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o1.jou: The serpents had come up out of the sand to drink. Farouz watched from the top of a crate and offered advice.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o1.tex: Kill the sand serpents nesting at the well
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o2.rep: Everyone but my lord's honour. The raiders struck the rear wagon while you fought the serpents and rode off with the tribute casket, the clever dogs. Their camp is in the rocks to the south. Bring it back.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o2.top: The well is clear. Is everyone whole?
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o3.jou: Qasim Sandfang wore three Crown signet rings on a cord around his neck, taken from three caravans. He will not take a fourth.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o3.tex: Kill Qasim Sandfang, chief of the raiders
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o5.rep: Farouz sent a rider ahead with the tale. He says you fought like a whirlwind. He also says he fought beside you, so I will believe half. The casket goes to the High King with my thanks, and with your name in the letter.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o5.tex: Bring the tribute back to Lord Hamaad
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.o5.top: The tribute is safe. The raiders are not.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.offer: Lord Hamaad says your caravan needs a sword.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.outro: Alik'r raiders stole the Crowns' tribute to the High King on the caravan road. I took it back from their camp, and Lord Hamaad sent it on with my name attached.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.pitch: It needs ten swords and a miracle, but I will take you. Raiders out of the deep Alik'r have bled every caravan on the eastern road this season, and this one carries the Crowns' tribute to the High King. If it is late, my lord is shamed. If it is lost, so am I, permanently.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_salt_road.title: The Salt Road
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.de: Ansei Zahreh agreed to test me in the way of the sword-singers. At the Shrine of the Ansei I must meditate, and then face whatever answers.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o0: Climb to the Shrine of the Ansei
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o1: I sat until my legs ached and the wind dropped. When I stood, I could feel my own pulse in the hilt of my sword.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o2: Then you are listening. The Shehai is the blade of the spirit, a sword made of nothing but will. Before I show you how it sings, tell me what you would use it for.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o3: To shield those who can't shield themselves.
A good answer, and an old one. The first Ansei said the same and died young. Be wiser than he was.
Honest. Hunding would have laughed at you and then taught you anyway. Winning is a beginning.
To honour the ones who carried it before me.
Then you understand more than most of my students already. Good.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o4: The figure that rose from the shrine moved the way Zahreh moved, without a wasted step. When my blade finally found it, it bowed and was gone.
Face the echo of a fallen sword-singer
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.o5: They always do, to those who earn it. You have taken the first step on the Walking Way. Wear these; a sword-singer should not look like a street guard.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.of: Lord Hamaad says you train sword-singers.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.ou: I meditated at the Shrine of the Ansei and bested the echo of a sword-singer who died long ago. Ansei Zahreh says I have begun to walk the way of the Shehai.
story.skycraft.q.cr_the_singing_blade.pi: I train people who wish to be sword-singers. Few become them. Go to the Shrine of the Ansei on the western cliffs, sit with the old blades until the wind stops arguing with you, and then show me whether there is a song in your hands.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.desc: Orvas Dren wants the debt papers from the neighbouring Arvel plantation. With them, he can take the plantation and push the Imperials out of the Ascadian Isles.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.o3.re: Excellent. In a month, Arvel saltrice will be Dren saltrice. You have a gift for this, you know. Sovor has a problem in Balmora. I think you're the solution.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.o3.te: Bring the papers to Orvas Dren
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.o3.to: The Arvels' debts. All of them.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.outro: I stole the Arvel plantation's debt papers for Orvas Dren, who will soon own their fields.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.pitch: The Arvels next door owe an Imperial bank more than their plantation is worth, and they've hired guards to keep the bank's men out. Take their debt papers. When I own their debts, I own their fields.
story.skycraft.q.ct_ashes_at_arvel.title: Ashes at Arvel
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.de: Sovor Trandel of the Camonna Tong's Council Club in Balmora will take me on if I teach an Imperial trader, Marius Faelian, what it costs to do business in Balmora.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.o0: I have a license from the Hlaalu Council, thank you. I'm not paying anyone else.
You opened a shop in Balmora without the Tong's leave.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.o1: Pay, or this shop burns tonight, with or without you inside.
All right! All right. How much? Gods, how did anyone ever think this was a civilized province?
Pay, and the Tong makes sure no one robs you. Refuse, and see who does.
That's... protection, is it? Fine. Fine. A small fee, for peace of mind.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.o2: Of course he will. They always do, once someone explains it properly. Welcome to the Camonna Tong, Associate.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.of: I'm Dunmer, and I'm looking for work.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.ou: I joined the Camonna Tong in Balmora after persuading an Imperial trader to pay for the privilege of staying in business.
story.skycraft.q.ct_blood_of_the_land.pi: Good. You've got the right blood, now show me the right spine. An Imperial trader, Marius Faelian, opened a shop in the Commerce district without asking the Tong's leave. Go and explain the local customs to him.
story.skycraft.q.ct_boss_of_the_tong.des: Sovor Trandel's underboss, Dalam Gavyn, has been selling Tong secrets to the East Empire Company. Sovor and Orvas Dren want him dead, and want me to do it.
Dalam Gavyn. My underboss, my friend, and a traitor who sold our routes to the Company. He's holed up in a warehouse by the river with his own men. End it.
Dren says you have a problem.
Dalam Gavyn begged at the end. He said the Company would make us all rich. Orvas Dren will not see it that way.
story.skycraft.q.ct_boss_of_the_tong.out: I killed the traitor Dalam Gavyn, and the Camonna Tong named me Boss of the Council Club in Balmora.
story.skycraft.q.ct_friend_on_the_counci: Nevos the Hlaalu factor quietly helps the Tong. Hired bruisers are coming to frighten him into turning on us, and Sovor wants me to protect him.
I know. I saw them by the bridge, three of them, watching my door. I'm a factor, not a fighter. Please.
The Tong sent me. You've got trouble coming.
Deal with the bruisers waiting for Nevos
Then tell Sovor the Council's inspectors will be very busy with the Imperial warehouses this month. Very busy indeed.
They're gone. Nobody will bother you.
I protected Nevos, the Hlaalu factor, and the Tong's friend on the Council will keep its eyes elsewhere.

Nevos, the Hlaalu factor, keeps the Council's eyes turned away from our business. Some outlander guild has hired bruisers to rough him up and frighten him straight. If Nevos gets frightened, we get raided. Keep him safe.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.desc: An outlander smuggling crew operating out of Addamasartus has been undercutting the Tong's trade, and they were the ones who tipped off the excise men. Sovor wants them gone, and their Thieves Guild fence warned.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o0.te: Travel to the smugglers' cave at Addamasartus
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o3.re: Now, now. Let's not be hasty. Business is business. What does the Tong want?
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o3.te: Pay a visit to the fence Corvo Malaxius
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o3.to: Your smuggler friends at Addamasartus are dead. I have their ledger.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o4.c0: A cut of everything you fence in Balmora, from now on.
A cut. Fine. My Guild masters won't like it, but they're far away and you're very close.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o4.c1: Tonight. Understood. I hear Ebonheart is lovely this time of year.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o4.te: Decide what the Tong wants from Corvo
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o5.re: Good. That's two problems gone and one lesson taught. You're climbing, Runner.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o5.te: Bring the smuggler's ledger to Sovor Trandel
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.o5.to: The smugglers are dead and the fence is handled.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.outro: I wiped out the outlander smugglers at Addamasartus and dealt with their Thieves Guild fence in Balmora.
story.skycraft.q.ct_outlanders_out.title: Outlanders Out
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.desc: Sovor Trandel sent me to collect a crate of moon sugar from Orvas Dren's plantation and run it to Balmora past the excise patrols.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o1.reply: Sovor's new one. Good. Take it. And listen to me a moment, before you go.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o1.topic: Sovor sent me for the crate.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o2.journal: The excise men had been told exactly which road I'd take. Someone in Balmora is talking.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o2.text: Deal with the excise patrol waiting on the road
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o3.reply: Then someone sold you. Outlander smugglers, most likely, or that Guild fence who thinks he owns the docks. We'll deal with them next.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o3.text: Deliver the moon sugar to Sovor Trandel
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.o3.topic: The sugar's here. But the excise men knew my route.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.outro: I ran a crate of moon sugar from the Dren plantation to Balmora. The excise men were waiting for me, which means someone talked.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.pitch: A crate of moon sugar is waiting at the Dren plantation. Bring it to Balmora. The Imperial excise men have been sniffing the roads, so don't stop to chat with anyone in uniform.
story.skycraft.q.ct_sugar_run.title: The Sugar Run
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.de: Falion, the wizard of Morthal, can cure my vampirism with an old ritual. He needs a black soul gem, and the ritual must be done at dawn at the summoning circle outside Morthal.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o0: Good. Go to the summoning circle east of town and wait for first light. I'll be there before you.
Bring Falion a black soul gem
I have the black soul gem.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o1: Go to the summoning circle outside Morthal
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o2: Wait for dawn at the summoning circle
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o3: Then kneel in the circle, and let the sun see you.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.of: I've heard you know a cure for vampirism.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.pi: I do, and I'll not ask how you came by the need. Bring me a black soul gem, then meet me at the summoning circle outside town at dawn. The soul pays for the ritual, not you.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_battle_whiter: The Stormcloaks are attacking Whiterun. The Legion holds the walls.
Join the defenders at Whiterun's gate
It did, and so did you. Now we take the fight to them, fort by fort. Come to me when you're ready to march.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.desc: The Legion marches on Windhelm, Ulfric Stormcloak's capital, to end the rebellion.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.o1.te: Fight through the defenders of Windhelm
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.o2.te: Defeat Ulfric Stormcloak in the Palace of the Kings
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.offer: Is it time to finish this?
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.pitch: It's time. Windhelm. Ulfric's own city. We break the gate, we take the palace, and we end this rebellion in one day.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.title: The Battle for Windhelm
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.desc: Legate Rikke sent me to seize a Stormcloak fort. If it falls, the hold it guards comes over to the Empire.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.offer: Which fort do we take next?
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.pitch: The rebels hold a fort that guards a whole hold. Take it, and the hold is ours. I'll send a squad to meet you there.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.title: Reunification of Skyrim
The Jagged Crown of the ancient High Kings lies in Korvanjund. If Ulfric gets it, he'll be crowned High King. Legate Rikke wants it first.
Drive the Stormcloaks out of Korvanjund
Ugly thing. Priceless, though, to the right fools. Ulfric won't be wearing it. Now, Whiterun. Balgruuf has sat on the fence long enough.
Bring the crown to General Tullius
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.desc: Legate Rikke will enlist me in the Imperial Legion once I've cleared bandits out of Fort Hraggstad.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.o1.text: Clear the bandits out of Fort Hraggstad
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.o2.reply: Then raise your hand and swear it. Welcome to the Imperial Legion, soldier. Here's your kit. Don't get blood on the collar.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.offer: I want to join the Legion.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.pitch: Good. Before I sign you up: Fort Hraggstad has been taken over by bandits, and we need it back. Clear it out, and come back.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.title: Joining the Legion
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.desc: General Tullius wants Jarl Balgruuf to accept a Legion garrison in Whiterun. I'm to deliver the demand.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.o0.re: A garrison. And if I refuse, the Stormcloaks march on me anyway. Very well. Whiterun stands with the Empire. Tell Tullius to send his soldiers quickly; Ulfric's are already coming.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.o0.te: Deliver General Tullius's letter to Jarl Balgruuf
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.title: Message to Whiterun
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_battle_whiteru: Balgruuf refused. The Stormcloaks march on Whiterun.
Join the army at the Stormcloak camp near Whiterun
Ha! Whiterun is ours! Now we drive them back to their forts and burn them out one by one.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.desc: The Stormcloaks march on Solitude, the seat of Imperial power in Skyrim.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.o1.tex: Fight through the defenders of Solitude
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.o2.tex: Defeat General Tullius in Castle Dour
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.offer: Is it time to take Solitude?
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.pitch: It's time. Solitude, the Empire's last stronghold. We take the city, we take Castle Dour, and Tullius goes back to Cyrodiil in a box.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.title: The Battle for Solitude
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.desc: Galmar sent me to seize an Imperial fort. If it falls, the hold it guards goes over to the Stormcloaks.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.offer: Which Imperial fort do we hit next?
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.pitch: There's a Legion fort squatting over one of our holds. Take it, and that hold is free. I'll have brothers waiting for you there.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.title: Liberation of Skyrim
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_jagged_crown.d: The Jagged Crown of the ancient High Kings lies in Korvanjund. Ulfric means to wear it. The Legion means to stop him.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_jagged_crown.o: Drive the Legion out of Korvanjund
The crown of Skyrim's kings. Not mine yet; it must be earned. But this will put fire in every Nord's chest. Now: Whiterun.
Bring the crown to Ulfric Stormcloak
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.desc: Galmar Stone-Fist will take me into the Stormcloak army once I've killed an ice wraith haunting a ruin in the snow.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.o2.reply: Ha! Then raise your blade and swear it. You're a Stormcloak now. Fight for Skyrim, and Sovngarde will know your name.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.offer: I want to fight for the Stormcloaks.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.pitch: Talk is cheap. There's an ice wraith in the old redoubt north of here that's been killing travelers. Bring me its teeth.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.title: Joining the Stormcloaks
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.desc: Ulfric sends Jarl Balgruuf an axe. If Balgruuf keeps it, he stands with Ulfric. If he sends it back, it means war.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.o0.rep: An axe. Subtle, as always. Take it back to him. Whiterun is not his to command. If he wants it, he can come and take it.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.o0.tex: Deliver Ulfric's axe to Jarl Balgruuf
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.title: Message to Whiterun
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.desc: Azura's priestess Aranea Ienith says the Lady of Dusk and Dawn wants her Star cleansed. A sorcerer has corrupted it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o3.text: Destroy Malyn Varen's soul within the Star
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.reply: Azura smiles on you. The Star is yours. It will hold any soul, endlessly, and never break.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.text: Return the cleansed Star to Aranea
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.topic: Varen is gone. The Star is clean.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.offer: Who are you waiting for out here?
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.pitch: For you, it seems. Azura has shown me your face. She has a task for you. Kneel at the shrine, and listen.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.title: The Black Star
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.desc: The cultists of Boethiah serve a Prince of betrayal and murder. She wants a new champion, and the old one must die.
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.pitch: A champion. Hers is weak. Climb to the Sacellum, let the Prince speak to you, and then kill the one she names.
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.title: Boethiah's Calling
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.desc: A talking dog named Barbas found me near Falkreath. He says he's lost his master, the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile, and wants me to help him get home.
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.o0.text: Follow the talking dog through Falkreath
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.o2.text: Clear the vampires out of Haemar's Shame
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.title: A Daedra's Best Friend
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.desc: Septimus Signus wants me to open a Dwemer lockbox deep under Blackreach for his master, Hermaeus Mora.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.o1.text: Destroy the guardian of the Dwemer lockbox
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.offer: Is there something else beneath the ice, Septimus?
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.pitch: A box! A Dwemer box, sealed in the deeps, and what's inside it belongs to my master. Open it, bring me the Oghma. Bring it, bring it, bring it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.title: Discerning the Transmundane
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.desc: Sinding, a werewolf jailed in Falkreath, stole the Ring of Hircine. Now the Lord of the Hunt wants a hunt.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.pitch: I killed a girl. Not me. The beast. I took a ring that was supposed to help me control it, and Hircine cursed it. He'll come for me. Unless you hunt me first.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.title: Ill Met by Moonlight
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.desc: The orcs of Largashbur are cursed. Their shaman Atub thinks Malacath wants an outsider's help.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o0.text: Kill a troll and take its fat
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o1.reply: Now place your hands on the shrine. He will speak.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o1.text: Bring the troll fat to Atub
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o2.text: Kill the giant chieftain who mocks Largashbur
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.pitch: Malacath has turned from us. Our chief will not beg. You could. Bring troll fat to the shrine, and listen to what the Furious One wants.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.title: The Cursed Tribe
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.desc: Silus Vesuius, a collector of Mythic Dawn relics, wants me to gather the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o0.text: Recover the Razor's hilt from Cracked Tusk Keep
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o1.text: Recover the Razor's blade shards from Cliffside Retreat
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o2.text: Recover the Razor's pommel from Morvunskar
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o3.text: Meet Silus at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.pitch: The Mythic Dawn, the cult that opened the gates of Oblivion! And I want the one thing missing from my collection: Mehrunes' Razor. It was broken into three pieces. Find them, and we'll meet at the shrine.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.title: Pieces of the Past
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.desc: The Jarl's son Nelkir hears a whispering door in Dragonsreach's cellar. Behind it, the Daedric Prince Mephala's blade sleeps.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.reply: That door? The Jarl had it sealed for good reason. Fine. Take the key. I didn't give it to you.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.text: Get the key to the Whispering Door from Farengar
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.topic: I need the key to the cellar door.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o2.text: Take Mephala's blade from the stand
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.pitch: It knows secrets. About my father, and about you. And it says there's a blade behind it, if somebody gets the key from Farengar. I can't. You can.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.title: The Whispering Door
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.desc: I found a glowing beacon in a chest, and it pulls toward the Statue to Meridia on the coast of Haafingar.
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.o0.text: Bring the beacon to the Statue to Meridia
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.title: The Break of Dawn
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.desc: A Vigilant of Stendarr asked me to help purge an abandoned house in Markarth. The Prince of Domination is waiting inside.
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o0.text: Enter the Abandoned House with the Vigilant
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o1.text: Bring Molag Bal's judgment to Logrolf the Willful
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o2.text: Answer the Prince of Domination's summons
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o3.text: Walk the burning streets of the Hollow City
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o4.text: Escape Coldharbour through the Dark Anchor
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.pitch: It belongs to a Daedric Prince now. Molag Bal, I think. Come in with me. Whatever happens, keep your sword drawn.
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.title: The House of Horrors
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.desc: A woman named Eola in Markarth wants my help reclaiming Reachcliff Cave for Namira's followers.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o1.text: Clear the draugr from Reachcliff Cave
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c0.label: I'll join the feast.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c0.reply: Then you're one of us. Wear this, and never fear hunger again.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c1.label: No. This ends now.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c1.reply: Pity. Namira will remember your refusal. Take this, anyway. She likes a bold palate, even a disappointing one.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.pitch: A feast of a kind few have the stomach for. First, Reachcliff Cave has been overrun by draugr. Clear it, and we'll talk about dinner.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.title: The Taste of Death
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.desc: Kesh the Clean needs vampire dust and silver to burn the incense that lets Peryite speak.
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.pitch: Kesh needs ingredients to speak with the Taskmaster. Bring vampire dust and a silver ingot. Then breathe the smoke, and listen.
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.title: The Only Cure
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.desc: I accepted a drinking contest from a stranger named Sam Guevenne. I don't remember much after the third mug.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o0.text: Match Sam mug for mug (bring three bottles of Nord Mead)
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o0.topic: Three for you, three for me.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o2.reply: What didn't? You were a legend. I'm Sanguine, by the way. Sorry about the mess. Here, you've earned this.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o2.text: Talk to Sam at Misty Grove
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.pitch: Ha! Drink up. Here, this one's on me. And this one. And this one...
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.title: A Night to Remember
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.desc: A madman in Solitude says his master, Sheogorath, is lost inside the mind of a long-dead emperor, and the way in is the sealed Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.o3.text: Walk through the Gates of Madness to New Sheoth and the Mad God's palace
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.pitch: Sheogorath! The Mad God! He went into Pelagius's mind, and Pelagius has been dead for centuries! Go to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace and fetch him out.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.title: The Mind of Madness
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.desc: Dawnstar is plagued by nightmares. Erandur, a priest of Mara who once served Vaermina, wants to cleanse the Nightcaller Temple.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o0.text: Go to the Nightcaller Temple with Erandur
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o3.c0.repl: Thank you. Mara's mercy on us both. Dawnstar will sleep tonight.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o3.c1.repl: Then you're no better than I was. Go, and may Mara forgive you.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.pitch: Vaermina. Her priests were sealed in the Nightcaller Temple long ago with something that feeds on dreams. The seal is breaking. Come with me, and we'll end it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.title: Waking Nightmare
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.de: The Emperor's cousin, Vittoria Vici, is to be married in Solitude. A wedding is a fine place for a funeral.
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o0: Travel to Solitude for the wedding
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o1: Kill Vittoria Vici during her wedding
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o2: And the Empire will be crying into its wine for a week. Good. Next, the Emperor himself.
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.desc: The Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's guards, found the Sanctuary. Astrid betrayed us to save herself, and they killed her anyway.
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.o1.t: Kill the Penitus Oculatus agents in the Sanctuary
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.o3.r: Now? Now we finish the contract. The Emperor's ship is docked at Solitude. We go in, we kill him, we disappear. Sithis is watching.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.desc: The Emperor's ship, the Katariah, lies at anchor off Solitude. It is time to fulfill the contract of the age.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o0.text: Board the Katariah at the Solitude Docks
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o2.s0: Titus Mede II, Emperor of Tamriel
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o3.reply: Hail Sithis! The Dark Brotherhood lives, and you, Listener, are its heart. Here's your share. It's a big share.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.title: Hail Sithis!
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.desc: A boy in Windhelm, Aventus Aretino, has been performing the Black Sacrament to summon an assassin. He wants Grelod the Kind, who runs the orphanage in Riften, dead.
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.o2.re: Really? She's really dead? Then the Night Mother heard me. Here, it's all I have. Thank you. Thank you!
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.o2.te: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.pitch: I've been doing the Black Sacrament. Grelod the Kind runs the Honorhall orphanage in Riften, and there's nothing kind about her. Please. Kill her. I'll give you everything I have.
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.title: Innocence Lost
story.skycraft.q.db_whispers_in_the_dark: Cicero, the Keeper of the Night Mother's coffin, has been listening to her for years and hearing nothing. Then she spoke, and she spoke to me.
Because she spoke to you! Listen, listen! She wants you to go!
Speak to Cicero beside the Night Mother
Why are you staring at me?
Then here is the contract, and it is not a small one. Titus Mede the Second. The Emperor. He arrives in Skyrim soon. Take the letter to your Sanctuary, and seal the deal.
The Emperor. The Brotherhood hasn't had a contract like this since the Mythic Dawn. Before we strike, we take care of the people close to him.
The Emperor. We're to kill the Emperor.
story.skycraft.q.db_with_friends_like_th: I took a contract that belonged to the Dark Brotherhood, and the Brotherhood noticed. I woke up in an abandoned shack with three bound prisoners and a woman named Astrid.
Kill one of the three hooded captives
Not a moment's hesitation. Welcome to the family. Our Sanctuary is in the pine forest near Falkreath. The password is 'Silence, my brother.'
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.desc: Lucien Lachance, a Speaker of the Dark Brotherhood, found me and made an offer: murder a Bravil moneylender named Gaelan Hollowtree, and the Brotherhood will take me in at its Sanctuary in Cheydinhal.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.o1.jou: Hollowtree was counting coins when I found him. He never finished the stack.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.o2.tex: Go to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary in Cheydinhal
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.o3.rep: Then welcome home. The Family is small here, and close. You will take your contracts from Vicente. Lucien will visit, when he must.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.o3.tex: Speak with Ocheeva in the Sanctuary
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.o3.top: Silence, my Brother. Lucien Lachance sent me.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.offer: Who are you, and why are you following me?
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.outro: I murdered Gaelan Hollowtree and was welcomed into the Cheydinhal Sanctuary of the Dark Brotherhood.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.pitch: Lucien Lachance, of the Dark Brotherhood. You have a talent the world wastes. Prove it to me: a moneylender in Bravil, Gaelan Hollowtree, has been sentenced by someone who paid us dearly. Kill him, and come to the Cheydinhal Sanctuary. The door will ask you a question. Answer it with 'Silence, my Brother.'
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_dark_offer.title: A Dark Offer
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_quiet_gathering.d: Vicente Valtieri sent me to the Vallerian hunting lodge, where guests gathered for an inheritance. Three of them are to die, one by one, without the others ever seeing who did it.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_quiet_gathering.o: Join the guests at the Vallerian lodge
Kill the first guest, Ser Draco Annius, while he sleeps
By the second morning the guests were eating with their backs to the wall. Nobody suspected the polite newcomer who poured the wine.
Kill the second guest, Neris Telvar, alone in the cellar
Kill the last mark, Brutus Venn, who has armed himself
Haunted! The client will adore that. You have an artist's touch. Lucien will hear of it, I promise you.
Three guests dead. The other two fled before breakfast, swearing the lodge is haunted.
Three guests died at the Vallerian lodge, and the two survivors will tell anyone who listens that the place is cursed.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_a_quiet_gathering.p: Very delicate. Five guests have been invited to a hunting party at the Vallerian lodge, east of Cheydinhal, each promised a share of a dead man's fortune. Our client wants three of them dead before the week is out, and the others too frightened to say why. Make it look like the lodge itself is cursed.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_night_mothers_crypt: To clear Lucien's name, I must reach the Night Mother's crypt beneath Bravil before the traitor does, and stand before her coffin.
Find the Night Mother's crypt beneath Bravil
Bellamont was waiting by the coffin, sure that I would come to destroy it. He had forged every order and sold every life. He died at the Night Mother's feet.
She spoke to you? Then everything changes. You are the Listener now, and the Black Hand answers to you. I'll be the first to kneel.
Tell Lucien Lachance what the Night Mother said
The Night Mother spoke to me. Bellamont was the traitor, and you are clear.
I killed the traitor Mathieu Bellamont in the Night Mother's crypt, and she chose me as her Listener. Lucien Lachance's name is clear.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.desc: Sealed orders from the Black Hand reached me in Lucien's handwriting. They say the Cheydinhal Sanctuary harbours a traitor and must be cleansed, every member of it. I have to decide what to do.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.o1.rep: You have that look. The one people have before they do something they can't undo. Whatever it is, I'd rather hear it now.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.o1.tex: Decide what to do with the order
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.o1.top: I've received orders from the Black Hand about this Sanctuary.
The Hand has spoken. I'll carry out the order.
Then do what you came for, and may the Night Mother forgive whoever wrote that order.
This order is wrong. I'm warning you instead.
Lucien would never... no. Someone wants us dead and wants you to hold the knife. Go to Lucien. Find out who.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.o2.tex: Choose: obey the Purification order, or warn the Family
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.outro: I chose what to do with the Purification order. Either way, Lucien Lachance has some explaining to do.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_purification.title: Purification
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.de: Vicente Valtieri gave me my first true contract: Captain Garro Velmont, who holds his own wrecked ship in Topal Bay and ransoms its survivors.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.o0: Find the wreck of the Gilded Gull near Leyawiin
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.o3: Take the captain's log as proof
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.o4: Splendid. The prisoners will find their own way home, I imagine, and the client will sleep soundly. Your payment, with my compliments.
Velmont is dead. His log, for the client.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.of: Do you have a contract for me, Vicente?
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.ou: I killed Captain Garro Velmont aboard his own wreck. Vicente was delighted, in the way only a very old vampire can be.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_salt_and_silence.pi: A charming one. Captain Garro Velmont ran his ship aground in Topal Bay and now holds the wreck like a fortress, ransoming the passengers he pulled out of the water. Someone in Leyawiin would like him to stop. Permanently.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_speaker_betrayed.de: Lucien Lachance has fled to Fort Farragut, his hideout near Cheydinhal, and sent word that the orders I received were never his. Someone inside the Black Hand is forging them.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_speaker_betrayed.o1: Fight off the assassins sent for Lucien
story.skycraft.q.dbc_speaker_betrayed.o2: Search the executioners for their orders
story.skycraft.q.dbc_speaker_betrayed.o3: No. Not mine. Listen to me carefully.
Show the orders to Lucien Lachance
The executioners carried these. Your seal, but not your hand.
story.skycraft.q.dbc_speaker_betrayed.ou: Lucien Lachance has been framed by a traitor in the Black Hand. Only the Night Mother can name the culprit, and her crypt lies beneath Bravil.
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.desc: Isran sent me to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are digging for.
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.o2.reply: Serana. Please, no more questions. I need to get home to Castle Volkihar. My family will want to know I'm awake.
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.o3.text: Take Serana home to Castle Volkihar
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.title: Awakening
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.desc: Serana's family are the vampires of Castle Volkihar, and her father, Lord Harkon, has something to offer me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o0.c0.repl: Then drink, and rise as a lord of the night. Serana will guide you. We have a prophecy to fulfill.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o0.c1.repl: A pity. Leave my hall while I'm still in a generous mood. Serana stays with me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.reply: A prophecy, and an Elder Scroll, and a vampire girl who wants to help us. Fine. I'll take any weapon I can get. Find a Moth Priest to read that Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.text: Report to Isran at Fort Dawnguard
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.topic: Volkihar's lord wants to blot out the sun.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.title: Bloodline
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.desc: Serana's mother, Valerica, fled into the Soul Cairn with the second Elder Scroll. The portal is in the courtyard of Castle Volkihar.
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.o0.te: Open the portal in Castle Volkihar's courtyard
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.o2.te: Cross the Soul Cairn to Valerica's refuge
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.o3.jo: With the Keeper destroyed, Valerica gave up the second Elder Scroll, and I left the Soul Cairn before it could keep me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.title: Chasing Echoes
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.desc: A guard told me of a new order of vampire hunters, the Dawnguard, gathering at an old fort in the Dayspring Canyon near Riften. Vampires are bold enough to attack towns now.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o1.reply: Good, because I'm not turning anyone away. There's a crypt, Dimhollow, where the vampires have been digging. I want to know why. Go.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o1.topic: I want to join the Dawnguard.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o2.text: Help drive off the vampires testing the fort's walls
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.title: Dawnguard
story.skycraft.q.dg_kindred_judgment.des: With Auriel's bow, Harkon can be stopped before he blots out the sun. Castle Volkihar is where it ends.
It is. Keep the bow. It's yours by every right that matters. And if you need a companion who doesn't mind the dark, you know where to find me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.desc: Serana's Elder Scroll holds part of Harkon's prophecy. A Moth Priest, Dexion Evicus, is traveling near Dragon Bridge and could read it.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o0.text: Find the Moth Priest near Dragon Bridge
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o1.text: Kill the vampires holding the Moth Priest
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o2.reply: Free? And a Scroll to read, my reward for it. Take me to your fort, and bring me an ancestor moth swarm from the glade near Falkreath; I'll need their light.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o2.topic: You're free. We need you to read a Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o4.text: Gather ancestor moths in the Ancestor Glade
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o5.reply: Then I read. 'Amongst the Vale lies the bow of Auriel, which with blood made dark will darken the sun.' And there is a second Scroll. It lies with Serana's mother.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.title: Prophet
story.skycraft.q.dg_touching_the_sky.des: Both Scrolls point to the Forgotten Vale, a hidden valley beyond Darkfall Cave, where the Snow Elves kept Auriel's bow.
Find the way into the Forgotten Vale
Fight through the Falmer of the Vale
story.skycraft.q.eec_charter_renewed.des: The East Empire Company's Imperial charter is up for renewal in Anvil. I am carrying Falco Galenus's report on the Raven Rock colony to the Commissioner of Charters, Lucretia Valga.
Let me read it. Hm. A corrupt factor removed by your own people? That is unusual honesty for a company. Tell me plainly what terms you want.
Present the colony report to Commissioner Lucretia Valga
The East Empire Company's report on the Raven Rock colony, Commissioner.
Exclusive rights to Solstheim ebony, for twenty years.
Bold. But the report earns it. Granted, with the usual Imperial tithe.
Fair terms, and a seat for Raven Rock's miners in the colony's council.
Unusual. Thoughtful. The Emperor likes colonies that don't riot. Granted.
Negotiate the terms of the charter
Twenty years! The board will want to give you a statue. I'll settle for making you a Commissioner of the Company, and giving you a very large bonus.
Report to Canctunian Ponius in Ebonheart
The charter is renewed for twenty years.
story.skycraft.q.eec_charter_renewed.out: I secured the renewal of the East Empire Company's Imperial charter in Anvil. Canctunian Ponius made me a Commissioner of the Company.
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.desc: Canctunian Ponius of the East Empire Company in Ebonheart will hire me as a Porter if I clear the docks of the creatures plaguing the Company's warehouse.
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.o0.t: Clear the creatures from the Company docks
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.o1.r: Good. Welcome to the East Empire Company, Porter. Here are your papers. Lose them and you're nobody; keep them and you're the Empire's own.
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.offe: I hear the Company is hiring.
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.outr: I joined the East Empire Company in Ebonheart as a Porter.
story.skycraft.q.eec_porters_papers.pitc: We always are. Our warehouse on the Ebonheart docks has been losing goods to mudcrabs, and I'm told the slaughterfish in the harbour are getting bold. Clear the docks, and you'll be on the payroll as a Porter.
story.skycraft.q.eec_raven_rock_colony.d: Canctunian Ponius sent me to Raven Rock, the Company's ebony colony on Solstheim, to help Factor Carnius Magius open the mine.
story.skycraft.q.eec_raven_rock_colony.o: Travel to Raven Rock on Solstheim
Help? Excellent. Things nest in the mine at night: rieklings, and worse. Clear them, bring me a sample of the first seam, and I'll write Ponius a glowing report.
Ponius sent me to help open the mine.
Clear the creatures out of the Raven Rock mine
Take a sample from the first ebony seam
And he'll have it, after I've weighed it and logged it. Someone around here should. You'd be surprised how often Company ebony goes missing between the mine and the ship.
Give the ebony sample to Falco Galenus to log
Do you have work beyond the docks?
I helped open the Raven Rock ebony mine. Falco Galenus, the colony's clerk, hinted that Company ebony keeps going missing.
story.skycraft.q.eec_raven_rock_colony.p: The Company has founded a colony on Solstheim, at Raven Rock, around an ebony seam. The factor there, Carnius Magius, reports problems with the mine. Go and help him open it, and keep your eyes open. His reports are very short.
story.skycraft.q.eec_rieklings_and_smugg: Falco Galenus asked me to put an end to riekling raids on the mine carts and to look into smugglers selling Company ebony north of Raven Rock.
Search the cave for Company goods
The letters arranging each sale were signed by Carnius Magius. The factor himself was selling the colony's ebony.
Search the smugglers' chest for papers
I knew it. And you found letters too? Keep them. We'll need them when we face him.
Bring the stamped ebony to Falco Galenus
The rieklings are dealt with. And the smugglers had Company ebony.
What's going wrong in Raven Rock?
I cleared the riekling warren and raided the smugglers' cave. The letters there prove that Factor Carnius Magius has been selling the colony's ebony.

Two things. Rieklings from a warren to the east have been raiding the mine carts. And there's a smugglers' cave north of town where, I'm told, Company ebony turns up for sale. Deal with the first. Then look into the second, quietly.
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.desc: The Raven Rock colony's supply ship ran aground on the Sea of Ghosts coast. Falco needs its strongbox, with the colony's accounts and pay chest, before wreckers find it.
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.o0.te: Find the wreck on the north coast
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.o1.te: Drive off the wreckers and the creatures around the wreck
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.o3.re: The pay chest is all here, and the accounts can be dried. The miners will cheer you tonight. Take my report to the Commissioner in Anvil; the Company's charter is up for renewal, and Ponius wants you to carry it.
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.o3.te: Bring the strongbox to Falco Galenus
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.offer: Anything else before I report to Ebonheart?
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.outro: I recovered the colony's strongbox from the wreck on the Sea of Ghosts. Falco has entrusted me with his report for the Company's charter renewal in Anvil.
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.pitch: One thing. The colony's last supply ship ran aground on the north coast with the quarterly accounts and the miners' pay. Wreckers have been picking at it. Bring back the strongbox, or Ebonheart will think we lost it on purpose.
story.skycraft.q.eec_sea_of_ghosts.title: Lost in the Sea of Ghosts
With Carnius Magius's own letters in hand, Falco Galenus and I mean to confront the factor of Raven Rock.
Then let's go and see him together.
Give the letters to Falco Galenus
Here are the letters. It's time.
It does. I'll write to Ponius tonight and keep things running until he answers. Which means I'll keep the books honest. At last.
It's over. The colony needs a new factor.
I exposed and stopped Carnius Magius, the corrupt factor of Raven Rock. Falco Galenus now runs the colony.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.desc: Lord Ezhar has a buyer for the Dwarven astrolabe: a Breton scholar in Rihad named Sabine Larrenne. Treasure-hunters and Crown loyalists both want the device for themselves.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o0.r: In Rihad, yes. A Breton with an Imperial stipend and very little sense of a bargain. Carry it yourself. The road east is full of men who would rather take than pay.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o0.t: Noraya says you have a buyer for this.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o2.j: Someone in Taneth had talked. Three treasure-hunters were waiting on the Rihad road, and they knew exactly what I carried.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o2.t: Deal with the treasure-hunters waiting outside Rihad
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o3.r: Oh. Look at the escapement on it. Before we speak of price, you should know a Crown lord offered me twice as much to smash it rather than let it go to the Empire. I refused, of course. Mostly.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o3.t: Lord Ezhar sent me with the astrolabe.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o4.c: Lord Ezhar's price stands. The Empire pays fairly.
It does, eventually, after forms in triplicate. Done. My patrons at the University will be pleased with both of us.
If the Crowns want it smashed that badly, the price just went up.
You are a Forebear, all right. Half again, then. I will tell my patrons the pirates drove a hard bargain.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.o5.r: Thank you. Tell Lord Ezhar the University will buy whatever else his ships bring out of those ruins. And tell him the Crowns are angrier than I have ever seen them.
story.skycraft.q.fb_brass_for_rihad.outr: I sold the Dwarven astrolabe to Sabine Larrenne in Rihad for the Forebears. She warned me that the Crown loyalists are furious that Hammerfell's treasures are going to the Empire.
story.skycraft.q.fb_fire_in_the_harbor.d: Back in Taneth, old Huzail has heard talk of Crown zealots who mean to burn the harbour's bonded warehouses and blame the Empire for it.
story.skycraft.q.fb_fire_in_the_harbor.o: I hear everything. Men in desert white, not sailors, asking which warehouses hold Imperial goods. They meet at the old Saltwatch tower on the cliffs. The new moon is close. You can do the arithmetic.
Speak with Old Huzail in Taneth
Lord Ezhar says you've heard something.
The zealots had barrels of lamp oil stacked to the ceiling and a chalk map of the harbour on the floor. They died praying to ancestors who would have been ashamed of them.
Kill the Crown zealots in the tower
Search the tower for the zealots' orders

Burn Taneth to save Hammerfell from the Empire. They never could do sums. No name, only the crown and the sword. I know one sword-singer who seals his letters that way: Ansei Qadir. He will want to watch it burn himself.
Bring the orders to Lord Ezhar
The Crowns meant to burn your harbour. These are their orders.
Crown zealots planned to burn Taneth's bonded warehouses. I killed the cell at Saltwatch Tower, but their master, a sword-singer called Ansei Qadir, is still free.
story.skycraft.q.fb_lord_of_the_forebear: Ansei Qadir still means to set Taneth's harbour alight. Lord Ezhar has asked me to stop him among the warehouses before the first spark.
Go to the bonded warehouses on Taneth's harbour
Stop the firebrands among the warehouses
Qadir fought like the old songs say the Ansei fought, and he called me a traitor to Yokuda with his last breath. The harbour did not burn.
Then Taneth stands, and so does the Forebear claim to it. Come. The council is already arguing about you.
Qadir is dead. The warehouses are standing.
I stopped Ansei Qadir before he could burn Taneth's harbour. The Forebear council named me a Lord of the Forebears, with a seat beside Lord Ezhar.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.desc: Lord Ezhar at-Taneth, a merchant-lord of the Forebears, sent me to recover the manifest of the wrecked Salt Gazelle before scavengers strip her bare.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o0.re: She was my ship before she was a wreck. The rocks west of the harbour, past the old light. Mind the dreugh; they like a broken hull as much as the scavengers do.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o0.te: Speak with Captain Noraya on the Taneth quay
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o0.to: Lord Ezhar sent me about the Salt Gazelle.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o1.te: Find the wreck of the Salt Gazelle
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o2.jo: The scavengers had already broken open the wine. Most of them were too drunk to run, and the dreugh did not care whom it ate.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o2.te: Drive off the scavengers and the shore beasts
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o3.te: Search the wreck for the ship's manifest
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o4.re: Damp is fine. Lost is not. Every crate on this list is insured by the Empire, and now I can prove it. You have a head for business, whether you know it or not. The Forebears can use you.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.o4.te: Bring the manifest to Lord Ezhar
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.offer: I hear the Forebears hire people who can keep their heads.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.outro: I recovered the manifest of the Salt Gazelle for Lord Ezhar, and with it the Imperial insurance on her cargo. The Forebears of Taneth have taken me in.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.pitch: We hire people who can keep their heads and our cargo. The Salt Gazelle ran aground west of the harbour with a hold full of Imperial goods and, more important, her manifest. Scavengers are already at her. Get me that manifest before somebody burns it for warmth.
story.skycraft.q.fb_salt_and_paper.title: Salt and Paper
story.skycraft.q.fb_the_brinewash_pirate: Pirates operating out of Brinewash Cove on Stros M'Kai have been preying on Forebear shipping. Captain Noraya asked me to break them.
Fight through the pirates in the cove
Ysha the Gull kept her plunder in the cove and her best prize in her own cabin: a Dwarven device wrapped in sailcloth, still ticking.
Kill the pirate captain, Ysha the Gull
Take the Dwarven device from the captain's cabin
That isn't mine. That's worth more than anything that was ever mine. Show it to Lord Ezhar; he will know who in Rihad pays for Dwarven brass.
Report to Captain Noraya in Taneth
The cove is clear. Their captain had this.
Lord Ezhar says you have pirate trouble.
I broke the Brinewash pirates on Stros M'Kai and killed their captain. Among her plunder was a working Dwarven astrolabe from the island's ruins.

Every ship I send west comes home lighter or not at all. The pirates nest at Brinewash Cove on Stros M'Kai, and they've been digging in the old Dwarven ruins on the island as well. Lord Ezhar wants them gone. I want my cargo back. Get us both what we want.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.desc: Arelle Vantis sent word from Leyawiin: a Blackwood mercenary went berserk near Water's Edge and is still fighting off anyone who comes close. Modryn wants to know what makes a man fight like that.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.o0.text: Find the crazed Blackwood mercenary near Water's Edge
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.o1.journa: He kept fighting long after he should have fallen. When it was over, his eyes were yellow at the edges and his breath smelled of something sweet.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.o3.reply: Never seen the like. It isn't a potion an alchemist would brew. Leyawiin sits on the edge of the marsh; someone there will know what this is. Take it back south and ask.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.o3.text: Bring the vial to Modryn Oreyn in Chorrol
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.o3.topic: The mercenary carried this. He fought like nothing could hurt him.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.outro: The Blackwood Company's mercenaries are drinking something that makes them fearless and strong. Modryn doesn't know what it is, but he means to find out.
story.skycraft.q.fg_bitter_sap.title: Bitter Sap
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.desc: Vilena Donton has sent Modryn Oreyn and me to Leyawiin to break the Blackwood Company in its own hall, destroy the stolen Hist, and bring down its leader, Ri'Zakar.
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o0.t: Meet Modryn outside the Blackwood Company hall
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o1.t: Fight through the sap-maddened Blackwood mercenaries
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o2.j: Ri'Zakar fought with the sap in his blood and the Hist sapling behind him. When he fell, Modryn put the torch to the tree.
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o2.t: Defeat Ri'Zakar, master of the Blackwood Company
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o3.r: Then the Guild still means something. Stand there a moment. I have something to say to the whole hall.
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.o3.t: Return to Vilena Donton in Chorrol
The Blackwood Company is finished. Their hall is ashes.
story.skycraft.q.fg_blackwood_falls.outr: The Blackwood Company is broken and its stolen Hist burned. Vilena Donton stepped down and named me Master of the Fighters Guild, with Modryn Oreyn at my side.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.desc: Vilena Donton's son, Viranus, is being held for ransom by bandits at Fort Ash, west of Chorrol. Modryn Oreyn asked me to bring him home before his mother rides out herself.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o1.text: Fight through the bandits holding Fort Ash
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o2.journal: Hollis the Coin had a chest of ransom letters, half of them addressed to families in Chorrol. He won't be writing more.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o2.text: Defeat the bandit chief, Hollis the Coin
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o3.reply: Walk, yes. Look her in the eye, not yet. I thought I could take them alone. Let's go before I think too hard about that.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o3.topic: Your mother sent me. Can you walk?
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o5.reply: I told Modryn not to send anyone. I'm glad he didn't listen. You have my thanks, and more than that, you have my trust.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.o5.topic: Viranus is home. He's bruised, but he's whole.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.offer: You look like you've been waiting for me.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.outro: I brought Viranus Donton home from Fort Ash. Vilena did not weep, and did not scold him, but she kept her hand on his shoulder for a long time.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.pitch: Viranus Donton took a contract on his own and walked straight into a bandit nest at Fort Ash. They've sent his mother a ransom note. Vilena won't beg, and she won't let the Guild pay. So you're going to go and get him, quietly, before she does something foolish.
story.skycraft.q.fg_lost_son.title: The Guildmaster's Son
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.desc: Vilena Donton, Guildmaster of the Fighters Guild in Chorrol, offered me a first contract: goblins from Rockmilk Cave have been raiding Dulcia Marcanus's farm.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o0.re: Finally. They come up from Rockmilk Cave, west of the town, after dark. Take my tally stick. When you're done, bring it back and I'll break it over the fire.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o0.te: Speak with Dulcia Marcanus in Chorrol
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o0.to: The Fighters Guild sent me about your goblins.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o2.jo: The goblins had dragged half of Dulcia's fence into the cave and built themselves a shrine from it. The shaman went down last.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o2.te: Clear the goblins out of Rockmilk Cave
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o3.re: Then that's the end of it. Here, the Guild's fee, and a bit extra for you. Tell Vilena her people earn their pay.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o3.to: The cave is clear. No more goblins.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o4.re: Good. A satisfied client is worth more than a dead goblin. Welcome to the Fighters Guild, Associate. Burz will see to your kit.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.o4.to: The contract is done. Dulcia paid in full.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.offer: I'm looking for paid work with the Guild.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.outro: I joined the Fighters Guild in Chorrol. The work is plain and the pay is fair, and Vilena Donton runs a tight hall.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.pitch: Then you'll start where everyone starts, with somebody else's problem. A farmer outside town is losing livestock to goblins out of Rockmilk Cave. Clear them out, keep her happy, and you'll have a place here.
story.skycraft.q.fg_sword_for_hire.title: A Sword for Hire
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.desc: Modryn Oreyn sent me south to Leyawiin. The Blackwood Company, a rival mercenary outfit, has been stealing the Guild's contracts there, and nobody knows how they can afford their prices.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o1.reply: Winning. Water's Edge asked us to deal with trolls in the reeds. By the time I'd written the contract, the Blackwood men had already ridden out. Go and see what kind of job they did.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o1.text: Speak with Arelle Vantis at the Leyawiin guild hall
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o1.topic: Modryn sent me. What is the Blackwood Company doing down here?
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o2.text: Go to the village of Water's Edge
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o3.journal: The Blackwood men had taken the village's money, set half the reed huts burning, and left two trolls wounded and furious. I finished their work.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o3.text: Kill the trolls the Blackwood Company left alive
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o4.c0.label: Their recruits fight like madmen. Something's wrong with them.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o4.c0.reply: You noticed that too. The villagers said one of them laughed while a troll was chewing on his arm. Tell Modryn. I'll keep my ear to the ground here.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o4.c1.label: They're cheap and careless. The Guild can outwork them.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.o4.c1.reply: I'd like to believe that. But cheap and careless doesn't explain how they win every fight. Tell Modryn what you saw.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.offer: Vilena says you need someone in Leyawiin.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.outro: The Blackwood Company is careless with its clients and reckless with its own men, and still it wins. Arelle Vantis and I both think there's more to it.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.pitch: The Leyawiin hall hasn't sent a contract north in two months. The Blackwood Company sells the same work for half the price and twice the noise. Go down there, see Arelle Vantis, and find out how they're doing it.
story.skycraft.q.fg_undercut.title: Undercut
story.skycraft.q.fg_what_the_marsh_remem: The amber sap from the Blackwood mercenary needs a name. Leyawiin's Argonians may know it, and the Company's own supply records might tell me where it comes from.
I know it. Every Saxhleel would know it. Where did a dry-skin get this? No, do not tell me yet. Find where it is kept, and then we will speak of what it is.
Ask Wades-in-Reeds in Leyawiin about the sap
Do you know what this is?
Raid the Blackwood supply camp outside Water's Edge
Then it is worse than I feared. They have a tree. A young one, stolen from the root-lands. Go to your Guild. I will not stand in the way of what you do next.
The Company ships this sap from its hall in Leyawiin. It's all in here.
Poisoning their own men to win contracts. I won't let the trade sink to that. Modryn will lead the assault on their hall, and you'll be beside him.
Bring the ledger to Vilena Donton
The Blackwood Company is feeding its mercenaries Hist sap. Here's the proof.
The Blackwood Company has a stolen Hist sapling hidden in its Leyawiin hall and has been drinking its sap to fight like monsters. Vilena has ordered the Guild to end it.
As I came into Markarth, a man drew a knife in the crowded market and went for a woman at a fruit stall.
I was too late for the woman. The killer screamed something about the Reach as he died, and the crowd scattered as if they had seen it all before.
Stop the knife-man in the market

Quietly. That woman, Margret, was asking questions about the Forsworn killings, like me. These murders happen every month in Markarth, and every time, someone makes sure nobody looks too closely. The killer lived in the Warrens. Search his cot before the guards 'tidy' it.
Speak with the man who slipped you a note
You wanted to talk to me?
Search Weylin's cot in the Warrens
Signed 'N'. Then someone gave him that order, and someone else gave them theirs. Keep digging, and keep your head down. I've already lost one friend to this city.
The killer was following orders. This was in his cot.
A Forsworn agent murdered a woman in Markarth's market. Eltrys, who has been looking into the killings, showed me that the murderer was following orders from someone higher up.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.desc: I am a prisoner in Cidhna Mine. The man behind the killings, Madanach, the King in Rags, is held here too, and the other prisoners say he wants to see me.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.o0.re: I run more than the mine. Sit down, and listen to a story about silver.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.o0.te: Speak with Madanach, the King in Rags
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.o0.to: They say you run this mine.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.o1.c0: The Silver-Bloods framed me. I'll stand with the Forsworn.
Good. Then we leave tonight, and we leave loudly. Meet me at Druadach Redoubt when you are out. The Reach will remember you.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.o1.c1: You ordered those killings. I'll find my own way out.
Then find it, and rot on the way. When you are back among your Nord masters, remember that you chose them.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.outro: I escaped from Cidhna Mine. Inside, Madanach, the King in Rags, told me the truth about the Silver-Bloods and offered me a place among the Forsworn.
story.skycraft.q.fs_no_one_escapes.title: No One Escapes Cidhna Mine
story.skycraft.q.fs_silver_and_blood.des: Madanach has reached Druadach Redoubt. His first order to me: hit the Silver-Bloods where they keep their wealth, at Kolskeggr Mine, and make Thonar feel it.
Now the Silver-Bloods learn that their cage is empty. Their mercenaries guard the gold at Kolskeggr Mine. Kill them, take the gold, and leave the mine-head burning where Markarth can see the smoke.
Kill the Silver-Blood mercenaries guarding the mine
The overseer died with his keys in his hand. The mine's gold went into Forsworn sacks, and the smoke went up over the hills.
Kill the mine's overseer, Skjold Iron-Purse
I can see it from here. Thonar will spend tonight counting what he has left, and tomorrow wondering who will come next. Good. Rest. Kaie has something to ask of you.
story.skycraft.q.fs_silver_and_blood.out: I raided the Silver-Bloods' holdings at Kolskeggr Mine for Madanach and left the mine-head burning where all of Markarth could see it.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_briar_and_the_he: Kaie the Briar-Mother wants to make me a Briarheart, as the Forsworn make their greatest warriors. For the rite she needs the heart of Hollow-Eye, the great bear of Purewater Run.

Not a task. A rite. A Briarheart carries a root where the heart should be, and the root must be fed with courage. Hollow-Eye, the old bear of Purewater Run, has more courage than any Nord. Bring me its heart.
Madanach says you have a task for me.
Hollow-Eye was blind on one side and missed nothing on the other. It fought me across the stream and back again.
Still warm, still brave. Stand by the fire, and do not flinch. The briar does not like those who flinch.
Bring the heart to Kaie at Druadach Redoubt
I hunted Hollow-Eye of Purewater Run and brought its heart to Kaie. Before Madanach and the Forsworn of Druadach Redoubt, I was made a Briarheart of the Reach.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_briar_mother.des: Kaie the Briar-Mother, the Forsworn witch who makes their Briarhearts, holds Druadach Redoubt with Madanach's hagravens. Faleen wants her dead before she can make more.
Fight through the Forsworn in Druadach Redoubt
Kaie cursed me in a tongue older than the Nords. Her briar-roots were still beating in jars along the walls when she fell.
Then there will be fewer Briarhearts in the hills this year, and fewer funerals in the city. The Jarl sends his thanks, and this. He says you have earned a weapon worthy of Markarth's stone.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_briar_mother.out: I killed Kaie the Briar-Mother at Druadach Redoubt. Without her, the Forsworn can make no new Briarhearts, and the Jarl of Markarth has named me a friend of the Reach.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.de: I escaped Cidhna Mine without Madanach. The Jarl's housecarl, Faleen, has sent word that the Jarl will hear my side of things, if I can prove I am no friend of the Forsworn.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.o0: The Jarl will listen to someone who has done the Reach some good. The Forsworn hold Red Eagle Redoubt and raid the road from it every week. Clear it, and you'll find the Jarl very attentive.
I hear the Jarl will listen to me.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.o2: Clear the Forsworn from Red Eagle Redoubt
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.o3: Kill the Briarheart chieftain of the redoubt
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.o4: So I've heard. The Jarl has decided you were never in Cidhna Mine, and the guards who say otherwise will be reminded of that. One more thing, though. Madanach's witch still holds Druadach.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_jarls_justice.ou: I cleared the Forsworn from Red Eagle Redoubt. In return, the Jarl of Markarth quietly struck my name from Cidhna Mine's records.
story.skycraft.q.fs_the_silver_blood_sec: Eltrys believes the Forsworn killings in Markarth are ordered from inside Cidhna Mine and paid for by the Silver-Blood family. I agreed to find proof.
A servant of the Silver-Bloods, I think. But every trail goes past him, down into Cidhna Mine, to the man the Silver-Bloods keep there. Thonar Silver-Blood will know. Be careful how you ask.
Then you have been reading the wrong names. Leave Markarth today. I will not say it twice.
Your family's name keeps turning up next to dead people.
Eltrys was dead before I arrived. The guards were waiting beside him, and they had my name before I could say it.
Meet Eltrys at the shrine below the city
