Eltrys was murdered and I was framed for it. The guards took the Silver-Blood ledger and threw me into Cidhna Mine, the prison the Silver-Bloods own.
A Nord sellsword named Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat has learned a Word of Power from some ruined wall and is using it to raid the farms along the White River. Arngeir has asked me to stop him without becoming what he is.

A man called Hrolfgar has found a Word and uses it to knock farmers down and take their grain. He camps at Valtheim Towers and boasts that he will come here next, to make us teach him the rest. The Voice is not for war. Stop him. But remember what you are, while you do.
Hrolfgar shouted until he was hoarse and swung until his arms shook. When he finally went down, he begged me to teach him the next Word.
Bring Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat to his knees
And? What did you do with a beaten man who begged you for power?
I told him the Word he wanted was silence, and sent him home.
Then you have understood the Way of the Voice better than he ever will. Come into the courtyard. The Masters are waiting.
I made sure he'll never raid again.
Perhaps that was needed. I will not judge you for it. But think on it, in the quiet. Come; the Masters are waiting anyway.
I stopped Hrolfgar Thunder-Throat from turning his stolen Word on the farms of Whiterun and on High Hrothgar. The Greybeards spoke my name together and called me a Master of the Voice.
story.skycraft.q.gb_the_breath_between.d: Arngeir says that to learn the Voice I must learn to be silent. I am to sit with the Word FUS in the courtyard of High Hrothgar without speaking it.
story.skycraft.q.gb_the_breath_between.o: There is always more. You have learned to shout FUS and push the world aside. Now sit with the Word without speaking it. Learn what it is, before you learn again what it does. Master Einarth will sit with you.
You said there was more to learn.
For a long time the Word sat in my chest like a stone. Then, near dusk, it was only a word, and the stone was me.
Meditate on the Word FUS in the courtyard
That force is only a door. What matters is where it opens.
Well said. Many push without asking what is on the other side. Remember that you asked.
That every push is also a refusal.
Yes. To use force is to say no to every other way. Sometimes that is right. Less often than people think.
That I'm stronger than I knew.
Strength is the first thing the Voice reveals, and the least important. Sit with it again someday. It will tell you more.
Tell Arngeir what the Word taught you
I meditated on the Word FUS with Master Einarth in the courtyard of High Hrothgar. Arngeir says the Voice is learned in the silence between Words as much as in the Words themselves.
Klimmek of Ivarstead has carried supplies up to the Greybeards every season for most of his life. His legs have failed him, and he asked me to take this season's bundle to High Hrothgar.
Begin the climb of the Seven Thousand Steps
The troll had been sleeping in the lee of one of the old pilgrim tablets. It woke angry. The tablet, when I could read it, spoke of patience.
Kill the frost troll on the pilgrims' road
Tell him his offering was received, and that the mountain remembers every step he has taken on it. So do we. You might remember them too, next time you climb.
Klimmek sends these, with his apologies that he couldn't bring them himself.
You look like you're carrying something heavy.
I carried Klimmek's offering up the Seven Thousand Steps to High Hrothgar, as he has done every season since he was a boy.

Supplies for the Greybeards. I've taken them up the Seven Thousand Steps every season since I was a boy, and this season my legs told me no. Would you carry them for me? Mind the frost troll past the fourth shrine. It doesn't respect pilgrims either.
Master Borri has a Word of Whirlwind Sprint to give me. Arngeir says that to understand it I must run ahead of the wind, in the courtyard and on the mountain.
(Borri lets out one breath of a Word, so quietly it barely stirs the snow. NAH: Fury. It settles into you like a second heartbeat.)
Master Borri. Arngeir says you have a Word for me.
Run the courtyard of High Hrothgar on the wind
Go down to the broken stretch of the Seven Thousand Steps
The gap in the old stairway was too wide to jump. With the Words in my throat, it was not a gap at all.
Cross the broken steps with Whirlwind Sprint
Master Borri felt it from here. He says you are too eager, and that you will learn. From Borri, that is high praise.
Master Borri gave me the second Word of Whirlwind Sprint, and I crossed the broken stretch of the Seven Thousand Steps on the wind.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.desc: Arngeir sent me to Rannveig's Fast, west of Whiterun, where the dragons once carved a Word of Kyne's Peace into a wall. A Word learned from the stone, he says, teaches what no Master can.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o0.re: Something we cannot give you. The dragons carved their Words into walls across Skyrim, and some of them still sing to those who can hear. At Rannveig's Fast there is a Word of Kyne's Peace: the Voice that calms instead of breaks. Go and listen to it.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o2.te: Fight through the dead of Rannveig's Fast
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o3.jo: The wall spoke a Word in a voice like a herd of deer moving through snow. KAAN: Kyne. I understood it the way you understand warmth.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o3.te: Learn the Word on the wall
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o4.re: Then you have learned that the Voice can quiet a beast as easily as it can kill one. Most never wonder about that. Let me help you understand it fully.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o4.to: I learned the Word of Kyne's Peace.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o5.c0: Why did the dragons teach a Word of peace at all?
Perhaps not all of them loved war. Perhaps one did, once, and then grew tired. Paarthurnax could tell you more than I can.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.o5.c1: I'd rather have learned something stronger.
Stronger. You will see, one day, that you did.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.outro: I learned a Word of Kyne's Peace from the dragon wall at Rannveig's Fast. Arngeir helped me to understand it, and to see that the Voice can calm as well as break.
story.skycraft.q.gb_words_on_stone.title: Words on Stone
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.desc: Colovian loggers have crossed into Valenwood and are felling the great graht-oaks east of Elden Root. Warden Faendir sent me to stop them.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.o0.te: Find the felling camp east of Elden Root
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.o2.jo: Varro said it was only a tree, and that Cyrodiil needed ships. The graht-oak behind him was older than the Empire. Half of it was already lying in the mud.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.o4.re: It will be melted and made into arrowheads, which is the only honest thing it will ever do. You should know: some of the elders are very angry. Angrier than I have seen in years.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.o4.te: Bring the saw to Warden Faendir
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.o4.to: The camp is gone. Here is their saw.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.offer: You've been sharpening that knife a long time.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.outro: I stopped a Colovian logging crew from felling a second graht-oak outside Elden Root and brought their saw to Warden Faendir. He warned me that the elders are furious.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.pitch: Colovian timber-cutters have crossed the border and are felling a graht-oak east of the city. A whole graht-oak. There were families in it. Go there before the next one falls. Bring me their saw so I can show the Treethane what it looks like.
story.skycraft.q.gp_felling_season.title: Felling Season
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_green_ladys_bond: The Silvenar has summoned me to his court. The Wild Hunt has strained the bond between him and the Green Lady, and she has gone into the deep forest alone.
Travel to the Court of the Silvenar

The Hunt was the people's anger, and I carry the people. She felt it through me and went to hunt it out of herself, alone, in the Green Heart. Wood Orcs nest there. I feel each of her wounds. Please bring her home.
Find the Green Lady in the Green Heart
The Green Lady had already killed six of them by the time I arrived. She looked annoyed that I had come, and then very glad.
Help the Green Lady against the Wood Orcs
He always asks someone. Usually I refuse. I am tired, and this time, I will let you walk me back.
The Silvenar feels every wound you take. He asked me to bring you home.
Bring the Green Lady back to the Silvenar
I know. I felt it, three hills away.
I found the Green Lady fighting Wood Orcs in the Green Heart and brought her back to the Silvenar's court. Their bond, and through it the people's peace, is mended.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.desc: Warden Faendir of Elden Root offered to bring me into the Wardens of the Green Pact, if I swear to keep Y'ffre's ancient promise: no harm to living plants, and nothing but meat to eat.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o0.re: It means your bow is horn and bone, your house is grown, not built, and your supper bled before you ate it. It means when you kill an enemy in our woods, you do not waste him. We will not ask that last part of an outsider. Not yet.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o0.te: Hear the terms of the Green Pact
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o1.c0: I swear to keep the Green Pact as the Bosmer keep it.
Then the forest heard you, and so did I. Do not make either of us sorry.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o1.c1: I swear to keep it while I walk in Valenwood.
An honest oath, and a careful one. Y'ffre likes careful. Most of the time.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o2.te: Hunt your supper the Bosmer way
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o3.re: And you did not complain about the lack of bread. That alone puts you ahead of most Imperials. Welcome, Pact-Friend.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.o3.to: I hunted. I ate. Nothing green was harmed.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.offer: I'd like to become a friend of the Green Pact.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.outro: I swore the Green Pact before Warden Faendir in Elden Root and hunted my supper the Bosmer way. I am a Pact-Friend of the Wardens.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.pitch: Friends are easy. Friends do not cut living wood or eat what grows from the ground while they stand in Valenwood. That is the Pact, and Y'ffre made it before there were Bosmer to keep it. Swear to it, then hunt your own supper, and we will see what you are.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_pact_sworn.title: Words Under the Graht-Oak
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.de: Spinner Aerfin, one of Y'ffre's storytellers, sent me to a soured grove near Falinesti to recover a knotted cord that holds one of the oldest tales of the Green Pact.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.o0: Find the sour grove near Falinesti
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.o1: The spriggans fought like they were defending a wound. Maybe they were.
Calm the angry spirits of the grove
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.o3: It never does. Sit. Here is what the knots say.
Bring the cord to Spinner Aerfin
I found your cord. The grove did not want me to.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.of: Faendir says every Warden must hear a Spinner's tale.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.ou: I recovered a Spinner's knot-cord from a soured grove near Falinesti. Spinner Aerfin read me its tale: the forest remembers every broken promise.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_spinners_tale.pi: Every Warden must hear one and see one. The two are different. North of here, near Falinesti, there is a grove that went sour long ago. Go there, and find a cord of knots I left in it once. Then come back and I will read it to you.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.desc: In their fury over the felled graht-oak, a circle of Bosmer elders has called the Wild Hunt, the old rite that turns hunters into beasts. The Hunt has no master once it starts, and it is coming for a village outside Elden Root.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.o0.rep: The elders called the Wild Hunt. They meant it for the Colovians across the border. But the Hunt does not know borders. It knows hunger. It is running toward the village west of here, and those beasts were our people an hour ago.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.o1.tex: Reach the village before the Hunt does
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.o2.tex: Stop the beasts of the Wild Hunt
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.o3.jou: The Heart of the Hunt had been the eldest of the circle. As it died it was almost an elf again, for a moment, and it looked relieved.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.o3.tex: Kill the Heart of the Hunt
The elders who called it must answer to the Silvenar.
They will. The Silvenar will feel it before I can tell him. That is how the bond works.
They paid enough. Let it end here.
Mercy. The Green Lady would call it softness. The Silvenar would call it wisdom. I do not know which of them is right.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.outro: The elders' Wild Hunt broke loose and turned on our own people. I stopped it before it reached the village and killed its Heart, the eldest of the circle that called it.
story.skycraft.q.gp_the_wild_hunt.title: The Wild Hunt
story.skycraft.q.gp_voice_of_the_silvena: Where the Colovians felled the graht-oak east of Elden Root, something has grown out of the stump: the grief of the tree, given shape. The Silvenar asks me to put it to rest in his name.

The fallen graht-oak is grieving, and its grief has a body now. Wisps gather to it. Go to the stump and end it, gently if you can, and firmly if you must. Tell it the people are sorry. It will understand that much.
What do you need of me?
Wait for the grief to rise at nightfall
I said the words the Silvenar gave me before the last blow. I do not know if it heard. The wisps went out one by one, quietly, like candles at the end of a long night.
Put the graht-oak's grief to rest
It heard. So did I. Stand there, beside her.
It's at rest. I told it the people were sorry.
I put the grief of the felled graht-oak to rest in the Silvenar's name. He named me keeper of his voice, and the Green Lady gave me a bow that no living tree died for.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.desc: Ebony shipments from the Hlaalu mine at Caldera keep arriving short. Nileno sent me to find out whether the trader Tirvel Sadrano is skimming them.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o0.tex: Travel to the Caldera ebony mine
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o1.rep: Short? Bandits, my friend. There's a gang in the old shaft taking crates at night. I'd deal with it myself, but I'm a merchant, not a fool.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o1.top: The House says your shipments are short.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o2.jou: The thieves weren't bandits. They were miners on Tirvel Sadrano's payroll, and their crates were already addressed to a buyer in Vivec.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o2.tex: Clear the thieves out of the old shaft
Your thieves are dead. Pay back the House, or I report you.
All right! All right. The difference, with interest. You're a hard one for a hireling. Hlaalu will do well with you.
Then I'll be on the first silt strider out of Balmora. Tell her the ebony was always good, at least.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o5.rep: A trader who robs himself to rob us. Clever, until it wasn't. You handled it like a Hlaalu: the ebony back, the problem solved, no fuss in the streets.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o5.tex: Bring the ebony to Nileno Dorvayn
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.o5.top: Sadrano was skimming his own shipments. Here is what he stole.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.outro: I recovered the stolen Caldera ebony and dealt with Tirvel Sadrano, who had been skimming the House's shipments.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.pitch: The ebony shipments from Caldera have been arriving light. A crate here, a crate there. The trader Tirvel Sadrano swears it's the miners. Go and find out whose pockets are heavy.
story.skycraft.q.hl_caldera_ebony.title: The Caldera Ebony
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.desc: The Hlaalu Council meets in Vivec, and Nileno Dorvayn and Crassius Curio mean to put my name forward as Grandmaster. I will need to win over the waverers first.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o0.text: Travel to the Hlaalu Council in Vivec
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o1.reply: I do, and I've counted the votes. We're two short. How do you propose to persuade the stubborn ones?
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o1.text: Speak with Crassius Curio before the vote
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o1.topic: Nileno says you mean to nominate me.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c0.la: With gold. Everyone in this House has a price.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c0.re: Spoken like a true Hlaalu. I'll see the envelopes delivered discreetly.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c1.la: With Caldera ebony contracts. Make it worth their while.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c1.re: Oh, clever. Bribes that look like business. They'll vote for you and thank you for the privilege.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c2.la: With the truth. Rethan Manor stands and the Tong is beaten.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.c2.re: How refreshing. It might even work, if I stand behind you looking stern.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o2.text: Decide how to win the Council's vote
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.o3.reply: It is. Stand straight and let them look at you.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.outro: The Hlaalu Council named me Grandmaster of House Hlaalu. Rethan Manor is my seat, and the House's ledgers are now my problem.
story.skycraft.q.hl_grandmaster.title: Grandmaster of Hlaalu
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.desc: Councilor Nileno Dorvayn of the Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora offered me work as a hireling: clear the storeroom of vermin and collect the month's rent ledger from Nevos, the House factor.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o0.tex: Clear the rats from the Council Manor's storeroom
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o1.rep: Of course she does. Tell her the red marks are the shopkeepers who claim they've already paid the Tong. That's her problem now, not mine.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o1.tex: Collect the rent ledger from Nevos the factor
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o1.top: Nileno Dorvayn wants this month's rent ledger.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o2.rep: Then the Tong is collecting our rents in our own city. Welcome to House Hlaalu, hireling. You'll find we have a great deal of work.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o2.tex: Bring the ledger to Nileno Dorvayn
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.o2.top: The rats are gone and here is the ledger. Nevos says the red names are paying the Tong.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.offer: I'd like to work for House Hlaalu.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.outro: I joined House Hlaalu as a hireling under Nileno Dorvayn. Already it is clear the Camonna Tong has its hands in the House's pockets.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.pitch: Everybody starts as a hireling. The Manor's storeroom is overrun with rats, and Nevos the factor still hasn't brought me this month's rents. Deal with both and I'll put your name in the books.
story.skycraft.q.hl_manor_errands.title: Errands for the Manor
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.desc: Crassius Curio has granted me land on the Odai plateau to build Rethan Manor, a Hlaalu stronghold. First the plateau needs clearing, and the builder needs paying.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o1.text: Clear the cliff racers nesting on the building site
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o2.repl: Can I? Look at the view. Sign here, and bring me the first payment, and we'll have walls before the next ash storm.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o2.text: Show the deed to the builder, Meril Vandas
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o2.topi: This land is mine now. Can you build here?
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o3.repl: Good, honest gold. My crew starts at dawn.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o3.text: Pay Meril Vandas five gold ingots for materials
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o4.jour: By the second evening, the walls of Rethan Manor stood waist-high on the Odai plateau, and Meril's crew was arguing about the bathhouse.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.o4.text: Wait while the foundations of Rethan Manor are laid
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.outro: The first walls of Rethan Manor rise on the Odai plateau. The House has a new stronghold, and so do I.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rethan_manor.title: A Stronghold on the Odai
story.skycraft.q.hl_rivals_at_the_gate.d: Orvas Dren cannot let a Hlaalu stronghold stand on the Odai plateau, overlooking his routes. Meril Vandas sent word that armed men are gathering below the half-built walls of Rethan Manor.
story.skycraft.q.hl_rivals_at_the_gate.o: Drive off the Tong's hired blades
Kill their leader, the mercenary Ulvo Telas
Scorched, not broken. We'll finish the roof by the end of the week. Go to Vivec. Nileno says the Council is meeting, and your name keeps coming up.
They're gone. Is the manor standing?
I defended Rethan Manor from Orvas Dren's mercenaries. The stronghold stands, and the Hlaalu Council has taken notice.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.desc: Hlaalu loyalists in Balmora are being murdered, one by one. Nileno believes the Camonna Tong, Orvas Dren's men, are behind it, and that she is next.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o0.reply: Two of our loyalists dead this week, both with their throats cut, both after refusing the Tong's protection. The Tong drinks at a warehouse by the river. Find out who gives the orders.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o0.topic: You sent for me. You look worried.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o1.text: Break the Tong enforcers at the riverside warehouse
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o2.journa: Vadryn Gols carried a list of Hlaalu loyalists. The ones crossed out were dead. The last name on it was Nileno Dorvayn's.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o2.text: Kill the Tong captain, Vadryn Gols
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o3.reply: Dren's men, crossing out Hlaalu names like a grocery list. How very vulgar. Leave it with me; the Council will hear of it.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o3.text: Take the list to Councilor Crassius Curio in Vivec
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.o3.topic: The Tong has a list of Hlaalu loyalists. Nileno is on it.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.outro: I broke the Camonna Tong's cell in Balmora and saved Nileno Dorvayn's life. Crassius Curio was so pleased he granted me land on the Odai plateau.
story.skycraft.q.hl_tongs_grip.title: The Tong's Grip
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.de: Primate Artorius of the Temple of the One asked me to collect a promised donation from the merchant Corvinus Aelius and use it to feed the beggar Old Tamsin.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.o0: Did I promise that? I suppose I did. Here. For the Temple. Tell the Primate my name, and tell him it was generous.
Collect the Temple's donation from Corvinus Aelius
The Primate sent me about the donation you promised.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.o1: Bless you, dear. Bless the Temple, too, and bless whatever merchant got shamed into paying for it.
Bring Old Tamsin three loaves of bread
This is from the Temple. Eat, mother.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.o2: Good. You fed a hungry woman and reminded a rich man of his promise. Both are acts of faith. Welcome to the Imperial Cult, Layman.
Bring the alms purse to Primate Artorius
Tamsin has eaten. The rest of the donation is here.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.of: I'd like to serve the Temple.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.ou: I gathered alms for the poor and was received into the Imperial Cult by Primate Artorius at the Temple of the One.
story.skycraft.q.ic_alms_for_the_poor.pi: Service starts with the smallest things. Corvinus Aelius in the Market District has promised the Temple a donation and keeps forgetting. Collect it, then see that Old Tamsin outside the Temple eats tonight. Come back and tell me what you learned.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.desc: A coughing sickness has spread through Bravil. Sister Ilara at the Chapel of Mara needs healing herbs from the marshes, and every pair of hands the Temple can spare.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o1.reply: Then go into the marsh east of the city and gather the bitter herbs that grow where the water runs clear. Careful. The mudcrabs are in a mood this season.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o1.text: Speak with Sister Ilara at the Chapel of Mara
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o1.topic: The Primate sent me to help.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o2.text: Clear the mudcrabs from the herb beds
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o4.reply: Enough to brew for the whole chapel. Now stay and help me tend them. Mara heals through hands, not only through prayers.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o4.text: Bring the herbs to Sister Ilara
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o4.topic: The herbs, as many as I could carry.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o5.journ: I spent the night carrying water and holding cups to cracked lips. By dawn the coughing in the chapel had eased, and two children were asking for breakfast.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.o5.text: Tend the sick with Sister Ilara
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.outro: I gathered herbs and nursed Bravil's sick through the worst of the coughing sickness at the Chapel of Mara.
story.skycraft.q.ic_maras_mercy.title: Mara's Mercy
story.skycraft.q.ic_primates_blessing.de: Word of Bravil reached the Temple of the One before I did. Primate Artorius has asked me to come to the great dome to receive the blessing of the Nine.
story.skycraft.q.ic_primates_blessing.o0: Go to the Temple of the One
story.skycraft.q.ic_primates_blessing.o1: I did. Choose the Divine whose blessing you would carry with you. All Nine will watch over you, but one will walk closer.
story.skycraft.q.ic_primates_blessing.o2: Mara, then. May you always find the strength to be kind.
Stendarr, then. May your hand be firm and your judgment fair.
Arkay, then. May you never fear the door he keeps.
Choose the Divine whose blessing you will carry
story.skycraft.q.ic_primates_blessing.ou: Primate Artorius blessed me in the name of the Nine beneath the dome of the Temple of the One, and raised me to the rank of Master of the Cult.
story.skycraft.q.ic_rest_for_the_restles: The dead in the catacombs beneath the Green Emperor Way have begun to stir. Primate Artorius asked me to carry Arkay's censer into the catacombs and put them back to rest.
Enter the catacombs of the Green Emperor Way
Lay the restless dead to rest
A grave-robber with a little necromancy had been raising the dead to dig for him. The censer's smoke settled the rest back into their niches.
Destroy the necromancer who disturbed the tombs
Arkay will be pleased, and so will the families of the dead. You did that with courage and with respect. Both are needed.
Return Arkay's censer to Primate Artorius
The catacombs are quiet again. A grave-robber was raising them.
I put the restless dead of the Green Emperor Way catacombs back to rest and ended the grave-robber who woke them.
story.skycraft.q.ic_roads_of_the_divines: Primate Artorius sent me on a pilgrimage to the chapels of the Divines across Cyrodiil: Anvil, Skingrad, Leyawiin, Cheydinhal and Bruma.
Pray at the Chapel of Dibella in Anvil
Pray at the Chapel of Julianos in Skingrad
Pray at the Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin
Pray at the Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal
The Chapel of Talos in Bruma is quiet these days, and the priest kept glancing at the door. But the old prayers were still carved over the altar.
Pray at the Great Chapel of Talos in Bruma
Then you have seen what I wanted you to see: the Nine are not in this Temple alone. They are in every city, and every city needs them differently.
I prayed at all five chapels.
I walked the roads of the Divines and prayed at five chapels across Cyrodiil.

Walk the roads of the Divines. Each city of Cyrodiil keeps a chapel to one of the Nine. Pray at five of them: Dibella in Anvil, Julianos in Skingrad, Zenithar in Leyawiin, Arkay in Cheydinhal and Talos in Bruma. You will come back changed, or at least footsore.
story.skycraft.q.ic_stendarrs_hammer.des: Worshippers of Mehrunes Dagon, the remnants of the old Mythic Dawn, have gathered at the Prince's shrine south of the Heartland. Primate Artorius has asked me to carry Stendarr's justice to them.
Travel to the shrine of Mehrunes Dagon
Drive out the cultists and their summoned servants
Kill the cult's leader, Ruinous Cassia
Stendarr's mercy is for the repentant. His hammer is for those who would burn the world twice. You knew the difference. I will see this idol ground to dust.
Bring the idol to Primate Artorius
The cult is broken. Their idol, for the Temple to destroy.
story.skycraft.q.ic_stendarrs_hammer.out: I broke a Mythic Dawn remnant at the shrine of Mehrunes Dagon and brought their idol to the Temple to be destroyed.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_covenant_lists.d: Knights from every corner of the Daggerfall Covenant have come to the autumn lists outside Daggerfall. Dame Maelis has entered my name, and the favourite is Sir Rolan Dufresne of Camlorn.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_covenant_lists.o: Someone had to. Half the Covenant heard about Baelborne Rock and wants to know if it's true. The other half wants to knock you down to prove it isn't. Sir Rolan of Camlorn is in the final. Go and introduce yourself.
Speak with Dame Maelis about the tournament
You entered my name in the lists?
The dragon-slayer. I'll try not to embarrass you too badly; Daggerfall needs its heroes. Blunted steel, first to yield. Unless you'd rather make it interesting.
I hear we're to meet in the final.
Rolan was quicker than I expected and prouder than he should have been. When his shield arm finally dropped, he raised his visor and called the yield himself.
Defeat Sir Rolan in the final bout

A humbling one. Here, a winner's purse, and something worth more. My grandfather swore the Banner of the Red Wyrm lies in Cath Bedraud, with the knight who carried it. Daggerfall never went to look. Maybe its dragon-slayer should.
Speak with Sir Rolan after the bout
I won the Covenant lists against Sir Rolan Dufresne of Camlorn. In defeat he told me where the order's lost founding banner may lie: the old crypts of Cath Bedraud.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.desc: Lord Commander Odric Hollenmoor of the Knights of the Dragon agreed to consider me as an aspirant. I must keep the vigil at the dragon-stone and then pass Dame Maelis Corbel's trial.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o0.jo: The stone is carved with a coiled dragon worn nearly smooth by centuries of hands. Around midnight the cold came up out of the ground, and I stayed where I was.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o0.te: Keep vigil at the dragon-stone in the courtyard
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o1.re: Your eyes are red and your hands are steady. Good. Now the useful part. Wolves have been taking lambs from the farms outside the east gate. A knight serves the people before the crown. Go and serve them.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o2.te: Kill the wolves raiding the farms outside Daggerfall
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o3.re: And the farmers? Did you speak to them, or just leave carcasses in their fields? Never mind. One last thing before the Lord Commander. Every aspirant answers this.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o4.c0: To guard those who can't guard themselves.
The oldest answer, and still the right one. Hold on to it when the lords start giving you orders.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o4.c1: For glory, and a name the bards remember.
Honest, at least. Glory comes to knights who are too busy to look for it. You'll learn.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o4.c2: For Daggerfall, and for the Covenant.
Spoken like a native. The Lord Commander will like that.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.o4.te: Tell Dame Maelis why you would be a knight
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.offer: I'd like to serve the Knights of the Dragon.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.outro: I kept the vigil at the dragon-stone and passed Dame Maelis Corbel's trial. Lord Commander Hollenmoor accepted me as an aspirant of the Knights of the Dragon.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.pitch: Everyone would like to. Few last the night. Every aspirant keeps vigil at the old dragon-stone in the courtyard until dawn, alone, without sleep. Then Dame Maelis will see whether you can do more than stand still.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_long_vigil.title: The Long Vigil
The Banner of the Red Wyrm, the founding standard of the Knights of the Dragon, may lie in the crypts of Cath Bedraud. Dame Maelis will ride with me to bring it home.
Fight through the restless dead of Cath Bedraud
A Bloodthorn necromancer had made the crypt her workshop and was singing the knights out of their graves to guard it. Her song ended in the middle of a verse.
Take down the Banner of the Red Wyrm
Two hundred years. Maelis, call the whole order into the hall. Every knight, every squire, every stable-hand who can stand. This one is going to be done properly.
Carry the banner home to Daggerfall
The Banner of the Red Wyrm, Lord Commander.
I recovered the Banner of the Red Wyrm from Cath Bedraud and carried it home. Lord Commander Hollenmoor knighted me before the whole order and gave me a captain's command.
The Banner of the Red Wyrm
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_road_to_aldcroft: Lord Commander Hollenmoor ordered me to escort Lady Ysolde Merrival from Daggerfall to her estate at Aldcroft. Bloodthorn cultists have been active along the road.
One knight. Not even a knight, I'm told. Well, Hollenmoor has never yet wasted my time. Keep close, and if anything with thorns in its hair comes out of the woods, kill it before it reaches me.
The Lord Commander sent me to see you to Aldcroft.
The cultists had grown a hedge of black thorns across the lane overnight. When we cut through it, they were waiting on the other side.
Fight off the Bloodthorn ambush at the village edge
So I am, and with my skin intact. I shall write to Hollenmoor that his aspirant fights like a knight and talks like a farmhand. He will understand both are compliments.
Do you have work for an aspirant?
I brought Lady Ysolde Merrival safely to Aldcroft through a Bloodthorn ambush. She has written to the Lord Commander on my behalf.

Lady Ysolde Merrival must reach her estate at Aldcroft before the harvest court, and the road runs through country the Bloodthorn cult has been stirring up. She wants a whole company. She gets you. See that it's enough.
story.skycraft.q.kd_the_wyrm_of_baelborn: A dragon has made its lair on Baelborne Rock, west of Daggerfall, and has been burning farmsteads across Glenumbra. The Knights of the Dragon took their name from such a beast, and the Lord Commander wants it dead.

Glenumbra has a dragon problem. This order has a dragon on every shield and banner, and I'll not have it said we hid behind the walls while a real one burned the countryside. It nests on Baelborne Rock. Bring me proof it's dead.
Lady Ysolde says you have a dragon problem.
It came down out of the cloud with a sound like a forge bellows the size of a church. When it fell, the rock shook under me for a long time.
Slay the dragon of Baelborne Rock
Take a tooth from the wyrm's jaw

By the Eight. The first dragon this order has killed in a hundred years, and an aspirant did it. Squire, then, from today. And I'll have this tooth mounted over the hall door so the lords can admire it on their way in.
Bring the tooth to Lord Commander Hollenmoor
The dragon of Baelborne Rock is dead.
I killed the dragon of Baelborne Rock. Lord Commander Hollenmoor raised me to squire and hung its tooth above the hall door.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_divine_crusader.des: The Prophet told me that Umaril's spirit will come down to face me in Garlas Malatar under the night sky. If I destroy his avatar there, he will never return.
I heard the bells, even from here. The order is yours to lead, Divine Crusader. I'll be proud to serve under you.
Return to Sir Amiel at the Priory
Umaril is gone. All of him.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_divine_crusader.off: Umaril's spirit escaped. How do I follow it?
story.skycraft.q.kn9_divine_crusader.out: I destroyed Umaril's avatar and ended him for good. Sir Amiel named me Divine Crusader, head of the Knights of the Nine.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_divine_crusader.pit: You don't follow it. You call it. Go back to Garlas Malatar under the night sky, wearing Pelinal's blessing, and Umaril's pride will bring his avatar down to meet you. When it falls, nothing of him will return.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_mace_of_the_crusade: The Ayleids hid Pelinal's Stendarr-blessed mace in Garlas Agea, a ruin near Lake Rumare. Umaril's Aurorans are already inside.
Travel to the Ayleid ruin of Garlas Agea
Destroy the Aurorans searching the ruin
Take the Mace of the Crusader
Only a step. They will not get closer. The relics are whole, and so is the order. Now we find Umaril.
Bring the mace to Sir Amiel
The Mace of the Crusader. The Aurorans were a step behind me.
I took the Mace of the Crusader from Garlas Agea ahead of Umaril's Aurorans. The relics of Pelinal Whitestrake are gathered at the Priory.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.desc: A street preacher in Anvil who calls himself the Prophet asked me to walk a pilgrimage to the chapels of the Nine, and then present myself at the Priory of the Nine near Kvatch.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o0.journ: Kvatch's chapel is still half scaffolding. A mason stopped work to let me pray, and did not ask why.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o0.text: Pray at the rebuilt Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o1.text: Pray at the Chapel of Julianos in Skingrad
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o2.text: Pray at the Great Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o3.reply: Then the Prophet was right, and I was right to wait. Kneel. In the name of the Nine, I accept you as a knight of this order. There are few of us. There will be more.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o3.text: Present yourself to Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory of the Nine
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.o3.topic: The Prophet sent me. I've walked the pilgrimage.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.outro: I walked the pilgrimage of the Nine and was received into the Knights of the Nine by Sir Amiel Lannus at the Priory near Kvatch.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.pitch: That the Nine need knights again. Not soldiers. Knights. If you would be one, walk the pilgrimage: pray at the chapels of Kvatch, Skingrad and Chorrol, and come to the Priory of the Nine outside Kvatch. Sir Amiel waits there.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_pilgrimage.title: Pilgrimage of the Nine
story.skycraft.q.kn9_relics_of_the_white: Pelinal's helm and gauntlets were laid with the first knights of his order in an ossuary near Anvil. The dead there do not welcome visitors.
Travel to the Ossuary of the Knights
Lay the restless dead of the ossuary to rest
Take the Helm of the Crusader
Something had disturbed the knights' rest before me. Gold scratches on the stone, like the marks of a gauntleted hand. Umaril's servants are hunting the relics too.
Take the Gauntlets of the Crusader
Pelinal's own. I never thought I'd see it. Set it on the altar, beside his cuirass that the Priory has kept all these years. Do you have the gauntlets?
Bring the helm to Sir Amiel
Aurorans. Meridia's fallen warriors, Umaril's servants. Then he is truly stirring. One relic remains: the mace.
Bring the gauntlets to Sir Amiel
And the gauntlets. Something else was looking for them.
I recovered Pelinal's helm and gauntlets from the Ossuary of the Knights. Umaril's Auroran servants are already searching for the rest.
story.skycraft.q.kn9_shrine_of_the_crusa: Sir Amiel believes the spirit of Pelinal Whitestrake, the Divine Crusader, can still be reached at a forgotten shrine in the hills near Kvatch, and that it will tell us where his relics lie.
Find the Shrine of the Crusader
Umaril. The Ayleid sorcerer Pelinal fought to the last. If he's returning, we will need every relic the Crusader left. Follow the ember.
Tell Sir Amiel what you saw
Pelinal spoke to me. Umaril the Unfeathered is returning.
At the Shrine of the Crusader I saw Pelinal Whitestrake, who warned that Umaril the Unfeathered is returning, and told me where his relics lie.
Umaril the Unfeathered has taken flesh again in Garlas Malatar, the ruin where his last followers waited. Sir Amiel has blessed the relics. It is time to fight him.
I struck down Umaril's body in Garlas Malatar, but his spirit escaped to Meridia's realm. He is not finished.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.de: Lord Aubrec Valmont of the Knights of the Rose set me a first task: end the extortion of the fishwives on the Wayrest docks.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.o0: The Gullhook boys. They sell 'protection' to women who gut fish for a living, and break their tables when they can't pay. Give them the chance to leave. If they refuse it, don't give them a second.
Lord Valmont sent me about the docks.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.o1: I told them to leave the docks. Their leader laughed and drew a gutting knife. The fishwives cheered at the end, which I did not expect.
Break the Gullhook gang on the docks
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.o2: I watched from the harbour wall. You offered them the door first. Good. That's what separates us from the men we fight. Go and tell Lord Valmont.
The Gullhook gang won't trouble anyone again.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.o3: Dame Orielle has already sung your praises, which she does about once a decade. Take the Rose, Aspirant. Wear it where people can see it, and behave accordingly.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.of: I'd like to earn a place among the Knights of the Rose.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.ou: I broke the Gullhook gang that preyed on the fishwives of the Wayrest docks. Lord Aubrec Valmont accepted me as an aspirant of the Knights of the Rose.
story.skycraft.q.kr_a_courteous_blade.pi: Then begin where we all begin, with the people nobody else bothers about. A gang has been squeezing coin out of the fishwives on the Wayrest docks. Dame Orielle will tell you more. Settle it, and settle it like a knight, not a brawler.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.desc: Chancellor Ivo Brennault has fled to Saltreef Hold to sail out of the King's reach. Lord Valmont has given me the honour of bringing him to justice.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o1.te: Cut down the Chancellor's hired swords on the shore
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o2.jo: The Chancellor was a battlemage in his youth, it turns out, and had kept his hand in. It did not save him. The pirate ship sailed without him.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o2.te: Stop Ivo Brennault before he reaches the ship
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o3.re: Then Wayrest owes you its honour twice over. Come to the chapel tonight. The order has a question to ask you, and an oath to hear.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o3.te: Return to Lord Valmont in Wayrest
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.o3.to: The Chancellor won't trouble the court again.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.outro: I stopped Chancellor Brennault at Saltreef before he could escape across the bay. In the chapel of the Rose I swore the order's oath, and Lord Valmont named me Lord of the Rose.
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_roses_oath.title: The Rose's Oath
story.skycraft.q.kr_the_saltreef_hostage: Elsabet Mornay is held by pirates at Saltreef Hold on the coast west of Wayrest. Lord Valmont wants her brought home alive before the Chancellor's allies decide she knows too much.
Fight through the pirates of Saltreef Hold
Red Brannoc told me, with his last breath, that he had been paid to take the girl and paid again to keep her. He didn't say by whom. He didn't need to.
Kill the pirate captain, Red Brannoc
I heard them talking about the Chancellor. My father was going to vote against his new tariff. They were going to hold me until the council met. Please, take me home.
Lord Valmont sent me. You're safe now.
A councillor's daughter stolen to buy a vote. The King must hear it, from her own mouth, before the whole court.
Elsabet is home. She heard the pirates name the Chancellor.
I rescued Elsabet Mornay from the pirates of Saltreef Hold. She heard them name Chancellor Brennault, who had her taken to force her father's vote on the King's council.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.desc: Accused before the court, Chancellor Brennault claimed the old Breton right of trial by combat, and named Sir Garrick Vane his champion. Lord Valmont has named me champion of the Rose.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o0.r: An old law, and he knows Garrick Vane has never lost a duel. If his champion wins, Stendarr has judged him innocent, and nobody may speak of it again. I am too old to be sure of beating Vane. You are not.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o0.t: The Chancellor wants a trial by combat?
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o1.c: I'll fight to make him yield. The truth needs a winner, not a corpse.
That is the Rose's way, and the harder one. Vane will not offer you the same courtesy.
Whatever it takes. Vane chose his master.
Then go with Stendarr, and don't let anger make you careless.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o1.t: Tell Lord Valmont how you will fight
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o2.j: Garrick Vane was the best swordsman I have ever faced. When he went down he did not ask for mercy. He simply looked up at the gallery, and saw his master's chair empty.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o2.t: Defeat Sir Garrick Vane on the duelling ground
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o3.r: Through a servants' door with half the treasury's seals in his pockets, and a pirate ship waiting at Saltreef, no doubt. He has run to the only friends he has left.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.o3.t: The Chancellor fled before the duel ended.
story.skycraft.q.kr_trial_by_combat.outr: I defeated Sir Garrick Vane in a trial by combat, and the court of Wayrest judged the Chancellor guilty. Brennault fled before the verdict, toward his pirate allies at Saltreef.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.desc: Pirates have kidnapped Elsabet Mornay, daughter of a royal councillor. Chancellor Ivo Brennault wants the ransom paid at once, and Lord Valmont suspects something is wrong.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o0.r: Valmont asked, did he? Very well. Read it, by all means. The girl's life is on a clock, and the Rose should be helping me pay, not reading over my shoulder. The money goes to the docks tonight.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o0.t: Lord Valmont asked me to look at the ransom letter.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o2.j: The go-between was no pirate. He wore a clerk's ink stains under his sailor's coat, and he fought like a man who had never expected to.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o2.t: Catch the go-between collecting the ransom on the docks
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o3.t: Take the purse the go-between carried
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o4.r: Paid to the pirates by the Chancellor's banker, before the ransom was ever announced. Brennault arranged this himself. The question is why. We need the girl back before anyone thinks to silence her.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.o4.t: Bring the purse and the letter to Lord Valmont
The go-between was carrying this. It's the Chancellor's own coin.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.outr: The ransom for Elsabet Mornay was being paid out of Chancellor Brennault's own purse before the kidnapping was announced. The Chancellor arranged it. Lord Valmont wants her rescued before she can be silenced.
story.skycraft.q.kr_very_good_paper.pitc: I am. Iliac Bay pirates have taken Elsabet Mornay, whose father sits on the King's council. Chancellor Brennault wants the ransom paid quietly and quickly. Something about it smells wrong. Go and see the Chancellor, and look at that letter with a knight's eyes.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_ashes_of_fort_sutch: Daedra have been seen around Fort Sutch, where an Oblivion gate once burned near Anvil. Commander Phillida has called up the Legion to hold the fort, and I am to lead the defence.
Hold the walls against the first wave of Daedra
Valkynaz Ruuth laughed when he fell, and promised to come back. Perhaps he will. The fort is still ours.
Kill the dremora warlord Valkynaz Ruuth
Then the Gold Coast sleeps tonight because of you. The Legion needs officers who stand when the sky turns red. Consider yourself promoted.
Report to Adamus Phillida in the Imperial City
Fort Sutch held. Their warlord carried this.
I held Fort Sutch against the Daedra and killed their warlord. Commander Phillida raised me to Tribune.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_blood_on_the_gold_r: A bandit warlord named Varn Ironjaw holds Fort Urasek on the Gold Road and has been robbing every caravan bound for Skingrad. Commander Phillida ordered me to retake the fort.
Travel to Fort Urasek on the Gold Road
Retake Fort Urasek from the bandits
Varn Ironjaw had a strongbox full of caravan seals and a Legion helmet he'd taken off a dead patrol. He fought like a man who thought nobody would ever come for him.
Then the Gold Road is open. Skingrad's merchants will remember the Legion kindly, for a month or two. Well done, soldier.
Fort Urasek is ours again. Ironjaw is dead.
I retook Fort Urasek and killed the warlord Varn Ironjaw. The caravans run again between the Imperial City and Skingrad.
A warlord calling himself Varn Ironjaw has taken Fort Urasek on the Gold Road and is taxing every caravan between here and Skingrad. Take the fort back. Bring me his head, or at least his surrender.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_hunting_the_fox.des: Captain Lex wants the Gray Fox, master of the Thieves Guild, in a cell. He has sent me into the Waterfront to find where the smugglers' cargo ends up. Anyone in the Guild will see this as a betrayal.
Behind a false wall in a Waterfront warehouse I found a grey hood hung on a peg, a lamp still warm, and a man whose face I could not keep in my mind. He did not run. He asked me what I was going to tell Lex.
Then tell me where, soldier. Tell me exactly where.
I found the Gray Fox's hideout.
It was empty. He was gone before I got there.
Gone. Always gone. Very well. I'll get him another day, and you'll be there when I do.
The Waterfront, behind the warehouse wall. I'll take you there.
At last. We'll raid it tonight. If he slips the cells again, it won't be for lack of trying on your part.
Decide whether to give the Gray Fox up to Captain Lex
story.skycraft.q.lgc_hunting_the_fox.out: I tracked the Gray Fox to the Waterfront and made my choice about what Captain Lex would hear.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.desc: Captain Lex believes smugglers cross Lake Rumare by night to supply the Waterfront. He sent me to their cove on the north shore to find out who they work for.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.o0.t: Find the smugglers' cove on Lake Rumare
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.o1.t: Wait for the smugglers' boats after dark
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.o3.t: Search the smugglers' boat for papers
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.o4.r: Of course it does. The Waterfront means one thing to me: the Gray Fox. This is the closest I've been in years.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.o4.t: Bring the manifest to Captain Lex
The smugglers kept a manifest. Every cargo goes to a Waterfront warehouse.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.offe: Captain, you look like a man with a grudge.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.outr: The smugglers on Lake Rumare were supplying the Waterfront. Captain Lex is convinced the trail leads to the Gray Fox himself.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_mist_on_rumare.pitc: Smugglers are running boats across Lake Rumare at night, straight into the Waterfront. I want to know what they're carrying and who they're carrying it for. There's a cove on the north shore. Go after dark.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_stones_for_kvatch.d: Commander Phillida assigned me to escort the master mason Marcella Tullus to Kvatch, where Savlian Matius is rebuilding the city's walls.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_stones_for_kvatch.o: Just you? Well, I've seen the Legion send fewer. My tools are on the cart. Try to keep the bandits off them; they're worth more than I am.
Meet Marcella Tullus in the Imperial City
Drive off the scavengers picking over the convoy road
Whole! I'd nearly forgotten that was possible. Stay a moment. I want you to see this.
I brought Marcella Tullus safely to Kvatch. The first stones of the new walls went up while I watched.
story.skycraft.q.lgc_stones_for_kvatch.p: Kvatch is still rebuilding, and every mason we send gets robbed on the road. Marcella Tullus is the best builder in the Heartland. Take her to Savlian Matius in Kvatch, alive and with her tools, and see the first walls go up.
Commander Adamus Phillida will take me into the Imperial Legion if I serve a first duty with the Imperial Watch: clearing the thugs who rob travellers on the Red Ring Road.
A recruit. Wonderful. The Red Ring Road, south shore. Four of them, maybe five, and they're bold because nobody stops them. Stop them.
Commander Phillida sent me to you.
Clear the thugs off the Red Ring Road
Captain Lex says you did it cleanly. Raise your right hand. You serve the Empire, its laws and its people, for as long as it needs you. Welcome to the Legion, Auxiliary.
Return to Adamus Phillida and take the oath
The Red Ring Road is clear.
I want to serve the Legion.
I cleared the Red Ring Road and swore the oath of the Imperial Legion before Commander Adamus Phillida.

Good. The Watch is short of hands, so you'll start there. Thugs have been robbing travellers on the Red Ring Road in sight of the city walls. Clear them off and report to Captain Lex. If you're still standing, you'll take the oath.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.desc: With the Elder Scroll I return to the summit of the Throat of the World. At the time-wound, where Alduin was cast out long ago, the Scroll will show me the Shout I need.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o0.te: Return to the summit of the Throat of the World
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o1.te: Read the Elder Scroll at the time-wound
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o3.jo: Grounded by Dragonrend, Alduin fought like a cornered wolf, and when he was beaten he fled into the sky. He is not dead. Not yet.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.title: Alduin's Bane
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.desc: Esbern believes Alduin's Wall, carved in the lost Sky Haven Temple, shows how the ancient Nords defeated the World-Eater. The temple lies hidden inside Karthspire, in the Reach, where the Forsworn now camp.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o0.te: Meet Delphine and Esbern at Karthspire
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o1.te: Clear the Forsworn camp at Karthspire
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o3.re: Look, look! The heroes didn't kill him. They cast him out of time, with a Shout made for the purpose.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o4.re: Then go. Take this blade from the old Blades' armory: it was forged for exactly this kind of work. You're one of us now, whatever the Greybeards say.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o4.to: We have to ask the Greybeards about Dragonrend.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.title: Alduin's Wall
story.skycraft.q.main_before_the_storm.d: The dragon flew north toward Whiterun. Riverwood asked me to carry word to Jarl Balgruuf and beg him for soldiers; the village has no walls and no garrison.
story.skycraft.q.main_before_the_storm.o: The Jarl sent soldiers to Riverwood. He has another task for me, something about his court wizard and dragons.

A dragon? So the rumors are true. Irileth, send a detachment to Riverwood at once. You've done Whiterun a service, friend. Stay a moment. My court wizard has a task that wants someone with your nerve.
Speak to Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach
Riverwood needs protection. A dragon destroyed Helgen.
Delphine is one of the last Blades, the order that once guarded the Dragonborn emperors. She thinks the dragons are not returning on their own: something is raising them from their mounds. Kynesgrove is next on her map.
That map Farengar copied for me marks every burial mound in Skyrim. If I'm right, a dragon will rise from the one at Kynesgrove. Meet me there. Bring your Voice.
What do you know about the dragons?
By Alduin himself. The World-Eater, out of the old prophecies. I hoped it was a story. The Thalmor will know something; they always do. I have a way into their embassy.
So the dragons are being raised.
story.skycraft.q.main_bleak_falls_barrow: Farengar Secret-Fire, the Jarl's court wizard, believes there is a record of the dragons' resting places carved on a tablet in Bleak Falls Barrow, the old tomb on the mountain above Riverwood.
Help is a strong word. I need legs. In Bleak Falls Barrow lies a carved tablet: the Dragonstone. It maps their burial mounds, I'm sure of it. Bring it to me and the Jarl will pay you.
Speak to Farengar about the Dragonstone
The Jarl says you need help with dragons.
The dead don't stay down in Bleak Falls Barrow. I put four of them back in their alcoves.
Behind the overlord's sarcophagus stood a curved wall carved in claw-marks. One of the marks burned and I knew it: FUS. Force. I can't make it mean anything yet.
Defeat the Draugr Overlord guarding the inner chamber
Take the Dragonstone from the overlord's tomb
Remarkable. A map of mounds, every one marked. My colleague will be delighted. And you should go to the Jarl; a guard just came in shouting about the western watchtower.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.desc: Esbern, an archivist of the Blades, is hiding somewhere in the Ratway beneath Riften. The Thalmor are looking for him too.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.re: An old man jumping at shadows? Lad, half the Ratway fits that. But there's one locked in the Warrens like he owes the world money. Watch yourself down there; you're not the only one asking.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.te: Ask around Riften about the old man in the Ratway
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.to: I'm looking for an old man hiding in the Ratway.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o3.te: Deal with the Thalmor hunting Esbern
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o4.re: Delphine? Alive? Then the world isn't entirely lost. Alduin has come back, and nothing can stop him but a Dragonborn. Take me to her. I know where the Blades hid their secrets.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o4.te: Find Esbern in the Ratway Warrens
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o5.te: Bring Esbern to Delphine in Riverwood
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o6.re: Old fool, I thought you dead. Esbern says the lost Sky Haven Temple holds Alduin's Wall, the Blades' record of how he was beaten. It's in Karthspire, in the Reach. We go now.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.title: A Cornered Rat
story.skycraft.q.main_diplomatic_immunit: Delphine is sure the Thalmor know who is raising the dragons. Their embassy outside Solitude holds a reception tonight, and a friend of the Blades works in the kitchen.
Keep your voice down. I'll smuggle your gear into the embassy kitchen. Get in, find their files, get out. If anyone asks, you've never met me.
The Thalmor don't know who raises the dragons either. But they are hunting an old Blade named Esbern, and their file says he hides in the Ratway beneath Riften.
Search the embassy for the Thalmor's files
But they're hunting Esbern. If that old man is still alive, he knows more about Alduin than anyone living. Find him in the Ratway before they do.
The Thalmor are as lost as we are.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.desc: A dragon attacked the western watchtower. The Jarl sent his housecarl Irileth with a band of guards, and asked me to go with them. If a dragon can die, we will learn it today.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o0.t: Join Irileth at the western watchtower
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o2.j: When the dragon died, its soul poured into me. The guards say only the Dragonborn of legend could do that.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o3.r: Then the old tales are true. And did you hear the mountain? The Greybeards called a name from High Hrothgar, and I believe it was yours. By my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. Take this axe from my armory. And go to them: one does not keep the Greybeards waiting.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o3.t: The dragon is dead, and I took its soul.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.desc: The World-Eater is no more. Paarthurnax will want to hear it from me, on the mountain where it began.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.o0.te: Return to the Throat of the World
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.title: Dragonslayer
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.de: I need an Elder Scroll. The only person in Skyrim who might know where one lies is Septimus Signus, a scholar of the Scrolls who lives alone in the ice north of Winterhold.
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o0: Find Septimus Signus north of Winterhold
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o1: The Scroll! Under the earth, in the Dwemer's hidden city, it waits inside the Tower of Mzark. Go down through Alftand into Blackreach. Take this sphere; the tower will listen to it.
Ask Septimus about the Elder Scroll
I'm looking for an Elder Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o3: Survive the Falmer and the machines of Alftand
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o6: The tower's lenses focused a beam of starlight, and a cylinder rose from the floor. Inside lay an Elder Scroll.
Take the Elder Scroll from the tower's lens
story.skycraft.q.main_horn_of_jurgen.des: The Greybeards' final trial: recover the horn of their founder from his tomb in Ustengrav, deep in the bogs of Hjaalmarch.
Fight through the depths of Ustengrav
The horn was gone. Someone had beaten me to it and left a note: 'If you want the horn, rent the attic room at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood. Your friend.'
Go to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood
The attic? We don't have... Close the door. So you're the one the Greybeards were shouting for. Here's your horn. I needed to see who'd come for it before I trusted them with anything.
Ask the innkeeper about the attic room
I'd like to rent the attic room.
You have passed the trials. Stand with us, and receive the last word of Force: DAH. Push. Let your Voice break what stands before it.
Return the horn to the Greybeards
Here is the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.desc: Delphine and Esbern have learned what Paarthurnax is. They demand his death as the price of the Blades' help.
I won't kill him. He taught me, and he's earned his peace.
Then the Blades have nothing more to say to you. I hope you're right about him.
Good. Esbern will see to it that the Blades remember this.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.offer: You look like you want to say something, Delphine.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.pitch: I'll say it plainly. Paarthurnax is a dragon. He was Alduin's lieutenant once, and he did unspeakable things. The Blades will not help you again until he's dead.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.title: Paarthurnax
I agreed to kill Paarthurnax at the Blades' demand. He waits on the summit, as he always has.
Then the Blades stand with you again, Dragonborn. Some debts take a thousand years to collect.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.de: The civil war gets in the way of the fight against Alduin. Arngeir agreed to host a council at High Hrothgar, if both sides come.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o0: A truce with that rebel? ...If it frees my soldiers to fight dragons, I'll listen. I promise nothing.
Persuade General Tullius to attend the council
The Greybeards are holding a council. You should be there.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o1: I'd sooner not sit at a table with the Empire's dog. But I owe the Greybeards that much. I'll come.
Persuade Jarl Ulfric to attend the council
The Greybeards want both sides at High Hrothgar.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o2: Return to High Hrothgar for the council
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.of: Could the Greybeards host a truce between Ulfric and Tullius?
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.pi: This is a strange request to bring to High Hrothgar. But if the war hinders the fight against Alduin, we will open our doors. Bring them here. Let them talk.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.desc: Sovngarde. The mist here is Alduin's: he hunts the souls of the dead as they arrive. The heroes who first cast him out wait in the Hall of Valor.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.o1.text: Follow the old road through the mist and find the heroes of old
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.o2.journ: Alduin is gone. His soul broke apart over Sovngarde like sparks on the wind.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.o3.text: Ask Tsun at the Whalebone Bridge to send you home (or take the golden way at the misty vale)
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.title: Sovngarde
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.desc: Alduin fled to Sovngarde, through a portal no mortal can reach on foot. Paarthurnax says one of Alduin's own dragons could carry me, if I could trap one. Dragonsreach was built to hold a dragon once. Jarl Balgruuf will need persuading.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.repl: You want me to invite a dragon into my palace? ...You've never asked me for anything, and you saved this city once already. Very well. The great porch, and the old yoke. Gods help us.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.text: Ask Jarl Balgruuf to let you trap a dragon in Dragonsreach
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.topi: I need Dragonsreach to trap a dragon.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o1.text: Learn from Paarthurnax which dragon to call
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o2.text: Go to the great porch of Dragonsreach and call the dragon's name
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o3.jour: Odahviing came, and when he was spent the yoke slammed shut over his neck. Trapped, he offered a bargain.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o3.text: Wear Odahviing down until he can be caught in the yoke
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.title: The Fallen
story.skycraft.q.main_throat_of_the_worl: Arngeir must tell me about Dragonrend, though the Greybeards will not thank me for keeping company with the Blades.

That Shout was made from hatred, and we will not teach it. Our master may answer you. Paarthurnax dwells on the summit. Take this Shout to part the winds that guard the path: LOK VAH KOOR. Clear Skies.
Use Clear Skies to part the storm on the path to the summit
Climb to the summit of the Throat of the World
Paarthurnax, master of the Greybeards, is a dragon. He says Dragonrend can only be learned by seeing it, through an Elder Scroll read at the time-wound on this summit.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.desc: I was caught crossing the border and carted to Helgen with a band of rebels to lose my head. Then the sky split open and a black dragon came down on the town. I have to get out.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c0.labe: I'm with you, Ralof. Lead the way.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c0.repl: Then stay close and keep low. The keep's this way, and the Legion won't hold the door for us.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c1.labe: Hadvar! Get me out of here.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c1.repl: Follow me, prisoner. I'll cut those bindings once we're inside the keep. Move!
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.journal: With the headsman's block still wet and the dragon tearing the town apart, I picked a side and ran.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.text: Choose whom to follow out of Helgen: Ralof or Hadvar
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o1.journal: Inside the keep, soldiers of the other side stood between us and the tunnels. We cut our way through, and the spiders in the deep caves were worse.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o1.text: Fight your way through Helgen Keep
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o2.journal: We came out into daylight just as the dragon flew north over the mountains.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o2.text: Escape through the caves beneath the keep
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c0.labe: Ralof sent me. Helgen is gone. A dragon burned it.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c0.repl: A dragon? Shor's bones. Then Riverwood is next and we have no walls. Take what you need from the mill. And go to Whiterun, tell the Jarl we need soldiers.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c1.labe: Hadvar sent me. A dragon destroyed Helgen.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c1.repl: Hadvar's alive, thank the Nine. Here, take some iron from the forge and something to eat. Someone has to warn Jarl Balgruuf. Will you go?
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.text: Find help in Riverwood: Ralof's sister Gerdur, or Hadvar's uncle Alvor
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.title: Unbound
story.skycraft.q.main_way_of_the_voice.d: The Greybeards have summoned me to High Hrothgar, their monastery high on the Throat of the World. The pilgrims' road starts at Ivarstead: seven thousand steps cut into the mountain.
story.skycraft.q.main_way_of_the_voice.o: Begin the climb of the Seven Thousand Steps
So. A Dragonborn appears in our time. Let us see whether the blood speaks true. Show us your Voice.
Use Unrelenting Force before the Greybeards
Use Whirlwind Sprint to pass the gate in the courtyard
Then hear it. In the barrow of Ustengrav lies the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller, founder of our order. Bring it to us. The way is long and the dead do not sleep there.
Ask Arngeir about the final trial
I'm ready for the last trial.
Odahviing agreed to carry me to Skuldafn, a temple in the eastern mountains where Alduin's portal to Sovngarde stands. In return, I set him free.
Fight through the temple of Skuldafn
Open the portal with the dragon priest's staff and step through
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.de: With a chapter's recommendation in hand, I can present myself at the Arcane University in the Imperial City and ask to be admitted as an apprentice.
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.o0: Travel to the Arcane University in the Imperial City
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.o1: He did, in four pages, with diagrams. Before I admit you, tell me what you want from the University. People who don't know tend not to last.
Teekeeus of Chorrol sent a recommendation for me.
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.o2: Knowledge. Everything the old masters wrote down.
A reader. Good. The Mystic Archives will eat your evenings. Don't let them eat your sleep.
Power. Enough that nothing can threaten me.
Honest, at least. Most who say that end up in a necromancer's cellar or a Guild report. Learn restraint along with the spells.
To protect people. Magic is a tool like any other.
Traven will like you. Try not to let him lecture you about it for more than an hour.
Tell Raminus Polus what you seek at the University
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.o3: Then welcome. The University is the heart of the Guild, and the Guild is the conscience of Tamriel's magic, or it tries to be. Raminus will keep you busy.
story.skycraft.q.mg_arcane_university.ou: I was admitted to the Arcane University as an apprentice. Raminus Polus warned me that the work would start immediately. He was not exaggerating.
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.desc: Mannimarco, the King of Worms, waits in Echo Cave, east of the Imperial City. Traven has charged me with ending him before his Order can strike the University itself.
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.o1.tex: Fight through the Order of the Black Worm
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.o2.jou: Mannimarco was older than anything I had fought, and the dead rose for him without being asked. He came apart at last into dust and the smell of old paper.
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.o3.rep: Then sit. No, sit, before you fall down. There is something the Council and I must say to you.
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.o3.tex: Report to Hannibal Traven at the Arcane University
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.outro: I destroyed Mannimarco, the King of Worms, in Echo Cave. Hannibal Traven stepped aside and the Council of Mages named me his successor.
story.skycraft.q.mg_king_of_worms.title: The King of Worms
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.de: Raminus Polus sent me to Vahtacen, an Ayleid ruin near Lake Rumare, to recover a Welkynd stone from a sealed chamber.
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.o0: Travel to the Ayleid ruin of Vahtacen
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.o2: The sealed chamber was open when I reached it. Someone had come before me, cut a black worm into the wall, and left the stone where it lay.
Take the Welkynd stone from the sealed chamber
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.o3: A black worm carved on the wall? I was afraid of that. The stone is yours to keep for your trouble. The mark you saw is mine to worry about. For now.
Bring the Welkynd stone to Raminus Polus
The stone, intact. But someone had opened the chamber before me.
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.of: Do you have work for an apprentice?
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.ou: I brought a Welkynd stone back from Vahtacen, but the Order of the Black Worm had been there first. Raminus did not look surprised.
story.skycraft.q.mg_light_of_vahtacen.pi: The Ayleid ruin of Vahtacen, west of the lake, has a chamber our scholars could never open. A colleague swears it holds a working Welkynd stone. Bring one back intact and I will see you advanced. And watch for the dead. Ayleids rarely sleep alone.
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.de: Hannibal Traven believes the Order of the Black Worm makes black soul gems at an altar in Fort Linchal, near Bravil. He wants me to break the ritual on a moonlit night and bring him one of the gems.
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.o1: Wait for nightfall at Fort Linchal
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.o3: Take the black soul gem from the altar
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.o4: Let me see. Yes. I could fill this, you know. With my own soul, poured into a spell no necromancer could withstand. Or we break it here, and fight him as the Guild has always fought. Your counsel?
Bring the black soul gem to Hannibal Traven
The ritual is broken. I have one of their gems.
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.o5: Break it. We won't become what we're fighting.
Spoken like a true member of this Guild. There. Gone. We'll find another way to his door.
Keep it, but only as a last resort.
A last resort it is. I'll lock it in my study and pray I never need it.
Advise Traven on the black soul gem
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.ou: I broke the Black Worm's ritual at Fort Linchal and brought back one of their black soul gems. Among the necromancers' papers was the name of the place where their master waits: Echo Cave.
story.skycraft.q.mg_necromancers_moon.pi: Black soul gems. On certain nights the necromancers' altars catch the moonlight and turn an ordinary gem into a vessel for a mortal soul. They make them at Fort Linchal, near Bravil. Go when the moon is up, scatter them, and bring me one of those gems.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.desc: Teekeeus, head of the Mages Guild chapter in Chorrol, will recommend me to the Arcane University if I deal with the scamps loose in his library and recover his Concordance.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.o0.jo: Three scamps, a great deal of smoke, and one very unhappy apprentice. The library will need a new rug.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.o0.te: Banish the scamps loose in the Chorrol guild hall
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.o2.re: Mostly is more than I hoped for. Welcome to the Guild. My letter will be at the Arcane University before you are. Ask for Raminus Polus, and try not to set anything on fire.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.o2.to: The scamps are gone. Here is your Concordance, mostly.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.offer: I'd like to join the Mages Guild.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.outro: I joined the Mages Guild in Chorrol. Teekeeus has written to the Arcane University on my behalf.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.pitch: The University only admits those a chapter will vouch for. I will vouch for you, once you help me. An apprentice's summoning went astray and there are scamps loose in the stacks, eating my books. Get rid of them and find my Concordance before they finish it.
story.skycraft.q.mg_recommendation.title: A Matter of Recommendation
Guild mages travelling between chapters have been disappearing on the roads. Teekeeus's own journeyman has not reached Chorrol, and the University suspects the Order of the Black Worm.
Three days late. She was carrying letters for the Arch-Mage. The road east of town runs past an old shepherd's track. Look there, and be ready for company.
The University says your journeyman never arrived.
The journeyman was beyond help. The acolytes had been waiting for the next Guild mage to come along the same road.
Break the necromancers' ambush on the Chorrol road
Search the acolytes for their orders
So is yours, I see. Stay a moment. Raminus should hear this.
Bring the orders to Hannibal Traven
The necromancers have a list of Guild mages. Your name is on it.
The Order of the Black Worm is hunting the Mages Guild, and it answers to Mannimarco, the King of Worms. Traven means to strike first.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.desc: Moongrave Fane, an old temple west of Torval, has fallen silent. Azadhi believes the Dro-m'Athra, Khajiit spirits lost to the darkness between the moons, have claimed it.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o0.reply: Moongrave Fane has gone dark. Its keeper's censer burned for three hundred years and now it does not. Only the Dro-m'Athra put out a light like that. Go, and if the censer can be lit again, bring it to me.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o2.text: Send the Dro-m'Athra back into the dark
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o3.journa: Ash-Whisker had been the Fane's keeper once. I could see the old priest's cord still around its neck, gone black as the rest of it.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o3.text: Destroy the Dro-m'Athra who snuffed the censer
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o5.reply: Then he is home now, or closer to it. Look, the censer remembers.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o5.text: Bring the censer to Azadhi in Torval
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.o5.topic: The Fane is cleansed. Its keeper was among them.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.outro: I cleansed Moongrave Fane of the Dro-m'Athra, including the lost spirit of its own keeper, and brought the temple's censer back to Azadhi, who lit it again.
story.skycraft.q.mp_dro_mathra.title: Children of the Dark Moon
story.skycraft.q.mp_pilgrims_path.desc: Jo'vassa, an old Khajiit pilgrim, asked me to walk with him from Torval to the Moon Temple in the hills, where he means to give thanks for his grandson's birth.
story.skycraft.q.mp_pilgrims_path.o0.tex: Escort Jo'vassa to the Moon Temple
story.skycraft.q.mp_pilgrims_path.o1.jou: The bandits had a senche-tiger on a chain. When its keeper fell, it simply lay down and purred. Jo'vassa fed it a sugar cake.
story.skycraft.q.mp_pilgrims_path.o1.tex: Drive off the bandits waylaying pilgrims
story.skycraft.q.mp_pilgrims_path.o2.rep: Terrible, and full of gratitude. This one will pray for his grandson, and then for you. Tell Hadoba that Jo'vassa says you walk well.
